   133	  function unlockAudio() {
   134	    if (!audio) {
   135	      try { audio = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (e) { audio = null; }
   136	    }
   137	    if (audio && audio.state === 'suspended') audio.resume().catch(function () {});
   138	  }
   139	
   140	  function tone(freq, duration, type, volume) {
   141	    if (!audio) return;
   142	    try {
   143	      var osc = audio.createOscillator(), gain = audio.createGain();
   144	      osc.type = type || 'sine'; osc.frequency.value = freq;
   145	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audio.currentTime);
   146	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(volume || 0.04, audio.currentTime + 0.01);
   147	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audio.currentTime + duration);
   148	      osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audio.destination); osc.start(); osc.stop(audio.currentTime + duration + 0.02);
   149	    } catch (e) {}
   150	  }
   151	
   152	  function sound(kind) {
   153	    if (kind === 'kick') tone(130, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.08);
   154	    else if (kind === 'pass') tone(310, 0.1, 'sine', 0.045);
   155	    else if (kind === 'tackle') { tone(92, 0.07, 'square', 0.05); tone(170, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.03); }
   156	    else if (kind === 'goal') { tone(400, 0.12, 'sine', 0.06); tone(560, 0.16, 'sine', 0.035); }
   157	    else if (kind === 'ui') tone(520, 0.05, 'sine', 0.025);
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
   161	  function clamp(n, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n)); }
   162	  function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
   163	  function norm(x, y) { var l = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1; return { x: x / l, y: y / l }; }
   164	  function selectedPlayers() { return selected.map(function (i) { return roster[i]; }).filter(Boolean); }
   165	
   166	  function makePlayers() {
   167	    var chosen = selectedPlayers();
   168	    while (chosen.length < 5) { if (!roster[chosen.length]) break; chosen.push(roster[chosen.length]); }
   169	    var ownSlots = [{ x: 195, y: 536 }, { x: 111, y: 487 }, { x: 278, y: 487 }, { x: 150, y: 420 }, { x: 240, y: 420 }];
   170	    var oppSlots = [{ x: 195, y: 168 }, { x: 111, y: 216 }, { x: 278, y: 216 }, { x: 150, y: 285 }, { x: 240, y: 285 }];
   171	    var own = chosen.slice(0, 5).map(function (p, i) {
   172	      return { id: p.id, name: p.name, role: p.role, team: 'own', x: ownSlots[i].x, y: ownSlots[i].y, homeX: ownSlots[i].x, homeY: ownSlots[i].y, vx: 0, vy: 0, stamina: p.stamina, pace: p.pace, nerve: p.nerve, cooldown: 0, active: i === 0 };
   173	    });
   174	    var opp = oppSlots.map(function (pos, i) {
   175	      return { id: 100 + i, name: ['Vale', 'Ibis', 'Rime', 'Silo', 'Pike'][i], role: ['GK', 'DF', 'DF', 'MF', 'FW'][i], team: 'opp', x: pos.x, y: pos.y, homeX: pos.x, homeY: pos.y, vx: 0, vy: 0, stamina: 1, pace: 0.84 + i * 0.035, nerve: 0.82 + i * 0.04, cooldown: 0, active: false };
   176	    });
   177	    return { own: own, opp: opp };
   178	  }
   179	
   180	  function makeMatch() {
   181	    var squad = SQUAD_NAMES[saveData.fixture % SQUAD_NAMES.length];
   182	    var players = makePlayers();
   183	    return {
   184	      clock: 180, ownScore: 0, oppScore: 0, paused: false, ended: false,
   185	      fixture: saveData.fixture, cup: saveData.cup, squad: squad[0], style: squad[1], styleNote: squad[2],
   186	      difficulty: 0.84 + saveData.cup * 0.045 + saveData.fixture * 0.018,
   187	      own: players.own, opp: players.opp, active: 0, possession: 'own', carrier: 4,
   188	      ball: { x: 195, y: 420, vx: 0, vy: 0, owner: 'own', ownerIndex: 4, spin: 0, trail: [] },
   189	      kickCooldown: 0, aiCooldown: rand(1, 2), restartDelay: 0, banner: 'KICKOFF', bannerTime: 1.8,
   190	      lastAction: 'Move your selected player into the play.', stick: { x: 0, y: 0 }, drag: null,
   191	      substitutions: 0, scoreFlash: 0
   192	    };
   193	  }

   195	  function startMatch() {
   196	    resetInputs(); cancelPendingTimeouts(); match = makeMatch(); state = 'match'; sound('ui');
   197	  }

   199	  function newCup() {
   200	    cancelPendingTimeouts(); resetInputs();
   201	    saveData.fixture = 0; saveData.wins = 0; saveData.history = [];
   202	    selected = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].filter(function (n) { return n < roster.length; });
   203	    while (selected.length < 5) selected.push(selected.length);
   204	    selectedSet = new Set(selected); save(); state = 'lineup'; lineupMessage = 'New cup ready. Set your starting five.'; sound('ui');
   205	  }

   207	  function replayMatch() { cancelPendingTimeouts(); resetInputs(); match = makeMatch(); state = 'match'; sound('ui'); }
   208	
   209	  function recordMatchStamina() {
   210	    var used = new Set(selected);
   211	    roster.forEach(function (p) {
   212	      if (used.has(p.id)) {
   213	        var played = match && match.own.find(function (q) { return q.id === p.id; });
   214	        p.stamina = clamp(played ? played.stamina : p.stamina, 0.25, 1);
   215	      } else p.stamina = clamp(p.stamina + 0.18, 0.35, 1);
   216	    });
   217	  }
   218	
   219	  function finishMatch() {
   220	    if (!match || match.ended) return;
   220	    if (!match || match.ended) return;
   221	    match.ended = true; cancelPendingTimeouts(); resetInputs();
   222	    recordMatchStamina();
   223	    var win = match.ownScore > match.oppScore;
   224	    var draw = match.ownScore === match.oppScore;
   225	    if (win) {
   226	      saveData.wins++;
   227	      saveData.history.push({ cup: saveData.cup, fixture: saveData.fixture, own: match.ownScore, opp: match.oppScore });
   228	      saveData.history = saveData.history.slice(-7);
   229	      saveData.fixture++;
   230	      if (saveData.fixture >= 7) {
   231	        saveData.trophies.push('Cup ' + saveData.cup + ' · ' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
   232	        saveData.trophies = saveData.trophies.slice(-32);
   233	        saveData.cup = Math.min(99, saveData.cup + 1); saveData.fixture = 0; saveData.wins = 0;
   234	        for (var i = 0; i < 2 && roster.length < 14; i++) {
   235	          var id = roster.length;
   236	          roster.push({ id: id, name: FIRST_NAMES[id], role: ROLES[id], pace: 0.92 + (id % 3) * 0.04, nerve: 0.95, stamina: 1 });
   237	        }
   238	        save(); state = 'trophy'; sound('goal'); shake = 8; flash = 1;
   239	      } else {
   240	        save(); lineupMessage = 'Win secured. Rotate tired legs before fixture ' + (saveData.fixture + 1) + '.'; state = 'lineup'; sound('goal');
   241	      }
   242	    } else {
   243	      saveData.history.push({ cup: saveData.cup, fixture: saveData.fixture, own: match.ownScore, opp: match.oppScore });
   244	      saveData.history = saveData.history.slice(-7); save(); state = 'loss'; sound('tackle'); shake = 6;
   245	    }
   246	    if (draw) lineupMessage = 'A level score is a replay. Find the opening.';
   247	  }
   248	
   249	  function update(dt) {
   250	    menuPulse += dt; shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 18); flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 2.5);
   251	    updateParticles(dt); updateTexts(dt);
   252	    if (state !== 'match' || !match || match.ended) return;
   253	    if (match.bannerTime > 0) match.bannerTime -= dt;
   254	    match.scoreFlash = Math.max(0, match.scoreFlash - dt);
   255	    match.kickCooldown = Math.max(0, match.kickCooldown - dt);
   256	    match.aiCooldown = Math.max(0, match.aiCooldown - dt);
   257	    match.clock = Math.max(0, match.clock - dt);
   258	    if (match.restartDelay > 0) {
   259	      match.restartDelay = Math.max(0, match.restartDelay - dt);
   260	      if (match.restartDelay === 0 && !match.ended) {
   261	        match.ball.owner = 'own'; match.ball.ownerIndex = match.own[4].id; match.ball.x = match.own[4].x; match.ball.y = match.own[4].y - 13;
   262	      }
   263	    }
   264	    updateStickFromKeys();
   265	    updatePlayers(dt);
   266	    updateBall(dt);
   267	    if (match.clock <= 0) finishMatch();
   268	  }
   269	
   270	  function updateStickFromKeys() {
   271	    var x = 0, y = 0;
   272	    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft')) x -= 1; if (keys.has('ArrowRight')) x += 1;
   273	    if (keys.has('ArrowUp')) y -= 1; if (keys.has('ArrowDown')) y += 1;
   274	    if (x || y) match.stick = norm(x, y); else if (controlPointers.stick === null) match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 };
   275	  }
   276	
   277	  function updatePlayers(dt) {
   278	    var m = match, active = m.own[m.active], all = m.own.concat(m.opp);
   279	    m.own.forEach(function (p, i) {
   280	      p.cooldown = Math.max(0, p.cooldown - dt); p.stamina = clamp(p.stamina - dt * (i === m.active ? 0.0008 : 0.00025), 0.35, 1);
   281	      var targetX = p.homeX, targetY = p.homeY;
   282	      if (p.id === m.ball.ownerIndex && m.ball.owner === 'own') { targetX = m.ball.x; targetY = m.ball.y; }
   283	      else if (i === m.active) { targetX += m.stick.x * 70; targetY += m.stick.y * 70; }
   284	      else { targetX += clamp((m.ball.x - 195) * 0.16, -32, 32); targetY += clamp((m.ball.y - 352) * 0.11, -28, 28); }
   285	      targetX = clamp(targetX, field.l + 18, field.r - 18); targetY = clamp(targetY, field.mid + 12, field.b - 18);
   286	      moveToward(p, targetX, targetY, (p.pace * 72 + 20) * dt);
   287	    });
   288	    var style = m.style;
   289	    m.opp.forEach(function (p, i) {
   290	      p.cooldown = Math.max(0, p.cooldown - dt);
   291	      var targetX = p.homeX, targetY = p.homeY;
   292	      if (m.ball.owner === 'opp' && m.ball.ownerIndex === p.id) { targetX = m.ball.x; targetY = m.ball.y; }
   293	      else if (style === 'press') { targetX = clamp(m.ball.x + (i - 2) * 14, field.l + 16, field.r - 16); targetY = clamp(m.ball.y - 78 + i * 18, field.t + 22, field.mid - 12); }
   294	      else if (style === 'wing') { targetX = clamp((i === 1 || i === 4) ? (i === 1 ? field.l + 22 : field.r - 22) : m.ball.x, field.l + 16, field.r - 16); targetY = clamp(m.ball.y - 48 + i * 14, field.t + 18, field.mid - 12); }
   295	      else { targetX += clamp((m.ball.x - 195) * 0.24, -30, 30); targetY += clamp((m.ball.y - 170) * 0.06, -14, 20); }
   296	      if (m.ball.owner === 'own' && dist(p, m.ball) < (style === 'press' ? 45 : 34) && p.cooldown <= 0) trySteal(p);
   297	      if (m.ball.owner === 'opp' && m.ball.ownerIndex === p.id && p.cooldown <= 0 && m.ball.y > field.b - 140) {
   298	        aiKick(p, true);
   299	      }
   300	      targetX = clamp(targetX, field.l + 16, field.r - 16); targetY = clamp(targetY, field.t + 18, field.mid - 12);
   301	      moveToward(p, targetX, targetY, (p.pace * 58 + 18) * dt);
   302	    });
   303	    if (m.ball.owner === 'own') {
   304	      var carrier = m.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === m.ball.ownerIndex; });
   305	      if (carrier) { m.ball.x = carrier.x; m.ball.y = carrier.y - 13; m.ball.vx = carrier.vx; m.ball.vy = carrier.vy; }
   306	    } else if (m.ball.owner === 'opp') {
   307	      var oc = m.opp.find(function (p) { return p.id === m.ball.ownerIndex; });
   308	      if (oc) { m.ball.x = oc.x; m.ball.y = oc.y + 13; m.ball.vx = oc.vx; m.ball.vy = oc.vy; }
   309	    }
   310	    if (active && active.stamina < 0.42) addText(active.x, active.y - 28, 'TIRED', COLORS.yellow, 0.8);
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  function moveToward(p, tx, ty, step) {
   314	    var dx = tx - p.x, dy = ty - p.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   315	    if (d > 0.5) { var n = norm(dx, dy); p.vx = n.x * Math.min(d, step) / 0.016; p.vy = n.y * Math.min(d, step) / 0.016; p.x += n.x * Math.min(d, step); p.y += n.y * Math.min(d, step); }
   316	    else { p.vx *= 0.8; p.vy *= 0.8; }
   317	  }
   318	
   319	  function updateBall(dt) {
   320	    var b = match.ball;
   321	    if (b.owner) return;
   322	    b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.vx *= Math.pow(0.25, dt); b.vy *= Math.pow(0.25, dt); b.spin += dt * 5;
   323	    b.trail.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y }); if (b.trail.length > 9) b.trail.shift();
   324	    if (b.x < field.l + 8 || b.x > field.r - 8) { b.x = clamp(b.x, field.l + 8, field.r - 8); b.vx *= -0.75; }
   325	    if (b.y < field.t + 6) { if (b.x > 146 && b.x < 244) scoreGoal('own'); else { b.y = field.t + 6; b.vy *= -0.72; } }
   326	    if (b.y > field.b - 6) { if (b.x > 146 && b.x < 244) scoreGoal('opp'); else { b.y = field.b - 6; b.vy *= -0.72; } }
   327	    if (Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy) < 12) {
   328	      var candidates = match.own.concat(match.opp).filter(function (p) { return dist(p, b) < 18; });
   329	      if (candidates.length) { var p = candidates[0]; b.owner = p.team; b.ownerIndex = p.id; match.possession = p.team; addBurst(b.x, b.y, p.team === 'own' ? COLORS.blue : COLORS.red, 5); }
   330	    }
   331	  }
   332	
   333	  function scoreGoal(team) {
   334	    if (match.scoreFlash > 0) return;
   335	    if (team === 'own') match.ownScore++; else match.oppScore++;
   336	    match.scoreFlash = 1.1; match.banner = team === 'own' ? 'GOAL!  NICE FINISH' : 'CAUGHT ON THE BREAK'; match.bannerTime = 1.5; shake = 11; flash = 0.9;
   337	    addBurst(195, team === 'own' ? field.t + 14 : field.b - 14, team === 'own' ? COLORS.blue : COLORS.red, 28); sound(team === 'own' ? 'goal' : 'tackle');
   338	    match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = 195; match.ball.y = 352; match.ball.vx = 0; match.ball.vy = 0;
   339	    match.possession = team === 'own' ? 'opp' : 'own';
   340	    match.restartDelay = 0.7;
   341	  }
   342	
   343	  function passBall(vx, vy, curve) {
   344	    if (!match || match.kickCooldown > 0 || match.ball.owner !== 'own') return;
   345	    var carrier = match.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   346	    if (!carrier) return;
   347	    var n = norm(vx, vy); var target = findPassTarget(carrier, n);
   348	    match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = carrier.x; match.ball.y = carrier.y - 13;
   349	    match.ball.vx = n.x * 240 + (target.x - carrier.x) * 0.55; match.ball.vy = n.y * 240 + (target.y - carrier.y) * 0.55;
   350	    match.ball.spin = curve || 0; match.kickCooldown = 0.22; match.lastAction = 'PASS LANE  ·  bend the next one'; carrier.cooldown = 0.25; addBurst(carrier.x, carrier.y - 10, COLORS.mint, 9); sound('pass');
   351	  }
   352	
   353	  function shootBall(vx, vy, curve) {
   354	    if (!match || match.kickCooldown > 0 || match.ball.owner !== 'own') return;
   355	    var carrier = match.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   356	    if (!carrier) return;
   357	    var n = norm(vx, vy); if (n.y > -0.12) n.y = -0.72;
   358	    n = norm(n.x, n.y); match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = carrier.x; match.ball.y = carrier.y - 13;
   359	    var power = 350 + carrier.nerve * 50; match.ball.vx = n.x * power; match.ball.vy = n.y * power; match.ball.spin = (curve || 0) * 1.8;
   360	    match.kickCooldown = 0.38; match.lastAction = 'SHOT  ·  curve follows your swipe'; carrier.cooldown = 0.45; addBurst(carrier.x, carrier.y - 12, COLORS.yellow, 12); sound('kick'); shake = 2;
   361	  }
   362	
   363	  function findPassTarget(carrier, n) {
   364	    var candidates = match.own.filter(function (p) { return p !== carrier; });
   365	    var best = candidates[0], score = -Infinity;
   366	    candidates.forEach(function (p) { var d = norm(p.x - carrier.x, p.y - carrier.y); var s = d.x * n.x + d.y * n.y - dist(p, carrier) / 500; if (s > score) { score = s; best = p; } });
   367	    return best || carrier;
   368	  }
   369	
   370	  function aiKick(player, urgent) {
   371	    if (!match || match.ball.owner !== 'opp') return;
   372	    var target = match.style === 'wing' ? (player.x < 195 ? field.l + 58 : field.r - 58) : 195;
   373	    var n = norm(target - player.x, field.b + 50 - player.y);
   374	    match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = player.x; match.ball.y = player.y + 13;
   375	    if (urgent || Math.random() < 0.36 + saveData.cup * 0.03) { match.ball.vx = n.x * (205 + match.difficulty * 25); match.ball.vy = n.y * (205 + match.difficulty * 25); match.lastAction = 'THEIR BREAK IS ON'; }
   376	    else { match.ball.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 180; match.ball.vy = 150; match.lastAction = 'WIN IT BACK'; }
   377	    player.cooldown = 1.1; addBurst(player.x, player.y + 10, COLORS.red, 7); sound('kick');
   378	  }
   379	
   380	  function trySteal(defender) {
   381	    if (!match || match.ball.owner !== 'own' || !defender) return;
   382	    var carrier = match.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   383	    if (!carrier || dist(defender, carrier) > 43) return;
   384	    if (Math.random() < 0.4) { match.ball.owner = 'opp'; match.ball.ownerIndex = defender.id; match.possession = 'opp'; addBurst(defender.x, defender.y, COLORS.red, 8); }
   385	  }
   386	
   387	  function tackle() {
   388	    if (!match) return;
   389	    var p = match.own[match.active];
   390	    if (!p) return;
   391	    var target = match.opp.reduce(function (best, q) { return !best || dist(p, q) < dist(p, best) ? q : best; }, null);
   392	    if (target && dist(p, target) < 48) {
   393	      if (match.ball.owner === 'opp' && match.ball.ownerIndex === target.id) { match.ball.owner = 'own'; match.ball.ownerIndex = p.id; match.possession = 'own'; match.lastAction = 'CLEAN TACKLE'; addBurst(target.x, target.y, COLORS.mint, 14); sound('tackle'); shake = 3; }
   394	      else { target.x += (target.x - p.x) * 0.35; target.y += (target.y - p.y) * 0.35; addBurst(p.x, p.y, COLORS.yellow, 6); sound('tackle'); }
   395	    }
   396	  }
   397	
   398	  function switchDefender(x, y) {
   399	    if (!match) return;
   400	    var target = null;
   401	    if (Number.isFinite(x)) target = match.own.reduce(function (best, p) { return !best || dist({ x: x, y: y }, p) < dist({ x: x, y: y }, best) ? p : best; }, null);
   402	    if (target) { match.active = match.own.indexOf(target); match.own.forEach(function (p, i) { p.active = i === match.active; }); match.lastAction = target.name + ' selected'; }
   403	    tackle();
   404	  }
   405	
   406	  function actionDirection() {
   407	    var x = 0, y = -1;
   408	    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft')) x -= 1; if (keys.has('ArrowRight')) x += 1; if (keys.has('ArrowDown')) y += 1;
   409	    if (x || y !== -1) return norm(x, y);
   410	    return { x: 0, y: -1 };
   411	  }
   412	
   413	  function pointerPos(e) {
   414	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   415	    return { x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) - viewX) / viewScale, 0, W), y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) - viewY) / viewScale, 0, H) };
   416	  }
   417	
   418	  function inRect(p, r) { return !!r && p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h; }
   419	  function setControl(name, id) { if (controlPointers[name] === null) { controlPointers[name] = id; return true; } return false; }
   420	  function releaseControl(id) { Object.keys(controlPointers).forEach(function (k) { if (controlPointers[k] === id) controlPointers[k] = null; }); }
   421	
   422	  function onPointerDown(e) {
   423	    e.preventDefault(); unlockAudio();
   424	    if (blockedByOrientation) return;
   425	    var p = pointerPos(e); activePointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: p.x, y: p.y, points: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }], mode: null });
   426	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
   427	    if (state === 'match' && match) {
   428	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.stick) && setControl('stick', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'stick'; updateStick(p); return; }
   429	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.pass) && setControl('pass', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'pass'; return; }
   430	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.shoot) && setControl('shoot', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'shoot'; return; }
   431	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.switch) && setControl('switch', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'switch'; return; }
   432	      if (p.y >= field.t && p.y <= field.b && setControl('gesture', e.pointerId)) {
   433	        var carrier = match.own.find(function (q) { return q.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   434	        if (carrier && dist(p, carrier) < 64) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'gesture'; match.drag = { start: p, points: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }] }; }
   435	        else { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'defender'; }
   436	      }
   437	    } else { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'ui'; }
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  function updateStick(p) {
   441	    if (!match) return;
   442	    var c = { x: 64, y: 650 }, v = norm(p.x - c.x, p.y - c.y), d = clamp(Math.hypot(p.x - c.x, p.y - c.y) / 44, 0, 1);
   443	    match.stick = { x: v.x * d, y: v.y * d };
   444	  }
   445	
   446	  function onPointerMove(e) {
   447	    e.preventDefault(); var rec = activePointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!rec) return; var p = pointerPos(e);
   448	    if (rec.points.length < 20) rec.points.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y });
   449	    if (rec.mode === 'stick') updateStick(p);
   450	    if (rec.mode === 'gesture' && match && match.drag) match.drag.points = rec.points.slice(-20);
   451	  }
   452	
   453	  function onPointerUp(e, cancelled) {
   454	    e.preventDefault(); var rec = activePointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!rec) return; var p = pointerPos(e);
   455	    activePointers.delete(e.pointerId); releaseControl(e.pointerId);
   456	    if (cancelled) { if (rec.mode === 'stick' && match) match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 }; if (match) match.drag = null; return; }
   457	    if (state === 'match' && match) {
   458	      if (rec.mode === 'pass') passBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0);
   459	      else if (rec.mode === 'shoot') shootBall(0, -1, 0);
   460	      else if (rec.mode === 'switch') switchDefender(match.ball.x, match.ball.y);
   461	      else if (rec.mode === 'stick') match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 };
   462	      else if (rec.mode === 'gesture') {
   463	        var start = rec.points[0], dx = p.x - start.x, dy = p.y - start.y, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   464	        var curve = rec.points.reduce(function (acc, q, i) { if (!i) return acc; var prev = rec.points[i - 1]; return acc + (q.x - prev.x) * (q.y - start.y) - (q.y - prev.y) * (q.x - start.x); }, 0) / 5000;
   465	        if (len > 18) { if (dy < -22 && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 0.45) shootBall(dx, dy, clamp(curve, -1, 1)); else passBall(dx, dy, clamp(curve, -1, 1)); }
   466	        else { switchDefender(p.x, p.y); }
   467	        match.drag = null;
   468	      } else if (rec.mode === 'defender') switchDefender(p.x, p.y);
   469	    } else handleUiTap(p);
   470	  }
   471	
   472	  function handleUiTap(p) {
   473	    var area = Object.keys(hitAreas).find(function (key) { return key !== 'stick' && key !== 'pass' && key !== 'shoot' && inRect(p, hitAreas[key]); });
   474	    if (area === 'start') { if (state === 'menu') state = 'lineup'; else if (state === 'loss') replayMatch(); else if (state === 'trophy') newCup(); sound('ui'); }
   475	    else if (area === 'fixture') { if (state === 'lineup' && selected.length === 5) startMatch(); }
   476	    else if (area && area.indexOf('player-') === 0) togglePlayer(Number(area.slice(7)));
   477	  }
   478	
   479	  function togglePlayer(index) {
   480	    if (index < 0 || index >= roster.length) return;
   480	    if (index < 0 || index >= roster.length) return;
   481	    if (selectedSet.has(index)) { if (selected.length <= 5) return; selected = selected.filter(function (n) { return n !== index; }); selectedSet.delete(index); }
   482	    else if (selected.length < 5) { selected.push(index); selectedSet.add(index); }
   483	    save(); sound('ui');
   484	  }
   485	
   486	  function keyDown(e) {
   487	    if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'j', 'k', 'J', 'K', ' '].indexOf(e.key) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   488	    unlockAudio();
   489	    if (e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'J') { keys.add('j'); if (state === 'match') passBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0); }
   490	    else if (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K') { keys.add('k'); if (state === 'match') shootBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0); }
   491	    else if (e.key === ' ') { if (state === 'match') tackle(); else handleUiTap({ x: 195, y: 540 }); }
   492	    else keys.add(e.key);
   493	  }
   494	
   495	  function keyUp(e) { keys.delete(e.key); }
   496	
   497	  function draw() {
   498	    ctx.setTransform(pxScale, 0, 0, pxScale, 0, 0);
   499	    ctx.fillStyle = '#091217'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);
   500	    ctx.setTransform(pxScale * viewScale, 0, 0, pxScale * viewScale, pxScale * viewX, pxScale * viewY);
   501	    var sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
   502	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, sy); drawScene(); ctx.restore();
   503	    if (flash > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,201,' + Math.min(0.22, flash * 0.18) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); }
   504	    if (blockedByOrientation) drawRotateOverlay();
   505	  }
   506	
   507	  function drawScene() {
   508	    hitAreas = {};
   509	    ctx.fillStyle = '#091217'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   510	    if (state === 'menu') drawMenu();
   511	    else if (state === 'lineup') drawLineup();
   512	    else if (state === 'match') drawMatch();
   513	    else if (state === 'loss') drawResult(false);
   514	    else if (state === 'trophy') drawResult(true);
   515	    drawParticles(); drawTexts();
   516	  }

   518	  function text(str, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   519	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.ink; ctx.font = (weight || 600) + ' ' + (size || 14) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = align || 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillText(str, x, y);
   520	  }
   521	  function roundedPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
   522	    r = Math.min(r, Math.abs(w) / 2, Math.abs(h) / 2); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r); ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
   523	  }
   524	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
   525	    roundedPath(x, y, w, h, r); if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); } if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   526	  }
   527	  function pill(label, x, y, w, color) { roundRect(x, y, w, 27, 13, color || COLORS.panel2); text(label, x + w / 2, y + 14, 11, COLORS.ink, 'center', 750); }

   531	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1d3b3c'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(24, 80); ctx.lineTo(366, 80); ctx.stroke();
   532	  }

   586	  function drawPitch() {
   587	    roundRect(field.l, field.t, field.r - field.l, field.b - field.t, 17, COLORS.grass, '#7bc696');
   588	    ctx.save(); roundedPath(field.l, field.t, field.r - field.l, field.b - field.t, 17); ctx.clip();
   589	    for (var y = field.t; y < field.b; y += 46) { ctx.fillStyle = (Math.floor((y - field.t) / 46) % 2) ? COLORS.grass2 : COLORS.grass; ctx.fillRect(field.l, y, field.r - field.l, 46); }
   590	    ctx.restore();
   591	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,244,192,.65)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(field.l, field.mid); ctx.lineTo(field.r, field.mid); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(195, field.mid, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,255,210,.7)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(195, field.mid, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   592	    ctx.strokeRect(101, field.t, 188, 70); ctx.strokeRect(101, field.b - 70, 188, 70); ctx.strokeRect(143, field.t, 104, 33); ctx.strokeRect(143, field.b - 33, 104, 33);
   593	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ink; ctx.fillRect(146, field.t - 4, 98, 4); ctx.fillRect(146, field.b, 98, 4);
   594	    drawBall(match.ball);
   595	    match.own.forEach(function (p, i) { drawPlayer(p, i === match.active); });
   596	    match.opp.forEach(function (p) { drawPlayer(p, false); });
   597	    if (match.drag && match.drag.points.length > 1) { ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.yellow; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]); ctx.beginPath(); match.drag.points.forEach(function (p, i) { if (i) ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y); else ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); }); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
   598	  }

   606	  }

   610	    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff5c6'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b6b4c'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
   611	    ctx.fillStyle = '#263c38'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x - 2, b.y - 1, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x + 2, b.y + 2, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   612	  }

    87	  function clamp(value, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value)); }
    88	  function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
    89	  function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }

    93	  function readStore(key, fallback, valid) {
    94	    try {
    95	      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    96	      if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length === 0) return fallback;
    97	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    98	      return valid(parsed) ? parsed : fallback;
    99	    } catch (_) { return fallback; }
   100	  }
   101	
   102	  function writeStore(key, value) {
   103	    try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (_) { /* storage is optional */ }
   104	  }

   106	  function validProfile(value) {
   107	    return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) &&
   108	      Number.isFinite(value.xp) && Number.isFinite(value.wins) && Number.isFinite(value.played) &&
   109	      Number.isFinite(value.camo) && Number.isFinite(value.bestKills);
   110	  }

   122	  function resizeCanvas() {
   123	    view.w = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   124	    view.h = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   125	    view.dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / Math.max(view.w, view.h));
   126	    if (!Number.isFinite(view.dpr) || view.dpr <= 0) view.dpr = 1;
   127	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(view.w * view.dpr));
   128	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(view.h * view.dpr));
   129	    view.scale = Math.min(view.w / VW, view.h / VH);
   130	    view.ox = (view.w - VW * view.scale) * .5;
   131	    view.oy = (view.h - VH * view.scale) * .5;
   132	  }

   134	  function syncOrientation() {
   135	    const blocked = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   136	    if (blocked !== orientationBlocked) {

   144	  function unlockAudio() {
   145	    if (!audioContext) {
   146	      try { audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (_) { audioContext = null; }
   147	    }
   148	    if (audioContext) {
   149	      try { audioContext.resume(); } catch (_) { /* gesture may be unavailable */ }
   150	    }
   151	    $('audioToast').classList.add('off');
   152	  }

   154	  function tone(frequency, duration, type = 'square', volume = .025) {
   155	    if (!audioContext) return;
   156	    try {
   157	      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
   158	      const osc = audioContext.createOscillator();
   159	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   160	      osc.type = type;
   161	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   162	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, now);
   163	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now + duration);
   164	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
   165	      osc.start(now);
   166	      osc.stop(now + duration);
   167	    } catch (_) { /* audio is flavor, not a dependency */ }
   168	  }
   169	
   170	  function cancelPendingTimers() {
   171	    for (const timer of state.pendingTimers) {
   172	      try { clearTimeout(timer); } catch (_) { /* no-op */ }
   173	    }
   174	    state.pendingTimers.length = 0;
   175	  }
   176	
   177	  function schedule(callback, delay) {
   178	    if (state.pendingTimers.length >= 12) return;
   179	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   180	      const index = state.pendingTimers.indexOf(timer);
   181	      if (index >= 0) state.pendingTimers.splice(index, 1);
   182	      callback();
   183	    }, delay);
   184	    state.pendingTimers.push(timer);
   185	  }

   187	  function resetPad(pad) {
   188	    pad.pointerId = null;
   189	    pad.x = 0;
   190	    pad.y = 0;
   191	    pad.active = false;
   192	    const knob = pad.el.querySelector('.stickKnob');
   193	    if (knob) knob.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
   194	  }
   195	
   196	  function releaseAllInput() {
   197	    input.keys.clear();
   198	    input.queuedGadget = 0;
   199	    for (const pad of [input.left, input.right]) {
   200	      if (pad.pointerId !== null) {
   201	        try { pad.el.releasePointerCapture(pad.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* capture may already be gone */ }
   202	      }
   203	      resetPad(pad);
   204	    }
   205	    if (input.gadget.pointerId !== null) {
   206	      try { input.gadget.el.releasePointerCapture(input.gadget.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* no-op */ }
   207	    }
   208	    input.gadget.pointerId = null;
   209	    for (const tap of input.taps) {
   210	      if (tap.pointerId !== null) {
   211	        try { tap.el.releasePointerCapture(tap.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* no-op */ }
   212	      }
   213	      tap.pointerId = null;
   214	    }
   215	  }
   216	
   217	  function bindStick(pad) {
   218	    const el = pad.el;
   219	    const update = (event) => {
   220	      if (event.pointerId !== pad.pointerId) return;
   221	      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
   222	      const dx = event.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width * .5);
   223	      const dy = event.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height * .5);
   224	      const radius = rect.width * .39;
   225	      const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   226	      const scale = Math.min(1, radius / length);
   227	      pad.x = clamp(dx / radius, -1, 1);
   228	      pad.y = clamp(dy / radius, -1, 1);
   229	      const knob = el.querySelector('.stickKnob');
   230	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx * scale}px), calc(-50% + ${dy * scale}px))`;
   231	    };
   232	    const release = (event) => {
   233	      if (event.pointerId !== pad.pointerId) return;
   234	      resetPad(pad);
   235	      event.preventDefault();
   236	    };
   237	    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   238	      if (pad.pointerId !== null) return;
   239	      unlockAudio();
   240	      pad.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   240	      pad.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   241	      pad.active = true;
   242	      try { el.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* capture is optional */ }
   243	      update(event);
   244	      event.preventDefault();
   245	    }, { passive: false });
   246	    el.addEventListener('pointermove', update, { passive: false });
   247	    el.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   248	    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   249	  }
   250	
   251	  function bindGadgetButton() {
   252	    const el = input.gadget.el;
   253	    const release = (event) => {
   254	      if (event.pointerId !== input.gadget.pointerId) return;
   255	      input.gadget.pointerId = null;
   256	      event.preventDefault();
   257	    };
   258	    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   259	      if (input.gadget.pointerId !== null) return;
   260	      unlockAudio();
   261	      input.gadget.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   262	      try { el.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* optional */ }
   263	      input.queuedGadget = 1;
   264	      event.preventDefault();
   265	    }, { passive: false });
   266	    el.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   267	    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   268	  }
   269	
   270	  function bindTapButton(element, action) {
   271	    const control = { el: element, pointerId: null };
   272	    input.taps.push(control);
   273	    const release = (event) => {
   274	      if (event.pointerId !== control.pointerId) return;
   275	      control.pointerId = null;
   276	      if (event.type === 'pointerup') action();
   277	      event.preventDefault();
   278	    };
   279	    element.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   280	      if (control.pointerId !== null) return;
   281	      unlockAudio();
   282	      control.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   283	      try { element.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* optional */ }
   284	      event.preventDefault();
   285	    }, { passive: false });
   286	    element.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   287	    element.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   288	  }
   289	
   290	  function makeEntity(name, team, type, position, weapon) {
   291	    return {
   292	      id: state.nextEntityId++, name, team, type, weapon, x: position.x, y: position.y, r: type === 'player' ? 12 : 10,
   293	      angle: team === 'blue' ? -Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 2, hp: 100, maxHp: 100, alive: true,
   294	      respawn: 0, fireCd: .3, think: Math.random() * .2, target: null, goal: null, kills: 0, deaths: 0,
   295	      invuln: type === 'player' ? 1.5 : .7, strafe: Math.random() > .5 ? 1 : -1
   296	    };
   297	  }
   298	
   299	  function resetRound() {
   300	    cancelPendingTimers();
   301	    releaseAllInput();
   302	    state.map = MAPS[state.mapIndex];
   303	    state.roundTime = 120;
   304	    state.blue = 0;
   305	    state.red = 0;
   306	    state.controlBlue = 0;
   307	    state.controlRed = 0;
   308	    state.roundOver = false;
   309	    state.killStreak = 0;
   310	    state.uavTimer = 0;
   311	    state.sensorTimer = 0;
   312	    state.flash = 0;
   313	    state.shake = 0;
   314	    state.charges = { frag: 2, smoke: 2, sensor: 3 };
   315	    state.particles.length = 0;
   316	    state.tracers.length = 0;
   317	    state.smokes.length = 0;
   318	    state.grenades.length = 0;
   319	    state.feed.length = 0;
   320	    state.nextEntityId = 1;
   321	    state.entities.length = 0;
   322	
   323	    const blueSpawns = state.map.spawns.blue;
   324	    const redSpawns = state.map.spawns.red;
   325	    state.player = makeEntity('YOU', 'blue', 'player', blueSpawns[0], state.weapon);
   326	    state.entities.push(state.player);
   327	    const allyNames = ['Kite', 'Mica', 'Dune'];
   328	    const botWeapons = ['ar', 'smg', 'dmr'];
   329	    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) state.entities.push(makeEntity(allyNames[i], 'blue', 'bot', blueSpawns[i + 1], botWeapons[i]));
   330	    const enemyNames = ['Vex', 'Nix', 'Orla', 'Rook'];
   331	    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) state.entities.push(makeEntity(enemyNames[i], 'red', 'bot', redSpawns[i], botWeapons[(i + 1) % botWeapons.length]));
   332	    $('roundResult').hidden = true;
   333	    renderUi();
   334	  }
   335	
   336	  function respawn(entity) {
   337	    const spawnSet = entity.team === 'blue' ? state.map.spawns.blue : state.map.spawns.red;
   338	    const spawn = spawnSet[(entity.deaths + entity.id) % spawnSet.length];
   339	    entity.x = spawn.x;
   340	    entity.y = spawn.y;
   341	    entity.hp = entity.maxHp;
   342	    entity.alive = true;
   343	    entity.invuln = 1.25;
   344	    entity.fireCd = .35;
   345	    entity.goal = null;
   346	    entity.target = null;
   347	    burst(entity.x, entity.y, entity.team === 'blue' ? '#66caff' : '#ff737b', 8, 32);
   348	  }
   349	
   350	  function circleHitsWall(x, y, radius) {
   351	    for (const wall of state.map.walls) {
   352	      const qx = clamp(x, wall.x, wall.x + wall.w);
   353	      const qy = clamp(y, wall.y, wall.y + wall.h);
   354	      if ((x - qx) ** 2 + (y - qy) ** 2 < radius ** 2) return true;
   355	    }
   356	    return false;
   357	  }
   358	
   359	  function moveEntity(entity, dx, dy) {
   360	    const nx = clamp(entity.x + dx, 18, VW - 18);
   361	    const ny = clamp(entity.y + dy, 103, VH - 26);
   362	    if (!circleHitsWall(nx, entity.y, entity.r)) entity.x = nx;
   363	    if (!circleHitsWall(entity.x, ny, entity.r)) entity.y = ny;
   364	  }
   365	
   366	  function segmentHitsWall(a, b) {
   367	    const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / 7);
   368	    for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
   369	      const t = i / steps;
   370	      const x = lerp(a.x, b.x, t);
   371	      const y = lerp(a.y, b.y, t);
   372	      for (const wall of state.map.walls) if (x >= wall.x && x <= wall.x + wall.w && y >= wall.y && y <= wall.y + wall.h) return true;
   373	    }
   374	    return false;
   375	  }
   376	
   377	  function segmentHitsSmoke(a, b) {
   378	    for (const smoke of state.smokes) {
   379	      const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / 9);
   380	      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
   381	        const t = i / steps;
   382	        const x = lerp(a.x, b.x, t);
   383	        const y = lerp(a.y, b.y, t);
   384	        if ((x - smoke.x) ** 2 + (y - smoke.y) ** 2 < smoke.r ** 2) return true;
   385	      }
   386	    }
   387	    return false;
   388	  }
   389	
   390	  function lineClear(a, b, includeSmoke) {
   391	    if (segmentHitsWall(a, b)) return false;
   392	    return !includeSmoke || !segmentHitsSmoke(a, b);
   393	  }
   394	
   395	  function getMoveVector() {
   396	    let x = input.left.x;
   397	    let y = input.left.y;
   398	    if (input.keys.has('w')) y -= 1;
   399	    if (input.keys.has('s')) y += 1;
   400	    if (input.keys.has('a')) x -= 1;
   401	    if (input.keys.has('d')) x += 1;
   402	    const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   403	    return length > 1 ? { x: x / length, y: y / length } : { x, y };
   404	  }
   405	
   406	  function getAimVector() {
   407	    let x = input.right.x;
   408	    let y = input.right.y;
   409	    let usingKeyboard = false;
   410	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowLeft')) { x -= 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   411	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowRight')) { x += 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   412	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowUp')) { y -= 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   413	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowDown')) { y += 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   414	    const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   415	    if (length > .08) {
   416	      state.lastAim = { x: x / length, y: y / length };
   417	      return state.lastAim;
   418	    }
   419	    return state.lastAim;
   420	  }
   421	
   422	  function playerIsFiring() {
   423	    return input.right.active && Math.hypot(input.right.x, input.right.y) > .12 ||
   424	      input.keys.has('ArrowLeft') || input.keys.has('ArrowRight') || input.keys.has('ArrowUp') || input.keys.has('ArrowDown');
   425	  }
   426	
   427	  function nearestTarget(bot) {
   428	    let best = null;
   429	    let bestScore = Infinity;
   430	    for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   431	      if (!candidate.alive || candidate.team === bot.team) continue;
   432	      const distance = dist(bot, candidate);
   433	      const hiddenPenalty = lineClear(bot, candidate, true) ? 0 : 230;
   434	      const score = distance + hiddenPenalty;
   435	      if (score < bestScore) { best = candidate; bestScore = score; }
   436	    }
   437	    return best;
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  function chooseBotGoal(bot) {
   441	    const target = bot.target;
   442	    if (target && target.alive) {
   443	      if (lineClear(target, bot, true)) {
   444	        let cover = null;
   445	        let coverScore = Infinity;
   446	        for (const spot of state.map.covers) {
   447	          if (lineClear(target, spot, true)) continue;
   448	          const score = dist(bot, spot) + dist(target, spot) * .08;
   449	          if (score < coverScore) { cover = spot; coverScore = score; }
   450	        }
   451	        if (cover && dist(bot, cover) < 230) return { x: cover.x, y: cover.y };
   452	      }
   453	      if (dist(bot, target) > WEAPONS[bot.weapon].range * .62) return { x: target.x, y: target.y };
   454	      return { x: target.x + Math.cos(bot.angle + Math.PI / 2) * 34 * bot.strafe, y: target.y + Math.sin(bot.angle + Math.PI / 2) * 34 * bot.strafe };
   455	    }
   456	    if (state.mode === 'control' && dist(bot, state.map.point) > 76) return { x: state.map.point.x, y: state.map.point.y };
   457	    return { x: bot.x, y: bot.y };
   458	  }
   459	
   460	  function updatePlayer(dt) {
   461	    const player = state.player;
   462	    if (!player.alive) {
   463	      player.respawn -= dt;
   464	      if (player.respawn <= 0) respawn(player);
   465	      return;
   466	    }
   467	    player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - dt);
   468	    player.fireCd -= dt;
   469	    player.weapon = state.weapon;
   470	    const move = getMoveVector();
   471	    moveEntity(player, move.x * 124 * dt, move.y * 124 * dt);
   472	    const aim = getAimVector();
   473	    player.angle = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x);
   474	    if (playerIsFiring()) shoot(player, aim, true);
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  function updateBot(bot, dt) {
   478	    if (!bot.alive) {
   479	      bot.respawn -= dt;
   480	      if (bot.respawn <= 0) respawn(bot);
   481	      return;
   482	    }
   483	    bot.invuln = Math.max(0, bot.invuln - dt);
   484	    bot.fireCd -= dt;
   485	    bot.think -= dt;
   486	    if (bot.think <= 0) {
   487	      bot.think = .22 + Math.random() * .18;
   488	      bot.target = nearestTarget(bot);
   489	      bot.goal = chooseBotGoal(bot);
   490	    }
   491	    const target = bot.target && bot.target.alive ? bot.target : nearestTarget(bot);
   492	    if (target) bot.target = target;
   493	    const weapon = WEAPONS[bot.weapon];
   494	    if (target && lineClear(bot, target, true)) {
   495	      const aimX = target.x - bot.x;
   496	      const aimY = target.y - bot.y;
   497	      const distance = Math.hypot(aimX, aimY);
   498	      bot.angle = Math.atan2(aimY, aimX);
   499	      if (distance < weapon.range * 1.08 && bot.fireCd <= 0) shoot(bot, { x: aimX / distance, y: aimY / distance }, false);
   500	    }
   501	    const goal = bot.goal || chooseBotGoal(bot);
   502	    if (goal) {
   503	      const gx = goal.x - bot.x;
   504	      const gy = goal.y - bot.y;
   505	      const length = Math.hypot(gx, gy);
   506	      if (length > 8) moveEntity(bot, gx / length * 64 * dt, gy / length * 64 * dt);
   507	    }
   508	  }
   509	
   510	  function shoot(shooter, aim, isPlayer) {
   511	    if (!shooter.alive || shooter.fireCd > 0) return;
   512	    const weapon = WEAPONS[shooter.weapon];
   513	    shooter.fireCd = weapon.cooldown;
   514	    const angle = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x) + (Math.random() - .5) * weapon.spread;
   515	    const direction = { x: Math.cos(angle), y: Math.sin(angle) };
   516	    const start = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * (shooter.r + 3), y: shooter.y + direction.y * (shooter.r + 3) };
   517	    let end = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * weapon.range, y: shooter.y + direction.y * weapon.range };
   518	    let hit = null;
   519	    for (let distance = 0; distance <= weapon.range; distance += 5) {
   520	      const point = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * distance, y: shooter.y + direction.y * distance };
   520	      const point = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * distance, y: shooter.y + direction.y * distance };
   521	      let blocked = false;
   522	      for (const wall of state.map.walls) {
   523	        if (point.x >= wall.x && point.x <= wall.x + wall.w && point.y >= wall.y && point.y <= wall.y + wall.h) { blocked = true; break; }
   524	      }
   525	      if (blocked) { end = point; break; }
   526	      for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   527	        if (!candidate.alive || candidate.team === shooter.team || candidate.id === shooter.id) continue;
   528	        if ((point.x - candidate.x) ** 2 + (point.y - candidate.y) ** 2 < (candidate.r + 3) ** 2) {
   529	          hit = candidate;
   530	          end = point;
   531	          break;
   532	        }
   533	      }
   534	      if (hit) break;
   535	    }
   536	    pushCap(state.tracers, { x1: start.x, y1: start.y, x2: end.x, y2: end.y, life: .075, color: weapon.color }, MAX_TRACERS);
   537	    burst(start.x, start.y, weapon.color, isPlayer ? 3 : 2, 22);
   538	    if (hit) {
   539	      const falloff = clamp(1 - dist(shooter, hit) / weapon.range * .35, .58, 1);
   540	      takeDamage(hit, weapon.damage * falloff, shooter);
   541	      burst(end.x, end.y, hit.team === 'blue' ? '#83d2ff' : '#ff7b7e', 6, 42);
   542	      if (isPlayer) state.flash = .07;
   543	    }
   544	    tone(isPlayer ? 125 : 90, .035, 'square', isPlayer ? .018 : .009);
   545	  }
   546	
   547	  function takeDamage(target, amount, attacker) {
   548	    if (!target.alive || target.invuln > 0) return;
   549	    target.hp -= amount;
   550	    target.invuln = Math.max(target.invuln, .06);
   551	    if (target.type === 'player') { state.flash = .11; state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3); }
   552	    if (target.hp <= 0) eliminate(target, attacker);
   553	  }
   554	
   555	  function eliminate(victim, killer) {
   556	    if (!victim.alive) return;
   557	    victim.alive = false;
   558	    victim.hp = 0;
   559	    victim.respawn = 2.2;
   560	    victim.deaths++;
   561	    if (killer) {
   562	      killer.kills++;
   563	      if (killer.team === 'blue') state.blue++; else state.red++;
   564	      if (killer.type === 'player') {
   565	        state.killStreak++;
   566	        if (state.killStreak === 3) {
   567	          state.uavTimer = 8;
   568	          addFeed('UAV PING ONLINE', '#59e0c0');
   569	          tone(760, .18, 'sine', .04);
   570	        }
   571	      }
   572	      addFeed(`${killer.name} dropped ${victim.name}`, killer.team === 'blue' ? '#7ccaff' : '#ff7b7e');
   573	    }
   574	    if (victim.type === 'player') {
   575	      state.killStreak = 0;
   576	      addFeed('YOU ARE DOWN · RESPAWNING', '#ffbc63');
   577	      state.shake = 7;
   578	      tone(52, .18, 'sawtooth', .035);
   579	    }
   580	    burst(victim.x, victim.y, victim.team === 'blue' ? '#66caff' : '#ff6872', 18, 75);
   581	    if (state.mode === 'tdm' && (state.blue >= 20 || state.red >= 20)) endRound();
   582	  }
   583	
   584	  function useGadget() {
   585	    if (state.roundOver || !state.player.alive) return;
   586	    const type = state.gadget;
   587	    if (!state.charges[type]) { addFeed(`${type.toUpperCase()} EMPTY`, '#ffbc63'); tone(180, .06, 'square', .025); return; }
   588	    const aim = getAimVector();
   589	    const range = type === 'sensor' ? 0 : 106;
   590	    const target = { x: clamp(state.player.x + aim.x * range, 22, VW - 22), y: clamp(state.player.y + aim.y * range, 110, VH - 30) };
   591	    state.charges[type]--;
   592	    if (type === 'frag') {
   593	      if (state.grenades.length < MAX_GRENADES) state.grenades.push({ x: target.x, y: target.y, t: .72, owner: state.player });
   594	      addFeed('FRAG OUT', '#ffbc63');
   595	      tone(230, .08, 'square', .035);
   596	    } else if (type === 'smoke') {
   597	      pushCap(state.smokes, { x: target.x, y: target.y, r: 66, life: 7 }, MAX_SMOKES);
   598	      burst(target.x, target.y, '#aeb9bd', 16, 44);
   599	      addFeed('SMOKE SCREEN ACTIVE', '#b9d4d0');
   600	      tone(300, .08, 'sine', .025);
   601	    } else {
   602	      state.sensorTimer = 5;
   603	      addFeed('SENSOR PING · HOSTILES MARKED', '#e2b269');
   604	      burst(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#e2b269', 14, 34);
   605	      tone(640, .12, 'sine', .035);
   606	    }
   607	  }
   608	
   609	  function explodeFrag(grenade) {
   610	    burst(grenade.x, grenade.y, '#ffbd66', 32, 115);
   611	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 8);
   612	    for (const entity of state.entities) {
   613	      if (!entity.alive || entity.team === grenade.owner.team) continue;
   614	      const distance = Math.hypot(entity.x - grenade.x, entity.y - grenade.y);
   615	      if (distance < 84 && lineClear(grenade, entity, false)) takeDamage(entity, 88 * (1 - distance / 130), grenade.owner);
   616	    }
   617	    tone(68, .22, 'sawtooth', .045);
   618	  }
   619	
   620	  function updateOrdnance(dt) {
   621	    for (let i = state.grenades.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   622	      const grenade = state.grenades[i];
   623	      grenade.t -= dt;
   624	      if (grenade.t <= 0) { explodeFrag(grenade); state.grenades.splice(i, 1); }
   625	    }
   626	    for (let i = state.smokes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   627	      state.smokes[i].life -= dt;
   628	      if (state.smokes[i].life <= 0) state.smokes.splice(i, 1);
   629	    }
   630	  }
   631	
   632	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   633	    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   634	      const p = state.particles[i];
   635	      p.life -= dt;
   636	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   637	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   638	      p.vx *= .94;
   639	      p.vy *= .94;
   640	      if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   641	    }
   642	    for (let i = state.tracers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   643	      state.tracers[i].life -= dt;
   644	      if (state.tracers[i].life <= 0) state.tracers.splice(i, 1);
   645	    }
   646	    for (let i = state.feed.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   647	      state.feed[i].life -= dt;
   648	      if (state.feed[i].life <= 0) state.feed.splice(i, 1);
   649	    }
   650	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt);
   651	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 16);
   652	    state.uavTimer = Math.max(0, state.uavTimer - dt);
   653	    state.sensorTimer = Math.max(0, state.sensorTimer - dt);
   654	  }
   655	
   656	  function updateControl(dt) {
   657	    if (state.mode !== 'control') return;
   658	    let blue = 0;
   659	    let red = 0;
   660	    for (const entity of state.entities) {
   661	      if (!entity.alive || dist(entity, state.map.point) > state.map.point.r) continue;
   662	      if (entity.team === 'blue') blue++; else red++;
   663	    }
   664	    if (blue > red) state.controlBlue = clamp(state.controlBlue + dt * 5, 0, 100);
   665	    if (red > blue) state.controlRed = clamp(state.controlRed + dt * 5, 0, 100);
   666	    if (state.controlBlue >= 100 || state.controlRed >= 100) endRound();
   667	  }
   668	
   669	  function update(dt) {
   670	    if (orientationBlocked || state.roundOver) return;
   671	    state.roundTime = Math.max(0, state.roundTime - dt);
   672	    updatePlayer(dt);
   673	    for (const entity of state.entities) if (entity.type === 'bot') updateBot(entity, dt);
   674	    updateOrdnance(dt);
   675	    updateControl(dt);
   676	    updateEffects(dt);
   677	    if (input.queuedGadget) { input.queuedGadget = 0; useGadget(); }
   678	    if (state.roundTime <= 0) endRound();
   679	  }
   680	
   681	  function burst(x, y, color, count, force) {
   682	    const safeCount = Math.min(count, MAX_PARTICLES - state.particles.length);
   683	    for (let i = 0; i < safeCount; i++) {
   684	      const angle = Math.random() * TAU;
   685	      const speed = Math.random() * force;
   686	      pushCap(state.particles, { x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: .16 + Math.random() * .35, size: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5, color }, MAX_PARTICLES);
   687	    }
   688	  }
   689	
   690	  function addFeed(text, color) { pushCap(state.feed, { text, color, life: 3.2 }, MAX_FEED); }
   691	
   692	  function endRound() {
   693	    if (state.roundOver) return;
   694	    state.roundOver = true;
   695	    releaseAllInput();
   696	    cancelPendingTimers();
   697	    const blueScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.blue : Math.floor(state.controlBlue);
   698	    const redScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.red : Math.floor(state.controlRed);
   699	    const winner = blueScore > redScore ? 'blue' : redScore > blueScore ? 'red' : 'draw';
   700	    const win = winner === 'blue';
   701	    const xpGain = winner === 'draw' ? 50 : (win ? 100 : 35) + Math.min(40, state.player.kills * 4);
   702	    profile.xp = clamp(profile.xp + xpGain, 0, 999999);
   703	    profile.wins = clamp(profile.wins + (win ? 1 : 0), 0, 999999);
   704	    profile.played = clamp(profile.played + 1, 0, 999999);
   705	    profile.bestKills = Math.max(profile.bestKills, state.player.kills);
   706	    profile.camo = clamp(Math.floor(profile.xp / 125), 0, CAMOS.length - 1);
   707	    writeStore('ironsight-ops-profile', profile);
   708	    const title = winner === 'draw' ? 'DRAW' : win ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT';
   709	    $('resultTitle').textContent = title;
   710	    $('resultTitle').style.color = winner === 'draw' ? '#ffbc63' : win ? '#59e0c0' : '#ff6872';
   711	    $('resultBody').textContent = `${state.map.name} · ${state.mode === 'tdm' ? 'TEAM DEATHMATCH' : 'CONTROL POINT'} · ${blueScore} — ${redScore}. ${win ? 'Your squad owns the drill.' : winner === 'draw' ? 'Nobody took the final lane.' : 'Recalibrate and take the next lane.'}`;
   712	    $('resultKills').textContent = `${state.player.kills} KILLS · ${xpGain} XP`;

   911	  function draw() {

   217	  function bindStick(pad) {
   218	    const el = pad.el;
   219	    const update = (event) => {
   220	      if (event.pointerId !== pad.pointerId) return;
   221	      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
   222	      const dx = event.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width * .5);
   223	      const dy = event.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height * .5);
   224	      const radius = rect.width * .39;
   225	      const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   226	      const scale = Math.min(1, radius / length);
   227	      pad.x = clamp(dx / radius, -1, 1);
   228	      pad.y = clamp(dy / radius, -1, 1);

   325	    state.player = makeEntity('YOU', 'blue', 'player', blueSpawns[0], state.weapon);
   326	    state.entities.push(state.player);
   327	    const allyNames = ['Kite', 'Mica', 'Dune'];
   328	    const botWeapons = ['ar', 'smg', 'dmr'];
   329	    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) state.entities.push(makeEntity(allyNames[i], 'blue', 'bot', blueSpawns[i + 1], botWeapons[i]));
   330	    const enemyNames = ['Vex', 'Nix', 'Orla', 'Rook'];
   331	    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) state.entities.push(makeEntity(enemyNames[i], 'red', 'bot', redSpawns[i], botWeapons[(i + 1) % botWeapons.length]));
   332	    $('roundResult').hidden = true;
   333	    renderUi();
   334	  }
   335	
   336	  function respawn(entity) {
   337	    const spawnSet = entity.team === 'blue' ? state.map.spawns.blue : state.map.spawns.red;
   338	    const spawn = spawnSet[(entity.deaths + entity.id) % spawnSet.length];
   339	    entity.x = spawn.x;
   340	    entity.y = spawn.y;
   341	    entity.hp = entity.maxHp;
   342	    entity.alive = true;
   343	    entity.invuln = 1.25;
   344	    entity.fireCd = .35;
   345	    entity.goal = null;
   346	    entity.target = null;
   347	    burst(entity.x, entity.y, entity.team === 'blue' ? '#66caff' : '#ff737b', 8, 32);
   348	  }
   349	
   350	  function circleHitsWall(x, y, radius) {
   351	    for (const wall of state.map.walls) {
   352	      const qx = clamp(x, wall.x, wall.x + wall.w);
   353	      const qy = clamp(y, wall.y, wall.y + wall.h);
   354	      if ((x - qx) ** 2 + (y - qy) ** 2 < radius ** 2) return true;
   355	    }
   356	    return false;
   357	  }
   358	
   359	  function moveEntity(entity, dx, dy) {
   360	    const nx = clamp(entity.x + dx, 18, VW - 18);
   361	    const ny = clamp(entity.y + dy, 103, VH - 26);
   362	    if (!circleHitsWall(nx, entity.y, entity.r)) entity.x = nx;
   363	    if (!circleHitsWall(entity.x, ny, entity.r)) entity.y = ny;
   364	  }
   365	
   366	  function segmentHitsWall(a, b) {
   367	    const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / 7);
   368	    for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
   369	      const t = i / steps;
   370	      const x = lerp(a.x, b.x, t);
   371	      const y = lerp(a.y, b.y, t);
   372	      for (const wall of state.map.walls) if (x >= wall.x && x <= wall.x + wall.w && y >= wall.y && y <= wall.y + wall.h) return true;
   373	    }
   374	    return false;
   375	  }
   376	
   377	  function segmentHitsSmoke(a, b) {
   378	    for (const smoke of state.smokes) {
   379	      const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / 9);
   380	      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
   381	        const t = i / steps;
   382	        const x = lerp(a.x, b.x, t);
   383	        const y = lerp(a.y, b.y, t);
   384	        if ((x - smoke.x) ** 2 + (y - smoke.y) ** 2 < smoke.r ** 2) return true;
   385	      }
   386	    }
   387	    return false;
   388	  }
   389	
   390	  function lineClear(a, b, includeSmoke) {
   391	    if (segmentHitsWall(a, b)) return false;
   392	    return !includeSmoke || !segmentHitsSmoke(a, b);
   393	  }
   394	
   395	  function getMoveVector() {
   396	    let x = input.left.x;
   397	    let y = input.left.y;
   398	    if (input.keys.has('w')) y -= 1;
   399	    if (input.keys.has('s')) y += 1;
   400	    if (input.keys.has('a')) x -= 1;
   401	    if (input.keys.has('d')) x += 1;
   402	    const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   403	    return length > 1 ? { x: x / length, y: y / length } : { x, y };
   404	  }
   405	
   406	  function getAimVector() {
   407	    let x = input.right.x;
   408	    let y = input.right.y;
   409	    let usingKeyboard = false;
   410	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowLeft')) { x -= 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   411	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowRight')) { x += 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   412	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowUp')) { y -= 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   413	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowDown')) { y += 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   414	    const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   415	    if (length > .08) {
   416	      state.lastAim = { x: x / length, y: y / length };
   417	      return state.lastAim;
   418	    }
   419	    return state.lastAim;
   420	  }
   421	
   422	  function playerIsFiring() {
   423	    return input.right.active && Math.hypot(input.right.x, input.right.y) > .12 ||
   424	      input.keys.has('ArrowLeft') || input.keys.has('ArrowRight') || input.keys.has('ArrowUp') || input.keys.has('ArrowDown');
   425	  }
   426	
   427	  function nearestTarget(bot) {
   428	    let best = null;
   429	    let bestScore = Infinity;
   430	    for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   430	    for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   431	      if (!candidate.alive || candidate.team === bot.team) continue;
   432	      const distance = dist(bot, candidate);
   433	      const hiddenPenalty = lineClear(bot, candidate, true) ? 0 : 230;
   434	      const score = distance + hiddenPenalty;
   435	      if (score < bestScore) { best = candidate; bestScore = score; }
   436	    }
   437	    return best;
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  function chooseBotGoal(bot) {
   441	    const target = bot.target;
   442	    if (target && target.alive) {
   443	      if (lineClear(target, bot, true)) {
   444	        let cover = null;
   445	        let coverScore = Infinity;
   446	        for (const spot of state.map.covers) {
   447	          if (lineClear(target, spot, true)) continue;
   448	          const score = dist(bot, spot) + dist(target, spot) * .08;
   449	          if (score < coverScore) { cover = spot; coverScore = score; }
   450	        }
   451	        if (cover && dist(bot, cover) < 230) return { x: cover.x, y: cover.y };
   452	      }
   453	      if (dist(bot, target) > WEAPONS[bot.weapon].range * .62) return { x: target.x, y: target.y };
   454	      return { x: target.x + Math.cos(bot.angle + Math.PI / 2) * 34 * bot.strafe, y: target.y + Math.sin(bot.angle + Math.PI / 2) * 34 * bot.strafe };
   455	    }
   456	    if (state.mode === 'control' && dist(bot, state.map.point) > 76) return { x: state.map.point.x, y: state.map.point.y };
   457	    return { x: bot.x, y: bot.y };
   458	  }
   459	
   460	  function updatePlayer(dt) {
   461	    const player = state.player;
   462	    if (!player.alive) {
   463	      player.respawn -= dt;
   464	      if (player.respawn <= 0) respawn(player);
   465	      return;
   466	    }
   467	    player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - dt);
   468	    player.fireCd -= dt;
   469	    player.weapon = state.weapon;
   470	    const move = getMoveVector();
   471	    moveEntity(player, move.x * 124 * dt, move.y * 124 * dt);
   472	    const aim = getAimVector();
   473	    player.angle = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x);
   474	    if (playerIsFiring()) shoot(player, aim, true);
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  function updateBot(bot, dt) {
   478	    if (!bot.alive) {
   479	      bot.respawn -= dt;
   480	      if (bot.respawn <= 0) respawn(bot);
   481	      return;
   482	    }
   483	    bot.invuln = Math.max(0, bot.invuln - dt);
   484	    bot.fireCd -= dt;
   485	    bot.think -= dt;
   486	    if (bot.think <= 0) {
   487	      bot.think = .22 + Math.random() * .18;
   488	      bot.target = nearestTarget(bot);
   489	      bot.goal = chooseBotGoal(bot);
   490	    }
   491	    const target = bot.target && bot.target.alive ? bot.target : nearestTarget(bot);
   492	    if (target) bot.target = target;
   493	    const weapon = WEAPONS[bot.weapon];
   494	    if (target && lineClear(bot, target, true)) {
   495	      const aimX = target.x - bot.x;
   496	      const aimY = target.y - bot.y;
   497	      const distance = Math.hypot(aimX, aimY);
   498	      bot.angle = Math.atan2(aimY, aimX);
   499	      if (distance < weapon.range * 1.08 && bot.fireCd <= 0) shoot(bot, { x: aimX / distance, y: aimY / distance }, false);
   500	    }
   501	    const goal = bot.goal || chooseBotGoal(bot);
   502	    if (goal) {
   503	      const gx = goal.x - bot.x;
   504	      const gy = goal.y - bot.y;
   505	      const length = Math.hypot(gx, gy);
   506	      if (length > 8) moveEntity(bot, gx / length * 64 * dt, gy / length * 64 * dt);
   507	    }
   508	  }
   509	
   510	  function shoot(shooter, aim, isPlayer) {
   511	    if (!shooter.alive || shooter.fireCd > 0) return;
   512	    const weapon = WEAPONS[shooter.weapon];
   513	    shooter.fireCd = weapon.cooldown;
   514	    const angle = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x) + (Math.random() - .5) * weapon.spread;
   515	    const direction = { x: Math.cos(angle), y: Math.sin(angle) };
   516	    const start = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * (shooter.r + 3), y: shooter.y + direction.y * (shooter.r + 3) };
   517	    let end = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * weapon.range, y: shooter.y + direction.y * weapon.range };
   518	    let hit = null;
   519	    for (let distance = 0; distance <= weapon.range; distance += 5) {
   520	      const point = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * distance, y: shooter.y + direction.y * distance };
   521	      let blocked = false;
   522	      for (const wall of state.map.walls) {
   523	        if (point.x >= wall.x && point.x <= wall.x + wall.w && point.y >= wall.y && point.y <= wall.y + wall.h) { blocked = true; break; }
   524	      }
   525	      if (blocked) { end = point; break; }
   526	      for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   527	        if (!candidate.alive || candidate.team === shooter.team || candidate.id === shooter.id) continue;
   528	        if ((point.x - candidate.x) ** 2 + (point.y - candidate.y) ** 2 < (candidate.r + 3) ** 2) {
   529	          hit = candidate;
   530	          end = point;
   531	          break;
   532	        }
   533	      }
   534	      if (hit) break;
   535	    }
   536	    pushCap(state.tracers, { x1: start.x, y1: start.y, x2: end.x, y2: end.y, life: .075, color: weapon.color }, MAX_TRACERS);
   537	    burst(start.x, start.y, weapon.color, isPlayer ? 3 : 2, 22);
   538	    if (hit) {
   539	      const falloff = clamp(1 - dist(shooter, hit) / weapon.range * .35, .58, 1);
   540	      takeDamage(hit, weapon.damage * falloff, shooter);
   541	      burst(end.x, end.y, hit.team === 'blue' ? '#83d2ff' : '#ff7b7e', 6, 42);
   542	      if (isPlayer) state.flash = .07;
   543	    }
   544	    tone(isPlayer ? 125 : 90, .035, 'square', isPlayer ? .018 : .009);
   545	  }
   546	
   547	  function takeDamage(target, amount, attacker) {
   548	    if (!target.alive || target.invuln > 0) return;
   549	    target.hp -= amount;
   550	    target.invuln = Math.max(target.invuln, .06);
   551	    if (target.type === 'player') { state.flash = .11; state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3); }
   552	    if (target.hp <= 0) eliminate(target, attacker);
   553	  }
   554	
   555	  function eliminate(victim, killer) {
   556	    if (!victim.alive) return;
   557	    victim.alive = false;
   558	    victim.hp = 0;
   559	    victim.respawn = 2.2;
   560	    victim.deaths++;
   561	    if (killer) {
   562	      killer.kills++;
   563	      if (killer.team === 'blue') state.blue++; else state.red++;
   564	      if (killer.type === 'player') {
   565	        state.killStreak++;
   566	        if (state.killStreak === 3) {
   567	          state.uavTimer = 8;
   568	          addFeed('UAV PING ONLINE', '#59e0c0');
   569	          tone(760, .18, 'sine', .04);
   570	        }
   571	      }
   572	      addFeed(`${killer.name} dropped ${victim.name}`, killer.team === 'blue' ? '#7ccaff' : '#ff7b7e');
   573	    }
   574	    if (victim.type === 'player') {
   575	      state.killStreak = 0;
   576	      addFeed('YOU ARE DOWN · RESPAWNING', '#ffbc63');
   577	      state.shake = 7;
   578	      tone(52, .18, 'sawtooth', .035);
   579	    }
   580	    burst(victim.x, victim.y, victim.team === 'blue' ? '#66caff' : '#ff6872', 18, 75);
   581	    if (state.mode === 'tdm' && (state.blue >= 20 || state.red >= 20)) endRound();
   582	  }
   583	
   584	  function useGadget() {
   585	    if (state.roundOver || !state.player.alive) return;
   586	    const type = state.gadget;
   587	    if (!state.charges[type]) { addFeed(`${type.toUpperCase()} EMPTY`, '#ffbc63'); tone(180, .06, 'square', .025); return; }
   588	    const aim = getAimVector();
   589	    const range = type === 'sensor' ? 0 : 106;
   590	    const target = { x: clamp(state.player.x + aim.x * range, 22, VW - 22), y: clamp(state.player.y + aim.y * range, 110, VH - 30) };
   591	    state.charges[type]--;
   592	    if (type === 'frag') {
   593	      if (state.grenades.length < MAX_GRENADES) state.grenades.push({ x: target.x, y: target.y, t: .72, owner: state.player });
   594	      addFeed('FRAG OUT', '#ffbc63');
   595	      tone(230, .08, 'square', .035);
   596	    } else if (type === 'smoke') {
   597	      pushCap(state.smokes, { x: target.x, y: target.y, r: 66, life: 7 }, MAX_SMOKES);
   598	      burst(target.x, target.y, '#aeb9bd', 16, 44);
   599	      addFeed('SMOKE SCREEN ACTIVE', '#b9d4d0');
   600	      tone(300, .08, 'sine', .025);
   601	    } else {
   602	      state.sensorTimer = 5;
   603	      addFeed('SENSOR PING · HOSTILES MARKED', '#e2b269');
   604	      burst(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#e2b269', 14, 34);
   605	      tone(640, .12, 'sine', .035);
   606	    }
   607	  }

   609	  function explodeFrag(grenade) {
   610	    burst(grenade.x, grenade.y, '#ffbd66', 32, 115);
   611	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 8);
   612	    for (const entity of state.entities) {
   613	      if (!entity.alive || entity.team === grenade.owner.team) continue;
   614	      const distance = Math.hypot(entity.x - grenade.x, entity.y - grenade.y);
   615	      if (distance < 84 && lineClear(grenade, entity, false)) takeDamage(entity, 88 * (1 - distance / 130), grenade.owner);
   616	    }
   617	    tone(68, .22, 'sawtooth', .045);
   618	  }

    55	  function finiteNumber(value, fallback, min, max) {
    56	    var number = Number(value);
    57	    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return fallback;
    58	    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, number));
    59	  }
    60	
    61	  function safeLoad() {
    62	    var fallback = { best: 0, prestige: 0, totalServed: 0, shopTier: 0, wave: 1, gold: 0, upgrades: 0, score: 0 };
    63	    try {
    64	      var raw = localStorage.getItem('slice-rush-save-v1');
    65	      if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length > 2048) return fallback;
    66	      var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    67	      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return fallback;
    68	      return {
    69	        best: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.best, 0, 0, 9999999)),
    70	        prestige: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.prestige, 0, 0, 99)),
    71	        totalServed: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.totalServed, 0, 0, 9999999)),
    72	        shopTier: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.shopTier, 0, 0, 99)),
    73	        wave: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.wave, 1, 1, 99)),
    74	        gold: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.gold, 0, 0, 999999)),
    75	        upgrades: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.upgrades, 0, 0, 12)),
    76	        score: Math.floor(finiteNumber(parsed.score, 0, 0, 9999999))
    77	      };
    78	    } catch (error) {
    79	      return fallback;
    80	    }
    81	  }
    82	
    83	  function safeSave() {
    84	    if (!game) return;
    85	    try {
    86	      var record = {
    87	        best: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.best, 0, 0, 9999999)),
    88	        prestige: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.prestige, 0, 0, 99)),
    89	        totalServed: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.totalServed, 0, 0, 9999999)),
    90	        shopTier: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.shopTier, 0, 0, 99)),
    91	        wave: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.wave, 1, 1, 99)),
    92	        gold: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.gold, 0, 0, 999999)),
    93	        upgrades: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.upgrades, 0, 0, 12)),
    94	        score: Math.floor(finiteNumber(game.score, 0, 0, 9999999))
    95	      };
    96	      localStorage.setItem('slice-rush-save-v1', JSON.stringify(record));
    97	    } catch (error) {
    98	      // Storage is a bonus. The game remains playable when it is unavailable.
    99	    }
   100	  }

   102	  function random() {
   103	    rngState = (rngState * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
   104	    return rngState / 4294967296;
   105	  }

   107	  function choose(list) {
   108	    return list[Math.floor(random() * list.length)];
   109	  }

   111	  function clamp(value, min, max) {
   112	    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
   113	  }

   115	  function roundRect(context, x, y, w, h, radius) {
   116	    var r = Math.min(radius, w / 2, h / 2);
   117	    context.beginPath();
   118	    context.moveTo(x + r, y);
   119	    context.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   120	    context.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   121	    context.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   122	    context.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   123	    context.closePath();
   124	  }

   126	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, weight, align) {
   127	    ctx.fillStyle = color || palette.cream;
   128	    ctx.font = (weight || 600) + ' ' + size + 'px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
   129	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   130	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   131	    ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   132	  }

   134	  function makeGame() {
   135	    var save = safeLoad();
   136	    game = {
   137	      state: 'rush',
   138	      orientationPaused: false,
   139	      wave: save.wave,
   140	      waveTimer: 34,
   141	      waveLength: 34,
   142	      targetCustomers: 5,
   143	      spawned: 0,
   144	      servedThisWave: 0,
   145	      walkouts: 0,
   146	      score: save.score,
   147	      gold: save.gold,
   148	      best: save.best,
   149	      prestige: save.prestige,
   150	      totalServed: save.totalServed,
   151	      shopTier: save.shopTier,
   152	      speed: 1 + save.prestige * 0.12,
   153	      upgrades: save.upgrades,
   154	      selectedStation: 0,
   155	      selectedTable: 0,
   156	      spawnTimer: .8,
   157	      prepProgress: 0,
   158	      ovenProgress: 0,
   159	      prepStock: 0,
   160	      bakedStock: 0,
   161	      plates: [],
   162	      customers: [],
   163	      particles: [],
   164	      floaters: [],
   165	      shake: 0,
   166	      flash: 0,
   167	      elapsed: 0,
   168	      waveMessage: '',
   169	      messageTimer: 0,
   170	      stationPulse: [0, 0, 0],
   171	      keyboardPlate: null,
   172	      keyboardDrag: false
   173	    };
   174	    if (game.upgrades >= upgradeNames.length) game.state = 'prestige';
   175	    clearInputState();
   176	    cancelTimers();
   177	  }

   179	  function resetWave() {
   180	    clearInputState();
   181	    cancelTimers();
   182	    game.state = 'rush';
   183	    game.waveLength = 32 + Math.min(12, game.wave * 1.8);
   184	    game.waveTimer = game.waveLength;
   185	    game.targetCustomers = Math.min(8, 4 + game.wave);
   186	    game.spawned = 0;
   187	    game.servedThisWave = 0;
   188	    game.walkouts = 0;
   189	    game.spawnTimer = .65;
   190	    game.prepProgress = 0;
   191	    game.ovenProgress = 0;
   192	    game.prepStock = 0;
   193	    game.bakedStock = 0;
   194	    game.plates.length = 0;
   195	    game.customers.length = 0;
   196	    game.particles.length = 0;
   197	    game.floaters.length = 0;
   198	    game.shake = 0;
   199	    game.flash = 0;
   200	    game.messageTimer = 0;
   201	  }

   203	  function startFresh() {
   204	    var best = game.best;
   205	    var prestige = game.prestige;
   206	    var totalServed = game.totalServed;
   207	    var shopTier = game.shopTier;
   208	    makeGame();
   209	    game.best = best;
   210	    game.prestige = prestige;
   211	    game.totalServed = totalServed;
   212	    game.shopTier = shopTier;
   213	    game.speed = 1 + prestige * .12;
   214	    resetWave();
   215	    playSound('start');
   216	  }

   218	  function cancelTimers() {
   219	    pendingTimeouts.forEach(function (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); });
   220	    pendingTimeouts.clear();
   221	  }
   222	
   223	  function schedule(callback, delay) {
   224	    var timer = setTimeout(function () {
   225	      pendingTimeouts.delete(timer);
   226	      callback();
   227	    }, delay);
   228	    pendingTimeouts.add(timer);
   229	    return timer;
   230	  }
