   308	  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
   309	  function boot() {
   310	    if (running) return;
   311	    running = true;
   312	    EO.audio.init();
   313	    EO.audio.resume();
   314	    startOv.style.display = 'none';
   315	    G.save = EO.loadSave();
   316	    resize();
   317	    EO.startMap(Math.min(G.save.cleared, EO.MAPS.length - 1));
   318	    last = 0;
   319	    if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
   320	    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   321	  }

   323	  startBtn.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); boot(); }, { passive: false });

   326	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { EO.after(120, resize); });

   329	  G.save = EO.loadSave();
   330	  resize();

     9	  EO.rotFp = function (f, s, dir) {
    10	    switch (dir) {
    11	      case 0: return [s, -f];
    12	      case 1: return [f, s];
    13	      case 2: return [-s, f];
    14	      default: return [-f, -s];
    15	    }

    42	    return null;

    52	  EO.computeMods = function (save) {

    56	      if (!id) continue;
    57	      if (id === 'cache') m.energy += 12;
    58	      else if (id === 'core') m.regen += 1.2;

    60	      else if (id === 'frame') m.hp *= 1.30;
    61	      else if (id === 'kiln') m.cd *= 0.75;
    62	      else if (id === 'rig') m.kill *= 1.40;
    63	    }
    64	    return m;
    65	  };

   110	    if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(id) < 0) return false;

   174	    for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
   175	      var cx = EO.cellX(cells[i][0]), cy = EO.cellY(cells[i][1]);
   176	      if (Math.abs(e.x - cx) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5 && Math.abs(e.y - cy) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5) return true;
   177	    }
   178	    return false;
   179	  }
   180	  function targetsOf(dd) {
   181	    var tgt = dd.def.tgt, out = [];
   182	    if (tgt === 'n') return out;
   183	    for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   184	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   185	      if (e.dead) continue;
   186	      if (tgt === 'g' && e.air) continue;
   187	      if (tgt === 'a' && !e.air) continue;
   188	      if (inFp(dd, e)) out.push(e);
   189	    }
   190	    /* front-most (furthest along) first */
   191	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.prog - a.prog; });
   192	    return out;
   193	  }
   194	
   195	  /* ---------- damage ---------- */
   196	  function hurtEnemy(e, amount, col, crit) {
   197	    if (e.dead) return;
   198	    var arm = e.def.armor * (e.oil > 0 ? 0.5 : 1);
   199	    var dmg = Math.max(1, amount - arm);
   200	    e.hp -= dmg;
   201	    e.flash = 0.12;
   202	    if (Math.random() < 0.45) G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, crit ? 8 : 3, col || '#ffd08a', 70, 2);
   203	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e);
   204	    else EO.sfx.hit();
   205	  }
   206	  function killEnemy(e) {
   207	    if (e.dead) return;
   208	    e.dead = true;
   209	    G.kills++;
   210	    var gain = (1.4 + e.maxhp / 34) * G.mods.kill;
   211	    G.energy += gain;
   212	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 10, e.def.col, 120, 3);
   213	    EO.float(e.x, e.y - 8, '+' + Math.round(gain), '#8fe0a0');
   214	    EO.sfx.die();
   215	  }
   216	  function auraMul(dd) {
   217	    var mul = 1;
   218	    if (dd.brace > 0) mul *= 0.4;
   219	    if (dd.shieldT > 0) mul *= 0.55;
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   221	      var w = G.defs[i];
   222	      if (w === dd || w.def.id !== 'warden' || w.hp <= 0) continue;
   223	      if (Math.abs(w.c - dd.c) <= 1 && Math.abs(w.r - dd.r) <= 1) { mul *= 0.8; break; }
   224	    }
   225	    return mul;
   226	  }
   227	  function hurtDefender(dd, amount) {
   228	    dd.hp -= amount * auraMul(dd);
   229	    dd.flash = 0.14;
   230	    if (dd.hp <= 0) {
   231	      var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   232	      if (i >= 0) G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   233	      if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   234	      G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 14, dd.def.col, 130, 4);
   235	      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6);
   236	      EO.sfx.boom();
   237	    }
   238	  }
   239	
   240	  /* ---------- spawning ---------- */
   241	  function spawnEnemy(type, pathIdx) {
   242	    if (G.enemies.length >= 90) return;
   243	    var base = EO.ENEMIES[type];
   244	    if (!base) return;
   245	    var s = EO.mapScale(G.mapIdx);
   246	    var hp = Math.round(base.hp * s);
   247	    var e = {
   248	      def: base, air: base.air, hp: hp, maxhp: hp, dead: false,
   249	      slow: 0, stun: 0, root: 0, burn: 0, burnT: 0, oil: 0,
   250	      atkCd: 0, tgt: null, flash: 0, prog: 0, kbcd: 0, rage: 0, cc: 0, cr: 0, x: 0, y: 0
   251	    };
   252	    if (base.air) {
   253	      e.x = G.L.ox + EO.rnd(G.L.tile * 0.6, G.L.tile * (EO.COLS - 0.6));
   254	      e.y = G.L.oy - 26 - EO.rnd(0, 40);
   255	      e.gx = EO.cellX(G.gate.c); e.gy = EO.cellY(G.gate.r);
   256	      e.ph = Math.random() * 6.28;
   257	    } else {
   258	      var pi = EO.clamp(pathIdx | 0, 0, G.paths.length - 1);
   259	      e.path = G.paths[pi]; e.seg = 0; e.u = 0;
   260	      e.x = EO.cellX(e.path[0].c); e.y = EO.cellY(e.path[0].r);
   261	    }
   262	    G.enemies.push(e);
   263	  }
   264	
   265	  function updateSpawner(dt) {
   266	    if (G.state !== 'prep' && G.state !== 'wave') return;
   267	    if (G.state === 'prep') {
   268	      G.prepT -= dt;
   269	      if (G.prepT <= 0) {
   270	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) return;
   271	        var w = G.waves[G.waveIdx];
   272	        G.queue.length = 0;
   273	        for (var i = 0; i < w.groups.length; i++) {
   274	          var g = w.groups[i];
   275	          for (var n = 0; n < g.count; n++) {
   276	            G.queue.push({ t: g.delay + n * g.gap, type: g.type, path: g.path });
   277	          }
   278	        }
   279	        G.queue.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
   280	        if (G.queue.length > 200) G.queue.length = 200;
   281	        G.state = 'wave'; G.waveActive = true;
   282	        EO.audio.tone(300, 0.1, 'square', 0.16, 420);
   283	      }
   284	      return;
   285	    }
   286	    /* wave */
   287	    for (var q = 0; q < G.queue.length; q++) G.queue[q].t -= dt;
   288	    while (G.queue.length && G.queue[0].t <= 0) {
   289	      var s = G.queue.shift();
   290	      spawnEnemy(s.type, s.path);
   291	    }
   292	    if (!G.queue.length) {
   293	      var alive = 0;
   294	      for (var e = 0; e < G.enemies.length; e++) if (!G.enemies[e].dead) alive++;
   295	      if (alive === 0) {
   296	        G.waveIdx++;
   297	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) { winMap(); }
   298	        else { G.state = 'prep'; G.prepT = G.waves[G.waveIdx].prep; G.energy += 6; EO.float(G.L.w * 0.5, G.L.oy + 30, 'WAVE CLEAR +6', '#8fe0a0'); }
   299	      }
   300	    }
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  /* ---------- enemy update ---------- */
   304	  function updateEnemies(dt) {
   305	    var t = G.L.tile;
   306	    for (var i = G.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   307	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   308	      if (e.dead) { G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   309	      if (e.flash > 0) e.flash -= dt;
   310	      if (e.slow > 0) e.slow -= dt;
   311	      if (e.kbcd > 0) e.kbcd -= dt;
   312	      if (e.oil > 0) e.oil -= dt;
   313	      if (e.stun > 0) e.stun -= dt;
   314	      if (e.root > 0) e.root -= dt;
   315	      if (e.burnT > 0) {
   316	        e.burnT -= dt;
   317	        e.hp -= e.burn * dt;
   318	        if (Math.random() < dt * 8) G.parts.add(e.x + EO.rnd(-5, 5), e.y, 0, -30, 0.3, '#ff9a3c', 3, -20);
   319	        if (e.hp <= 0) { killEnemy(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   320	      }
   321	      if (e.stun > 0) continue;
   322	
   323	      var spdMul = (e.slow > 0 ? 0.55 : 1);
   324	
   325	      if (e.air) {
   326	        var dx = e.gx - e.x, dy = e.gy - e.y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
   327	        var sp = e.def.spd * t * spdMul;
   328	        e.ph += dt * 3;
   329	        e.x += (dx / d) * sp * dt + Math.cos(e.ph) * 22 * dt;
   330	        e.y += (dy / d) * sp * dt;
   331	        e.prog = 1 - d / 900;
   332	        if (d < t * 0.5) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   333	        continue;
   334	      }
   335	
   336	      /* ground: current cell + orthogonally adjacent defenders */
   337	      var cA = e.path[e.seg], cB = e.path[Math.min(e.seg + 1, e.path.length - 1)];
   338	      var near = (e.u < 0.5) ? cA : cB;
   339	      e.cc = near.c; e.cr = near.r;
   340	      if (!e.tgt || e.tgt.hp <= 0 || G.defs.indexOf(e.tgt) < 0) {
   341	        e.tgt = null; e.rage = 0;
   342	        var anchorFound = null;
   343	        for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   344	          var dd = EO.defAt(e.cc + EO.DIRS[k][0], e.cr + EO.DIRS[k][1]);
   345	          if (!dd) continue;
   346	          if (dd.def.id === 'anchor') { anchorFound = dd; break; }
   347	          if (!e.tgt) e.tgt = dd;
   348	        }
   349	        if (anchorFound) e.tgt = anchorFound;
   350	      }
   351	
   352	      if (e.tgt && e.def.dmg > 0) {
   353	        e.atkCd -= dt;
   354	        /* rage: a stalled attacker hits harder so no fight can stalemate forever */
   355	        e.rage = (e.rage || 0) + dt;
   356	        if (e.atkCd <= 0) {
   357	          e.atkCd = 1 / e.def.arate;
   358	          hurtDefender(e.tgt, e.def.dmg * (1 + 0.13 * G.mapIdx) * (1 + Math.min(2.5, e.rage * 0.13)));
   359	          shot(e.x, e.y, EO.cellX(e.tgt.c), EO.cellY(e.tgt.r), '#e05f5f', 1);
   360	        }
   361	        continue;
   362	      }
   363	
   364	      if (e.root > 0) continue;
   365	
   366	      /* advance along path */
   367	      var move = e.def.spd * spdMul * dt;
   368	      while (move > 0 && e.seg < e.path.length - 1) {
   369	        var need = 1 - e.u;
   370	        if (move >= need) { move -= need; e.seg++; e.u = 0; }
   371	        else { e.u += move; move = 0; }
   372	      }
   373	      if (e.seg >= e.path.length - 1) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   374	      var a = e.path[e.seg], b = e.path[e.seg + 1];
   375	      e.x = EO.lerp(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellX(b.c), e.u);
   376	      e.y = EO.lerp(EO.cellY(a.r), EO.cellY(b.r), e.u);
   377	      e.prog = (e.seg + e.u) / e.path.length;
   378	    }
   379	    if (G.enemies.length > 90) G.enemies.splice(0, G.enemies.length - 90);
   380	  }
   381	
   382	  function leak(e) {
   383	    G.leaks += e.def.leak;
   384	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 9);
   385	    G.flashT = 0.25;
   386	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 14, '#e05f5f', 150, 4);
   387	    EO.float(e.x, G.L.oy + G.L.tile * EO.ROWS - 14, '-' + e.def.leak, '#e05f5f');
   388	    EO.sfx.leak();
   389	    if (G.leaks >= G.leakCap) loseMap();
   390	  }
   391	
   392	  /* ---------- defender update ---------- */
   393	  function updateDefs(dt) {
   394	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   395	      var dd = G.defs[i], d = dd.def;
   396	      if (dd.flash > 0) dd.flash -= dt;
   397	      if (dd.born > 0) dd.born -= dt;
   398	      if (dd.brace > 0) dd.brace -= dt;
   399	      if (dd.shieldT > 0) dd.shieldT -= dt;
   400	      if (dd.skcd > 0) dd.skcd -= dt;
   401	      dd.pulse += dt;
   402	      if (d.id === 'scout') G.energy += 0.45 * dt;
   403	
   404	      dd.cd -= dt;
   405	      if (dd.burst > 0) {
   406	        dd.burstT -= dt;
   407	        if (dd.burstT <= 0) { dd.burst--; dd.burstT = 0.16; fire(dd, 1.0); }
   408	      }
   409	      if (dd.cd > 0) continue;
   410	
   411	      if (d.kind === 'heal') {
   412	        var healed = false;
   413	        var cells = EO.fpCells(dd);
   414	        for (var c = 0; c < cells.length; c++) {
   415	          var t2 = EO.defAt(cells[c][0], cells[c][1]);
   416	          if (t2 && t2.hp < t2.maxhp) {
   417	            t2.hp = Math.min(t2.maxhp, t2.hp + 14);
   418	            G.parts.add(EO.cellX(t2.c), EO.cellY(t2.r) - 6, EO.rnd(-14, 14), -34, 0.5, '#8fe0a0', 3, -8);
   419	            healed = true;
   420	          }
   421	        }
   422	        dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   423	        if (healed) EO.audio.tone(760, 0.05, 'sine', 0.05);
   424	        continue;
   425	      }
   426	      var tg = targetsOf(dd);
   427	      if (!tg.length) { dd.cd = 0.08; continue; }
   428	      dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   429	      fire(dd, 1.0, tg);
   430	    }
   431	  }
   432	
   433	  function fire(dd, mul, tg) {
   434	    var d = dd.def;
   435	    tg = tg || targetsOf(dd);
   436	    if (!tg.length) return;
   437	    var sx = EO.cellX(dd.c), sy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   438	    var dmg = d.dmg * mul;
   439	    if (d.kind === 'melee' || d.kind === 'single') {
   440	      var e = tg[0];
   441	      hurtEnemy(e, dmg, d.col, mul > 1.5);
   442	      shot(sx, sy, e.x, e.y, d.col, d.kind === 'single' ? 2 : 0);
   443	    } else if (d.kind === 'pierce') {
   444	      for (var i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], dmg, d.col); }
   445	      var lastp = tg[tg.length - 1];
   446	      shot(sx, sy, lastp.x, lastp.y, d.col, 2);
   447	    } else if (d.kind === 'chain') {
   448	      for (var j = 0; j < Math.min(3, tg.length); j++) {
   449	        hurtEnemy(tg[j], dmg, d.col);
   450	        shot(j === 0 ? sx : tg[j - 1].x, j === 0 ? sy : tg[j - 1].y, tg[j].x, tg[j].y, d.col, 3);
   451	      }
   452	    } else if (d.kind === 'splash') {
   453	      var c0 = tg[0];
   454	      var rad = G.L.tile * 0.85;
   455	      for (var k = 0; k < tg.length; k++) {
   456	        if (EO.dist2(tg[k].x, tg[k].y, c0.x, c0.y) <= rad * rad) hurtEnemy(tg[k], dmg, d.col);
   457	      }
   458	      G.parts.burst(c0.x, c0.y, 8, '#ffb454', 110, 3);
   459	      shot(sx, sy, c0.x, c0.y, d.col, 4);
   460	      EO.audio.tone(180, 0.08, 'sine', 0.09, 90);
   461	      return;
   462	    } else if (d.kind === 'slow') {
   463	      for (var m = 0; m < tg.length; m++) {
   464	        hurtEnemy(tg[m], dmg, d.col);
   465	        tg[m].slow = 1.2; tg[m].oil = 4.0;
   466	      }
   467	      return;
   468	    } else if (d.kind === 'shove') {
   469	      for (var n = 0; n < tg.length; n++) {
   470	        var e2 = tg[n];
   471	        hurtEnemy(e2, dmg, d.col);
   472	        /* knockback is rate-limited so nothing can be shoved in place forever */
   473	        if (!e2.air && (e2.kbcd || 0) <= 0) {
   474	          e2.kbcd = 1.1;
   475	          var back = 0.5;
   476	          while (back > 0) {
   477	            if (e2.u >= back) { e2.u -= back; back = 0; }
   478	            else if (e2.seg > 0) { back -= e2.u; e2.seg--; e2.u = 1; }
   479	            else { e2.u = 0; back = 0; }
   480	          }
   481	        }
   482	      }
   483	      shot(sx, sy, tg[0].x, tg[0].y, d.col, 0);
   484	    }
   485	    EO.sfx.shot();
   486	  }
   487	
   488	  /* ---------- skills ---------- */
   489	  EO.useSkill = function (dd) {
   490	    if (!dd || dd.skcd > 0) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   491	    var d = dd.def;
   492	    dd.skcd = d.skill.cd * G.mods.cd;
   493	    var tg = targetsOf(dd), i;
   494	    var cx = EO.cellX(dd.c), cy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   495	    G.parts.burst(cx, cy, 14, d.col, 150, 4);
   496	    EO.sfx.skill();
   497	    EO.float(cx, cy - 18, d.skill.name, d.col);
   498	    switch (d.id) {
   499	      case 'blocker':
   500	        dd.hp = Math.min(dd.maxhp, dd.hp + dd.maxhp * 0.4); dd.brace = 4; break;
   501	      case 'pike':
   502	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 3, d.col, true);
   503	        break;
   504	      case 'arcer':
   505	        dd.burst = 4; dd.burstT = 0.05; break;
   506	      case 'sparker':
   507	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 1.5, d.col, true); tg[i].stun = 1.6; }
   508	        break;
   509	      case 'medic':
   510	        for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   511	          var a = G.defs[i];
   512	          a.hp = Math.min(a.maxhp, a.hp + a.maxhp * 0.35);
   513	          G.parts.add(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellY(a.r), EO.rnd(-20, 20), -50, 0.6, '#8fe0a0', 3, -10);
   514	        }
   515	        break;
   516	      case 'sniper':
   517	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 4, d.col, true);
   518	        if (tg.length) shot(cx, cy, tg[tg.length - 1].x, tg[tg.length - 1].y, '#ffffff', 2);
   519	        break;
   520	      case 'oiler':
   521	        for (i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   522	          var e = G.enemies[i];
   523	          if (e.oil > 0 && !e.dead) { e.burn = 14; e.burnT = 3; }
   524	        }
   525	        break;
   526	      case 'warden':
   527	        for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) G.defs[i].shieldT = 5;
   528	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) {
   529	          var e3 = tg[i];
   530	          hurtEnemy(e3, d.dmg * 2, d.col);
   531	          if (!e3.air) { var bk = 1.2; while (bk > 0) { if (e3.u >= bk) { e3.u -= bk; bk = 0; } else if (e3.seg > 0) { bk -= e3.u; e3.seg--; e3.u = 1; } else { e3.u = 0; bk = 0; } } }
   532	        }
   533	        break;
   534	      case 'scout':
   535	        G.energy += 16; EO.float(cx, cy - 30, '+16', '#8fe0a0'); break;
   536	      case 'anchor':
   537	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) if (!tg[i].air) tg[i].root = 2.6;
   538	        break;
   539	    }
   540	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 4);
   541	    return true;
   542	  };
   543	
   544	  /* ---------- end states ---------- */
   545	  function winMap() {
   546	    G.state = 'won';
   547	    var timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.round(1200 - G.time * 4));
   548	    G.score = G.kills * 12 + (G.leakCap - G.leaks) * 140 + timeBonus;
   549	    var first = (G.save.cleared === G.mapIdx);
   550	    var mats = EO.matsFor(G.mapIdx, first);
   551	    G.save.mats.scrap = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.scrap + mats.scrap);
   552	    G.save.mats.ember = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.ember + mats.ember);
   553	    G.save.mats.alloy = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.alloy + mats.alloy);
   554	    var newDefs = [];
   555	    if (first) {
   556	      G.save.cleared = G.mapIdx + 1;
   557	      var ul = EO.UNLOCKS[G.mapIdx] || [];
   558	      for (var i = 0; i < ul.length; i++) {
   559	        if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(ul[i]) < 0) { G.save.unlocked.push(ul[i]); newDefs.push(ul[i]); }
   560	      }
   561	    }
   562	    var key = 'm' + G.mapIdx;
   563	    var rec = false;
   564	    if (!G.save.best[key] || G.score > G.save.best[key]) { G.save.best[key] = G.score; rec = true; }
   565	    EO.writeSave(G.save);
   566	    G.resultInfo = { win: true, mats: mats, newDefs: newDefs, record: rec, final: (G.mapIdx === EO.MAPS.length - 1) };
   567	    G.shake = 8;
   568	    EO.sfx.win();
   569	    EO.after(700, function () { if (G.state === 'won') G.screen = 'result'; });
   570	  }
   571	  function loseMap() {
   572	    if (G.state === 'lost') return;
   573	    G.state = 'lost';
   574	    G.score = G.kills * 12;
   575	    G.resultInfo = { win: false, mats: null, newDefs: [], record: false, final: false };
   576	    G.shake = 14;
   577	    EO.sfx.lose();
   578	    EO.after(800, function () { if (G.state === 'lost') G.screen = 'result'; });
   579	  }
   580	  EO.winMap = winMap;
   581	
   582	  /* ---------- main update ---------- */
   583	  EO.update = function (dt) {
   584	    if (G.screen !== 'play') { if (G.parts) G.parts.update(dt); return; }
   585	    if (G.paused) return;
   586	    var sdt = dt * G.speed;
   587	    if (G.state === 'prep' || G.state === 'wave') {
   588	      G.time += sdt;
   589	      G.energy += G.regen * sdt;
   590	      if (G.energy > 999) G.energy = 999;
   591	      updateSpawner(sdt);
   592	      updateEnemies(sdt);
   593	      updateDefs(sdt);
   594	    } else {
   595	      updateEnemies(sdt * 0.35);
   596	    }
   597	    /* shots */
   598	    for (var i = G.shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   599	      G.shots[i].t -= dt;
   600	      if (G.shots[i].t <= 0) G.shots.splice(i, 1);
   601	    }
   602	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   603	      var fl = G.floats[f];
   604	      fl.t -= dt; fl.y -= 26 * dt;
   605	      if (fl.t <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   606	    }
   607	    G.parts.update(dt);
   608	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   609	    if (G.flashT > 0) G.flashT -= dt;
   610	  };

    11	    r = Math.min(r, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);

   318	  function drawPlay(g) {

   320	    g.save();
   321	    if (G.shake > 0) g.translate(EO.rnd(-G.shake, G.shake) * 0.5, EO.rnd(-G.shake, G.shake) * 0.5);

   324	    for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) drawDefender(g, G.defs[i]);
   325	    for (i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) if (!G.enemies[i].air) drawEnemy(g, G.enemies[i]);
   326	    for (i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) if (G.enemies[i].air) drawEnemy(g, G.enemies[i]);
   327	    drawShots(g);
   328	    G.parts.draw(g);
   329	    for (i = 0; i < G.floats.length; i++) {
   330	      var f = G.floats[i];
   331	      g.globalAlpha = EO.clamp(f.t / f.mt, 0, 1);
   332	      txt(g, f.s, f.x, f.y, 12, f.c, 'center', '800');
   333	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   334	    }
   335	    g.restore();
   336

   413	  function drawBase(g) {
   414	    var L = G.L, w = L.w, S = G.save;
   415	    g.fillStyle = BG; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, L.h);
   416	    txt(g, 'OUTPOST WORKSHOP', w * 0.5, 34, 18, HL, 'center', '800');
   417	    txt(g, 'Craft deploy kits from salvage. Kits apply to every map.', w * 0.5, 55, 10, DIM, 'center', '600');
   418	    txt(g, 'SCRAP ' + S.mats.scrap + '    EMBER ' + S.mats.ember + '    ALLOY ' + S.mats.alloy, w * 0.5, 76, 12, '#e2c46a', 'center', '800');
   419	
   420	    U.slots.length = 0;
   421	    var n = EO.slotsUnlocked(S.cleared);
   422	    var sw = (w - 10 - 3 * 6) / 4, sh = 58, sy = 94;
   423	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   424	      var x = 5 + i * (sw + 6);
   425	      var open = i < n;
   426	      var kid = S.kits[i], kit = kid ? EO.KIT_BY_ID[kid] : null;
   427	      U.slots.push({ id: 'slot', idx: i, x: x, y: sy, w: sw, h: sh, open: open });
   428	      rr(g, x, sy, sw, sh, 7);
   429	      g.fillStyle = (EO.baseSlot === i && open) ? '#2a323d' : '#1b222b'; g.fill();
   430	      g.lineWidth = 2;
   431	      g.strokeStyle = !open ? '#39434f' : (EO.baseSlot === i ? HL : (kit ? '#8fe0a0' : '#39434f'));
   432	      g.globalAlpha = open ? 1 : 0.4;
   433	      g.stroke();
   434	      if (!open) {
   435	        txt(g, 'LOCKED', x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.42, 9, DIM, 'center', '700');
   436	        txt(g, 'CLEAR ' + (i === 1 ? 2 : i === 2 ? 4 : 6), x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.66, 8.5, DIM, 'center', '600');
   437	      } else if (kit) {
   438	        var parts = kit.name.split(' ');
   439	        txt(g, parts[0], x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.36, 9.5, '#8fe0a0', 'center', '800');
   440	        txt(g, parts[1] || '', x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.58, 9.5, '#8fe0a0', 'center', '800');
   441	        txt(g, 'SLOT ' + (i + 1), x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.82, 8, DIM, 'center', '600');
   442	      } else {
   443	        txt(g, 'EMPTY', x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.42, 10, DIM, 'center', '700');
   444	        txt(g, 'SLOT ' + (i + 1), x + sw * 0.5, sy + sh * 0.68, 8, DIM, 'center', '600');
   445	      }
   446	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   447	    }
   448	    txt(g, 'TAP A SLOT, THEN A KIT TO FIT IT', w * 0.5, sy + sh + 14, 9.5, HL, 'center', '800');
   449	
   450	    U.recipes.length = 0;
   451	    var ry = sy + sh + 28;
   452	    var rh = EO.clamp((L.h - ry - 68) / EO.KITS.length - 6, 42, 56);
   453	    for (var k = 0; k < EO.KITS.length; k++) {
   454	      var kt = EO.KITS[k];

   457	      var afford = S.mats.scrap >= kt.cost.scrap && S.mats.ember >= kt.cost.ember && S.mats.alloy >= kt.cost.alloy;
   458	      U.recipes.push({ id: 'recipe', idx: k, kitId: kt.id, x: 5, y: y, w: w - 10, h: rh, afford: afford, equipped: equipped });
   459	      rr(g, 5, y, w - 10, rh, 7);
   460	      g.fillStyle = '#1b222b'; g.fill();

   462	      g.globalAlpha = (afford || equipped) ? 1 : 0.5;
   463	      g.stroke();
   464	      txt(g, kt.name, 14, y + rh * 0.27, 12, equipped ? '#8fe0a0' : INK, 'left', '800');
   465	      txt(g, kt.desc, 14, y + rh * 0.57, 9.5, DIM, 'left', '600');

   468	      if (kt.cost.alloy) costs += '  ' + kt.cost.alloy + ' ALLOY';
   469	      txt(g, equipped ? 'FITTED' : costs, 14, y + rh * 0.84, 9, equipped ? '#8fe0a0' : (afford ? '#e2c46a' : '#e05f5f'), 'left', '700');
   470	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   471	    }
   472	    var by = ry + EO.KITS.length * (rh + 6) + 4;
   473	    if (by > L.h - 60) by = L.h - 60;
   474	    var b = { id: 'back', x: w * 0.5 - 120, y: by, w: 240, h: 52, label: 'BACK TO MAPS', primary: true };
   475	    U.btns.push(b); button(g, b);
   476	  }

   478	  /* ---------- map select ---------- */
   479	  function drawMaps(g) {
   480	    var L = G.L, w = L.w, S = G.save;
   481	    g.fillStyle = BG; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, L.h);
   482	    txt(g, 'EMBERLINE OUTPOST', w * 0.5, 32, 19, HL, 'center', '800');
   483	    txt(g, 'MAPS HELD ' + S.cleared + '/8   ·   DEFENDERS ' + S.unlocked.length + '/10', w * 0.5, 53, 10.5, DIM, 'center', '700');
   484	
   485	    U.mapBtns.length = 0;
   486	    var cols = 2, bw = (w - 10 - 6) / cols, bh = 56, top = 74;
   487	    for (var i = 0; i < EO.MAPS.length; i++) {
   488	      var cx = i % cols, cy = Math.floor(i / cols);
   489	      var x = 5 + cx * (bw + 6), y = top + cy * (bh + 7);
   490	      var open = i <= S.cleared;
   491	      var best = S.best['m' + i] || 0;
   492	      U.mapBtns.push({ id: 'map', idx: i, x: x, y: y, w: bw, h: bh, open: open });
   493	      rr(g, x, y, bw, bh, 7);
   494	      g.fillStyle = open ? '#1b222b' : '#141a22'; g.fill();
   495	      g.lineWidth = 2; g.strokeStyle = open ? (i === S.cleared ? HL : '#39434f') : '#232c37';
   496	      g.globalAlpha = open ? 1 : 0.45; g.stroke();
   497	      txt(g, (i + 1) + '. ' + EO.MAPS[i].name, x + 10, y + 18, 12, open ? INK : DIM, 'left', '800');
   498	      if (open) txt(g, best ? 'BEST ' + best : 'NOT YET HELD', x + 10, y + 36, 9.5, best ? '#8fe0a0' : DIM, 'left', '600');
   499	      else txt(g, 'LOCKED', x + 10, y + 36, 9.5, DIM, 'left', '600');
   500	      if (open) txt(g, EO.MAPS[i].waves + ' WAVES · LEAK CAP ' + EO.MAPS[i].leak, x + 10, y + 49, 8.5, DIM, 'left', '600');
   501	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   502	    }
   503	    var by = top + Math.ceil(EO.MAPS.length / cols) * (bh + 7) + 6;
   504	    var b1 = { id: 'base', x: 5, y: by, w: (w - 16) * 0.5, h: 52, label: 'WORKSHOP', fs: 13 };
   505	    U.btns.push(b1); button(g, b1);
   506	    var b2 = { id: 'playsel', x: 5 + (w - 16) * 0.5 + 6, y: by, w: (w - 16) * 0.5, h: 52, label: 'DEPLOY', primary: true, fs: 13 };
   507	    U.btns.push(b2); button(g, b2);
   508	
   509	    /* roster */
   510	    var ry = by + 62;
   511	    txt(g, 'ROSTER', w * 0.5, ry, 10, DIM, 'center', '700');
   512	    ry += 16;
   513	    var pw = (w - 12) / 5;
   514	    for (var d = 0; d < EO.DEFS.length; d++) {
   515	      var dd = EO.DEFS[d], has = S.unlocked.indexOf(dd.id) >= 0;
   516	      var px = 6 + (d % 5) * pw, py = ry + Math.floor(d / 5) * 34;
   517	      g.globalAlpha = has ? 1 : 0.28;
   518	      g.fillStyle = dd.col;
   519	      rr(g, px + pw * 0.5 - 11, py, 22, 22, 4); g.fill();
   520	      txt(g, dd.ab, px + pw * 0.5, py + 11, 9, '#12161c', 'center', '800');
   521	      txt(g, has ? dd.name : 'LOCKED', px + pw * 0.5, py + 28, 7.5, has ? DIM : '#4d5762', 'center', '700');
   522	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   523	    }
   524	  }
   525	
   526	  /* ---------- entry ---------- */
   527	  EO.render = function (g) {
   528	    var L = G.L;
   529	    U.btns.length = 0;
   530	    g.fillStyle = BG;
   531	    g.fillRect(0, 0, L.w, L.h);
   532	    if (G.screen === 'play') drawPlay(g);
   533	    else if (G.screen === 'result') drawResult(g);
   534	    else if (G.screen === 'base') drawBase(g);
   535	    else drawMaps(g);
   536	  };

   160	  /* expand waypoints into an orthogonal list of cells */
   161	  EO.expandPath = function (wps) {
   162	    var cells = [], i, c, cur = wps[0].slice();
   163	    cells.push(cur.slice());
   164	    for (i = 1; i < wps.length; i++) {
   165	      var tgt = wps[i];
   166	      while (cur[0] !== tgt[0] || cur[1] !== tgt[1]) {
   167	        if (cur[0] !== tgt[0]) cur[0] += (tgt[0] > cur[0]) ? 1 : -1;
   168	        else cur[1] += (tgt[1] > cur[1]) ? 1 : -1;
   169	        cells.push(cur.slice());
   170	        if (cells.length > 200) return cells;
   171	      }
   172	    }
   173	    return cells;
   174	  };
   175	
   176	  /* ---------- wave generation (deterministic per map) ---------- */
   177	  EO.buildWaves = function (mi) {
   178	    var m = EO.MAPS[mi], rng = EO.seeded(9137 + mi * 7717), out = [], w, np = m.paths.length;
   179	    /* [type, first map it can appear, first wave it can appear] */
   180	    var roster = [
   181	      ['runner', 0, 0], ['grunt', 0, 0], ['swarm', 1, 1], ['flyer', 2, 2],
   182	      ['shell', 3, 3], ['brute', 2, 4], ['bomber', 4, 5]
   183	    ];
   184	    for (w = 0; w < m.waves; w++) {
   185	      var pool = [];
   186	      for (var q = 0; q < roster.length; q++) if (mi >= roster[q][1] && w >= roster[q][2]) pool.push(roster[q][0]);
   187	      var groups = [], gcount = 1 + Math.floor(w / 3) + (rng() < 0.4 ? 1 : 0);
   188	      if (gcount > 3) gcount = 3;
   189	      var budget = (24 + w * 16) * (1 + 0.11 * mi) * (np > 1 ? 0.84 : 1), airUsed = 0;
   190	      for (var g = 0; g < gcount; g++) {
   191	        var t = pool[Math.floor(rng() * pool.length)];
   192	        /* at most one airborne group per wave */
   193	        if (EO.ENEMIES[t].air) { if (airUsed) t = (rng() < 0.5) ? 'runner' : 'grunt'; else airUsed = 1; }
   194	        if (w === 0) t = (g === 0) ? 'runner' : 'grunt';
   195	        if (w === 1 && mi === 0) t = (g === 0) ? 'grunt' : 'runner';
   196	        var e = EO.ENEMIES[t];
   197	        var share = budget / gcount;
   198	        var n = Math.max(2, Math.round(share / (e.hp * 0.36)));
   199	        if (n > 14) n = 14;
   200	        groups.push({
   201	          type: t, count: n,
   202	          gap: e.air ? 0.55 : (0.75 - Math.min(0.3, w * 0.03)),
   203	          delay: g * (1.6 + rng() * 1.4),
   204	          path: Math.floor(rng() * np)
   205	        });
   206	      }
   207	      /* every third wave from map 3 onward gets an air flight */
   208	      if (mi >= 2 && (w % 3 === 2)) {
   209	        groups.push({ type: (mi >= 4 && w > 4) ? 'bomber' : 'flyer', count: Math.min(6, 3 + Math.floor(w / 4)), gap: 0.5, delay: 3.4, path: 0 });
   210	      }
   211	      out.push({ groups: groups, prep: (w === 0) ? 6.0 : 3.6 });
   212	      if (out.length >= 14) break;
   213	    }
   214	    return out;
   215	  };
   216	
   217	  /* enemy stat scale per map */
   218	  EO.mapScale = function (mi) { return 1 + 0.11 * mi; };
   219	
   220	  EO.matsFor = function (mi, first) {
   221	    var f = first ? 1 : 0.4;
   222	    return {
   223	      scrap: Math.round((22 + mi * 9) * f),
   224	      ember: mi >= 1 ? Math.round((4 + mi * 2.4) * f) : 0,
   225	      alloy: mi >= 3 ? Math.round((3 + (mi - 3) * 2.2) * f) : 0
   226	    };
   227	  };

    62	      else if (id === 'rig') m.kill *= 1.40;
    63	    }
    64	    return m;
    65	  };

    67	  /* ---------- start a map ---------- */
    68	  EO.startMap = function (mi) {
    69	    EO.clearTimers();
    70	    mi = EO.clamp(mi | 0, 0, EO.MAPS.length - 1);
    71	    var m = EO.MAPS[mi];
    72	    G.mapIdx = mi;
    73	    G.screen = 'play'; G.state = 'prep';
    74	    G.defs.length = 0; G.enemies.length = 0; G.shots.length = 0; G.floats.length = 0;
    75	    if (!G.parts) G.parts = new EO.Particles(); else G.parts.clear();
    76	    G.mods = EO.computeMods(G.save);
    77	    G.energy = m.energy + G.mods.energy;
    78	    G.regen = m.regen + G.mods.regen;
    79	    G.leaks = 0; G.leakCap = m.leak + G.mods.leak;
    80	    G.waves = EO.buildWaves(mi);
    81	    G.waveIdx = 0; G.queue.length = 0; G.waveActive = false;
    82	    G.prepT = G.waves.length ? G.waves[0].prep : 3;
    83	    G.time = 0; G.kills = 0; G.score = 0;
    84	    G.best = (G.save.best && G.save.best['m' + mi]) || 0;
    85	    G.shake = 0; G.flashT = 0; G.sel = null;
    86	    G.speed = 1; G.paused = false;
    87	    G.hint = !G.save.seen;
    88	    G.trayPage = 0; G.cursor.c = 3; G.cursor.r = EO.ROWS - 2; G.kbDir = 0; G.kbCard = 0;
    89	
    90	    /* paths */
    91	    G.paths = [];
    92	    G.pathSet = {};
    93	    for (var p = 0; p < m.paths.length; p++) {
    94	      var cells = EO.expandPath(m.paths[p]);
    95	      var pts = [];
    96	      for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    97	        pts.push({ c: cells[i][0], r: cells[i][1] });
    98	        G.pathSet[cells[i][0] + ',' + cells[i][1]] = 1;
    99	      }
   100	      G.paths.push(pts);
   101	    }
   102	    var last = G.paths[0][G.paths[0].length - 1];
   103	    G.gate = { c: last.c, r: last.r };
   104	  };

   106	  /* ---------- placement ---------- */
   107	  EO.placeDefender = function (id, c, r, dir) {
   108	    var d = EO.DEF_BY_ID[id];
   109	    if (!d) return false;
   110	    if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(id) < 0) return false;
   111	    if (!EO.buildable(c, r)) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   112	    if (G.energy < d.cost) { EO.sfx.deny(); EO.float(EO.cellX(c), EO.cellY(r), 'NO CHARGE', '#e05f5f'); return false; }
   113	    if (G.defs.length >= 40) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   114	    G.energy -= d.cost;
   115	    var hp = Math.round(d.hp * G.mods.hp);
   116	    G.defs.push({
   117	      def: d, c: c, r: r, dir: dir & 3, hp: hp, maxhp: hp,
   118	      cd: 0, skcd: 0, flash: 0, burst: 0, brace: 0, shieldT: 0, born: 0.35, pulse: 0
   119	    });
   120	    EO.sfx.place();
   121	    G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(c), EO.cellY(r), 10, d.col, 90, 3);
   122	    G.hint = false;
   123	    if (!G.save.seen) { G.save.seen = 1; EO.writeSave(G.save); }
   124	    return true;
   125	  };

   127	  EO.recycle = function (dd) {
   128	    var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   129	    if (i < 0) return;
   130	    G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   131	    G.energy += Math.round(dd.def.cost * 0.5);
   132	    G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 10, '#9aa6b2', 80, 3);
   133	    EO.sfx.ui();
   134	    if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   135	  };

   138	    if (G.floats.length >= 30) G.floats.shift();
   139	    G.floats.push({ x: x, y: y, t: 0.85, mt: 0.85, s: txt, c: col || '#e8e2d4' });

   141	  function shot(x, y, tx, ty, col, type) {
   142	    if (G.shots.length >= 90) G.shots.shift();
   143	    G.shots.push({ x: x, y: y, tx: tx, ty: ty, t: 0.16, mt: 0.16, c: col, k: type || 0 });

   146	  /* ---------- footprint helpers ---------- */
   147	  EO.fpCells = function (dd) {
   148	    var out = [], fp = dd.def.fp;
   149	    for (var i = 0; i < fp.length; i++) {
   150	      var o = EO.rotFp(fp[i][0], fp[i][1], dd.dir);
   151	      var c = dd.c + o[0], r = dd.r + o[1];
   152	      if (c >= 0 && r >= 0 && c < EO.COLS && r < EO.ROWS) out.push([c, r]);
   153	    }
   154	    return out;
   155	  };
   156	  EO.fpPreview = function (id, c, r, dir) {
   157	    var d = EO.DEF_BY_ID[id]; if (!d) return [];
   158	    var out = [];
   159	    for (var i = 0; i < d.fp.length; i++) {
   160	      var o = EO.rotFp(d.fp[i][0], d.fp[i][1], dir);
   161	      var cc = c + o[0], rr = r + o[1];
   162	      if (cc >= 0 && rr >= 0 && cc < EO.COLS && rr < EO.ROWS) out.push([cc, rr]);
   163	    }
   164	    return out;
   165	  };
   166	
   167	  function inFp(dd, e) {
   168	    var cells = EO.fpCells(dd), i;
   169	    if (!e.air) {
   170	      for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) if (cells[i][0] === e.cc && cells[i][1] === e.cr) return true;
   171	      return false;
   172	    }
   173	    var t = G.L.tile;
   174	    for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
   175	      var cx = EO.cellX(cells[i][0]), cy = EO.cellY(cells[i][1]);
   176	      if (Math.abs(e.x - cx) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5 && Math.abs(e.y - cy) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5) return true;
   177	    }
   178	    return false;
   179	  }
   180	  function targetsOf(dd) {
   181	    var tgt = dd.def.tgt, out = [];
   182	    if (tgt === 'n') return out;
   183	    for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   184	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   185	      if (e.dead) continue;
   186	      if (tgt === 'g' && e.air) continue;
   187	      if (tgt === 'a' && !e.air) continue;
   188	      if (inFp(dd, e)) out.push(e);
   189	    }
   190	    /* front-most (furthest along) first */
   191	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.prog - a.prog; });
   192	    return out;
   193	  }

   195	  /* ---------- damage ---------- */
   196	  function hurtEnemy(e, amount, col, crit) {
   197	    if (e.dead) return;
   198	    var arm = e.def.armor * (e.oil > 0 ? 0.5 : 1);
   199	    var dmg = Math.max(1, amount - arm);
   200	    e.hp -= dmg;
   201	    e.flash = 0.12;
   202	    if (Math.random() < 0.45) G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, crit ? 8 : 3, col || '#ffd08a', 70, 2);
   203	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e);
   204	    else EO.sfx.hit();
   205	  }
   206	  function killEnemy(e) {
   207	    if (e.dead) return;
   208	    e.dead = true;
   209	    G.kills++;
   210	    var gain = (1.4 + e.maxhp / 34) * G.mods.kill;
   211	    G.energy += gain;
   212	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 10, e.def.col, 120, 3);
   213	    EO.float(e.x, e.y - 8, '+' + Math.round(gain), '#8fe0a0');
   214	    EO.sfx.die();
   215	  }
   216	  function auraMul(dd) {
   217	    var mul = 1;
   218	    if (dd.brace > 0) mul *= 0.4;
   219	    if (dd.shieldT > 0) mul *= 0.55;
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   221	      var w = G.defs[i];
   222	      if (w === dd || w.def.id !== 'warden' || w.hp <= 0) continue;
   223	      if (Math.abs(w.c - dd.c) <= 1 && Math.abs(w.r - dd.r) <= 1) { mul *= 0.8; break; }
   224	    }
   225	    return mul;
   226	  }
   227	  function hurtDefender(dd, amount) {
   228	    dd.hp -= amount * auraMul(dd);
   229	    dd.flash = 0.14;
   230	    if (dd.hp <= 0) {
   231	      var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   232	      if (i >= 0) G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   233	      if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   234	      G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 14, dd.def.col, 130, 4);
   235	      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6);
   236	      EO.sfx.boom();
   237	    }
   238	  }

   240	  /* ---------- spawning ---------- */
   241	  function spawnEnemy(type, pathIdx) {
   242	    if (G.enemies.length >= 90) return;
   243	    var base = EO.ENEMIES[type];
   244	    if (!base) return;
   245	    var s = EO.mapScale(G.mapIdx);
   246	    var hp = Math.round(base.hp * s);
   247	    var e = {
   248	      def: base, air: base.air, hp: hp, maxhp: hp, dead: false,
   249	      slow: 0, stun: 0, root: 0, burn: 0, burnT: 0, oil: 0,
   250	      atkCd: 0, tgt: null, flash: 0, prog: 0, kbcd: 0, rage: 0, cc: 0, cr: 0, x: 0, y: 0
   251	    };
   252	    if (base.air) {
   253	      e.x = G.L.ox + EO.rnd(G.L.tile * 0.6, G.L.tile * (EO.COLS - 0.6));
   254	      e.y = G.L.oy - 26 - EO.rnd(0, 40);
   255	      e.gx = EO.cellX(G.gate.c); e.gy = EO.cellY(G.gate.r);
   256	      e.ph = Math.random() * 6.28;
   257	    } else {
   258	      var pi = EO.clamp(pathIdx | 0, 0, G.paths.length - 1);
   259	      e.path = G.paths[pi]; e.seg = 0; e.u = 0;
   260	      e.x = EO.cellX(e.path[0].c); e.y = EO.cellY(e.path[0].r);
   261	    }
   262	    G.enemies.push(e);
   263	  }
   264	
   265	  function updateSpawner(dt) {
   266	    if (G.state !== 'prep' && G.state !== 'wave') return;
   267	    if (G.state === 'prep') {
   268	      G.prepT -= dt;
   269	      if (G.prepT <= 0) {
   270	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) return;
   271	        var w = G.waves[G.waveIdx];
   272	        G.queue.length = 0;
   273	        for (var i = 0; i < w.groups.length; i++) {
   274	          var g = w.groups[i];
   275	          for (var n = 0; n < g.count; n++) {
   276	            G.queue.push({ t: g.delay + n * g.gap, type: g.type, path: g.path });
   277	          }
   278	        }
   279	        G.queue.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
   280	        if (G.queue.length > 200) G.queue.length = 200;
=== game part 2 ===
   280	        if (G.queue.length > 200) G.queue.length = 200;
   281	        G.state = 'wave'; G.waveActive = true;
   282	        EO.audio.tone(300, 0.1, 'square', 0.16, 420);
   283	      }
   284	      return;
   285	    }
   286	    /* wave */
   287	    for (var q = 0; q < G.queue.length; q++) G.queue[q].t -= dt;
   288	    while (G.queue.length && G.queue[0].t <= 0) {
   289	      var s = G.queue.shift();
   290	      spawnEnemy(s.type, s.path);
   291	    }
   292	    if (!G.queue.length) {
   293	      var alive = 0;
   294	      for (var e = 0; e < G.enemies.length; e++) if (!G.enemies[e].dead) alive++;
   295	      if (alive === 0) {
   296	        G.waveIdx++;
   297	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) { winMap(); }
   298	        else { G.state = 'prep'; G.prepT = G.waves[G.waveIdx].prep; G.energy += 6; EO.float(G.L.w * 0.5, G.L.oy + 30, 'WAVE CLEAR +6', '#8fe0a0'); }
   299	      }
   300	    }
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  /* ---------- enemy update ---------- */
   304	  function updateEnemies(dt) {
   305	    var t = G.L.tile;
   306	    for (var i = G.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   307	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   308	      if (e.dead) { G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   309	      if (e.flash > 0) e.flash -= dt;
   310	      if (e.slow > 0) e.slow -= dt;
   311	      if (e.kbcd > 0) e.kbcd -= dt;
   312	      if (e.oil > 0) e.oil -= dt;
   313	      if (e.stun > 0) e.stun -= dt;
   314	      if (e.root > 0) e.root -= dt;
   315	      if (e.burnT > 0) {
   316	        e.burnT -= dt;
   317	        e.hp -= e.burn * dt;
   318	        if (Math.random() < dt * 8) G.parts.add(e.x + EO.rnd(-5, 5), e.y, 0, -30, 0.3, '#ff9a3c', 3, -20);
   319	        if (e.hp <= 0) { killEnemy(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   320	      }
   321	      if (e.stun > 0) continue;
   322	
   323	      var spdMul = (e.slow > 0 ? 0.55 : 1);
   324	
   325	      if (e.air) {
   326	        var dx = e.gx - e.x, dy = e.gy - e.y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
   327	        var sp = e.def.spd * t * spdMul;
   328	        e.ph += dt * 3;
   329	        e.x += (dx / d) * sp * dt + Math.cos(e.ph) * 22 * dt;
   330	        e.y += (dy / d) * sp * dt;
   331	        e.prog = 1 - d / 900;
   332	        if (d < t * 0.5) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   333	        continue;
   334	      }
   335	
   336	      /* ground: current cell + orthogonally adjacent defenders */
   337	      var cA = e.path[e.seg], cB = e.path[Math.min(e.seg + 1, e.path.length - 1)];
   338	      var near = (e.u < 0.5) ? cA : cB;
   339	      e.cc = near.c; e.cr = near.r;
   340	      if (!e.tgt || e.tgt.hp <= 0 || G.defs.indexOf(e.tgt) < 0) {
   341	        e.tgt = null; e.rage = 0;
   342	        var anchorFound = null;
   343	        for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   344	          var dd = EO.defAt(e.cc + EO.DIRS[k][0], e.cr + EO.DIRS[k][1]);
   345	          if (!dd) continue;
   346	          if (dd.def.id === 'anchor') { anchorFound = dd; break; }
   347	          if (!e.tgt) e.tgt = dd;
   348	        }
   349	        if (anchorFound) e.tgt = anchorFound;
   350	      }
   351	
   352	      if (e.tgt && e.def.dmg > 0) {
   353	        e.atkCd -= dt;
   354	        /* rage: a stalled attacker hits harder so no fight can stalemate forever */
   355	        e.rage = (e.rage || 0) + dt;
   356	        if (e.atkCd <= 0) {
   357	          e.atkCd = 1 / e.def.arate;
   358	          hurtDefender(e.tgt, e.def.dmg * (1 + 0.13 * G.mapIdx) * (1 + Math.min(2.5, e.rage * 0.13)));
   359	          shot(e.x, e.y, EO.cellX(e.tgt.c), EO.cellY(e.tgt.r), '#e05f5f', 1);
   360	        }
   361	        continue;
   362	      }
   363	
   364	      if (e.root > 0) continue;
   365	
   366	      /* advance along path */
   367	      var move = e.def.spd * spdMul * dt;
   368	      while (move > 0 && e.seg < e.path.length - 1) {
   369	        var need = 1 - e.u;
   370	        if (move >= need) { move -= need; e.seg++; e.u = 0; }
   371	        else { e.u += move; move = 0; }
   372	      }
   373	      if (e.seg >= e.path.length - 1) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   374	      var a = e.path[e.seg], b = e.path[e.seg + 1];
   375	      e.x = EO.lerp(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellX(b.c), e.u);
   376	      e.y = EO.lerp(EO.cellY(a.r), EO.cellY(b.r), e.u);
   377	      e.prog = (e.seg + e.u) / e.path.length;
   378	    }
   379	    if (G.enemies.length > 90) G.enemies.splice(0, G.enemies.length - 90);
   380	  }
   381	
   382	  function leak(e) {
   383	    G.leaks += e.def.leak;
   384	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 9);
   385	    G.flashT = 0.25;
   386	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 14, '#e05f5f', 150, 4);
   387	    EO.float(e.x, G.L.oy + G.L.tile * EO.ROWS - 14, '-' + e.def.leak, '#e05f5f');
   388	    EO.sfx.leak();
   389	    if (G.leaks >= G.leakCap) loseMap();
   390	  }
   391	
   392	  /* ---------- defender update ---------- */
   393	  function updateDefs(dt) {
   394	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   395	      var dd = G.defs[i], d = dd.def;
   396	      if (dd.flash > 0) dd.flash -= dt;
   397	      if (dd.born > 0) dd.born -= dt;
   398	      if (dd.brace > 0) dd.brace -= dt;
   399	      if (dd.shieldT > 0) dd.shieldT -= dt;
   400	      if (dd.skcd > 0) dd.skcd -= dt;
   401	      dd.pulse += dt;
   402	      if (d.id === 'scout') G.energy += 0.45 * dt;
   403	
   404	      dd.cd -= dt;
   405	      if (dd.burst > 0) {
   406	        dd.burstT -= dt;
   407	        if (dd.burstT <= 0) { dd.burst--; dd.burstT = 0.16; fire(dd, 1.0); }
   408	      }
   409	      if (dd.cd > 0) continue;
   410	
   411	      if (d.kind === 'heal') {
   412	        var healed = false;
   413	        var cells = EO.fpCells(dd);
   414	        for (var c = 0; c < cells.length; c++) {
   415	          var t2 = EO.defAt(cells[c][0], cells[c][1]);
   416	          if (t2 && t2.hp < t2.maxhp) {
   417	            t2.hp = Math.min(t2.maxhp, t2.hp + 14);
   418	            G.parts.add(EO.cellX(t2.c), EO.cellY(t2.r) - 6, EO.rnd(-14, 14), -34, 0.5, '#8fe0a0', 3, -8);
   419	            healed = true;
   420	          }
   421	        }
   422	        dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   423	        if (healed) EO.audio.tone(760, 0.05, 'sine', 0.05);
   424	        continue;
   425	      }
   426	      var tg = targetsOf(dd);
   427	      if (!tg.length) { dd.cd = 0.08; continue; }
   428	      dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   429	      fire(dd, 1.0, tg);
   430	    }
   431	  }
   432	
   433	  function fire(dd, mul, tg) {
   434	    var d = dd.def;
   435	    tg = tg || targetsOf(dd);
   436	    if (!tg.length) return;
   437	    var sx = EO.cellX(dd.c), sy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   438	    var dmg = d.dmg * mul;
   439	    if (d.kind === 'melee' || d.kind === 'single') {
   440	      var e = tg[0];
   441	      hurtEnemy(e, dmg, d.col, mul > 1.5);
   442	      shot(sx, sy, e.x, e.y, d.col, d.kind === 'single' ? 2 : 0);
   443	    } else if (d.kind === 'pierce') {
   444	      for (var i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], dmg, d.col); }
   445	      var lastp = tg[tg.length - 1];
   446	      shot(sx, sy, lastp.x, lastp.y, d.col, 2);
   447	    } else if (d.kind === 'chain') {
   448	      for (var j = 0; j < Math.min(3, tg.length); j++) {
   449	        hurtEnemy(tg[j], dmg, d.col);
   450	        shot(j === 0 ? sx : tg[j - 1].x, j === 0 ? sy : tg[j - 1].y, tg[j].x, tg[j].y, d.col, 3);
   451	      }
   452	    } else if (d.kind === 'splash') {
   453	      var c0 = tg[0];
   454	      var rad = G.L.tile * 0.85;
   455	      for (var k = 0; k < tg.length; k++) {
   456	        if (EO.dist2(tg[k].x, tg[k].y, c0.x, c0.y) <= rad * rad) hurtEnemy(tg[k], dmg, d.col);
   457	      }
   458	      G.parts.burst(c0.x, c0.y, 8, '#ffb454', 110, 3);
   459	      shot(sx, sy, c0.x, c0.y, d.col, 4);
   460	      EO.audio.tone(180, 0.08, 'sine', 0.09, 90);
   461	      return;
   462	    } else if (d.kind === 'slow') {
   463	      for (var m = 0; m < tg.length; m++) {
   464	        hurtEnemy(tg[m], dmg, d.col);
   465	        tg[m].slow = 1.2; tg[m].oil = 4.0;
   466	      }
   467	      return;
   468	    } else if (d.kind === 'shove') {
   469	      for (var n = 0; n < tg.length; n++) {
   470	        var e2 = tg[n];
   471	        hurtEnemy(e2, dmg, d.col);
   472	        /* knockback is rate-limited so nothing can be shoved in place forever */
   473	        if (!e2.air && (e2.kbcd || 0) <= 0) {
   474	          e2.kbcd = 1.1;
   475	          var back = 0.5;
   476	          while (back > 0) {
   477	            if (e2.u >= back) { e2.u -= back; back = 0; }
   478	            else if (e2.seg > 0) { back -= e2.u; e2.seg--; e2.u = 1; }
   479	            else { e2.u = 0; back = 0; }
   480	          }
   481	        }
   482	      }
   483	      shot(sx, sy, tg[0].x, tg[0].y, d.col, 0);
   484	    }
   485	    EO.sfx.shot();
   486	  }
   487	
   488	  /* ---------- skills ---------- */
   489	  EO.useSkill = function (dd) {
   490	    if (!dd || dd.skcd > 0) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   491	    var d = dd.def;
   492	    dd.skcd = d.skill.cd * G.mods.cd;
   493	    var tg = targetsOf(dd), i;
   494	    var cx = EO.cellX(dd.c), cy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   495	    G.parts.burst(cx, cy, 14, d.col, 150, 4);
   496	    EO.sfx.skill();
   497	    EO.float(cx, cy - 18, d.skill.name, d.col);
   498	    switch (d.id) {
   499	      case 'blocker':
   500	        dd.hp = Math.min(dd.maxhp, dd.hp + dd.maxhp * 0.4); dd.brace = 4; break;
   501	      case 'pike':
   502	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 3, d.col, true);
   503	        break;
   504	      case 'arcer':
   505	        dd.burst = 4; dd.burstT = 0.05; break;
   506	      case 'sparker':
   507	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 1.5, d.col, true); tg[i].stun = 1.6; }
   508	        break;
   509	      case 'medic':
   510	        for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   511	          var a = G.defs[i];
   512	          a.hp = Math.min(a.maxhp, a.hp + a.maxhp * 0.35);
   513	          G.parts.add(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellY(a.r), EO.rnd(-20, 20), -50, 0.6, '#8fe0a0', 3, -10);
   514	        }
   515	        break;
   516	      case 'sniper':
   517	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 4, d.col, true);
   518	        if (tg.length) shot(cx, cy, tg[tg.length - 1].x, tg[tg.length - 1].y, '#ffffff', 2);
   519	        break;
   520	      case 'oiler':
   521	        for (i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   522	          var e = G.enemies[i];
   523	          if (e.oil > 0 && !e.dead) { e.burn = 14; e.burnT = 3; }
   524	        }
   525	        break;
   526	      case 'warden':
   527	        for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) G.defs[i].shieldT = 5;
   528	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) {
   529	          var e3 = tg[i];
   530	          hurtEnemy(e3, d.dmg * 2, d.col);
   531	          if (!e3.air) { var bk = 1.2; while (bk > 0) { if (e3.u >= bk) { e3.u -= bk; bk = 0; } else if (e3.seg > 0) { bk -= e3.u; e3.seg--; e3.u = 1; } else { e3.u = 0; bk = 0; } } }
   532	        }
   533	        break;
   534	      case 'scout':
   535	        G.energy += 16; EO.float(cx, cy - 30, '+16', '#8fe0a0'); break;
   536	      case 'anchor':
   537	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) if (!tg[i].air) tg[i].root = 2.6;
   538	        break;
   539	    }
   540	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 4);
   541	    return true;
   542	  };
   543	
   544	  /* ---------- end states ---------- */
   545	  function winMap() {
   546	    G.state = 'won';
   547	    var timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.round(1200 - G.time * 4));
   548	    G.score = G.kills * 12 + (G.leakCap - G.leaks) * 140 + timeBonus;
   549	    var first = (G.save.cleared === G.mapIdx);
   550	    var mats = EO.matsFor(G.mapIdx, first);
   551	    G.save.mats.scrap = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.scrap + mats.scrap);
   552	    G.save.mats.ember = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.ember + mats.ember);
   553	    G.save.mats.alloy = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.alloy + mats.alloy);
   554	    var newDefs = [];
   555	    if (first) {
   556	      G.save.cleared = G.mapIdx + 1;
   557	      var ul = EO.UNLOCKS[G.mapIdx] || [];
   558	      for (var i = 0; i < ul.length; i++) {
   559	        if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(ul[i]) < 0) { G.save.unlocked.push(ul[i]); newDefs.push(ul[i]); }
   560	      }
   561	    }
   562	    var key = 'm' + G.mapIdx;
   563	    var rec = false;
   564	    if (!G.save.best[key] || G.score > G.save.best[key]) { G.save.best[key] = G.score; rec = true; }
   565	    EO.writeSave(G.save);
   566	    G.resultInfo = { win: true, mats: mats, newDefs: newDefs, record: rec, final: (G.mapIdx === EO.MAPS.length - 1) };
   567	    G.shake = 8;
   568	    EO.sfx.win();
   569	    EO.after(700, function () { if (G.state === 'won') G.screen = 'result'; });
   570	  }
   571	  function loseMap() {
   572	    if (G.state === 'lost') return;
   573	    G.state = 'lost';
   574	    G.score = G.kills * 12;
   575	    G.resultInfo = { win: false, mats: null, newDefs: [], record: false, final: false };
   576	    G.shake = 14;
   577	    EO.sfx.lose();
   578	    EO.after(800, function () { if (G.state === 'lost') G.screen = 'result'; });
   579	  }
   580	  EO.winMap = winMap;
   581	
   582	  /* ---------- main update ---------- */
   583	  EO.update = function (dt) {
   584	    if (G.screen !== 'play') { if (G.parts) G.parts.update(dt); return; }
   585	    if (G.paused) return;
   586	    var sdt = dt * G.speed;
   587	    if (G.state === 'prep' || G.state === 'wave') {
   588	      G.time += sdt;
   589	      G.energy += G.regen * sdt;
   590	      if (G.energy > 999) G.energy = 999;
   591	      updateSpawner(sdt);
   592	      updateEnemies(sdt);
   593	      updateDefs(sdt);
   594	    } else {
   595	      updateEnemies(sdt * 0.35);
   596	    }
   597	    /* shots */
   598	    for (var i = G.shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   599	      G.shots[i].t -= dt;
   600	      if (G.shots[i].t <= 0) G.shots.splice(i, 1);
   601	    }
   602	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   603	      var fl = G.floats[f];
   604	      fl.t -= dt; fl.y -= 26 * dt;
   605	      if (fl.t <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   606	    }
   607	    G.parts.update(dt);
   608	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   609	    if (G.flashT > 0) G.flashT -= dt;
   610	  };
   611	
   612	})(window.EO);

    10	  function rr(g, x, y, w, h, r) {
    11	    r = Math.min(r, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
    12	    g.beginPath();
    13	    g.moveTo(x + r, y);
    14	    g.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    15	    g.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    16	    g.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    17	    g.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    18	    g.closePath();
    19	  }

   435	
   436	  function rollEncounter(nodeId, guaranteed = false) {
   437	    const node = district.nodes[nodeId];
   438	    if (!guaranteed && rng() > 0.86) {
   439	      encounter = null;
   440	      showToast("Only leaves. Keep exploring.", 1300);
   441	      return;
   442	    }
   443	    const weather = conditions().weather.key;
   444	    const species = chooseSpecies(node.habitat, weather);
   445	    encounter = { speciesId: species.id, age: 0, sparkle: rng() * Math.PI * 2 };
   446	    pulse = 1;
   447	    chirp(390 + rng() * 180, 0.1, "triangle", 0.025);
   448	  }
   449	
   450	  function moveTo(nodeId) {
   451	    if (!district.nodes[nodeId] || nodeId === currentNode) return;
   452	    const isPractice = practiceMode || steps <= 0;
   453	    if (!isPractice && steps > 0) steps -= 1;
   454	    if (steps <= 0) practiceMode = true;
   455	    currentNode = nodeId;
   456	    district.nodes[currentNode].visited = true;
   457	    visited.add(currentNode);
   458	    if (visited.size > district.nodes.length) visited.delete(visited.values().next().value);
   459	    walkCount += 1;
   460	    score += isPractice ? 2 : 10;
   461	    shake = Math.max(shake, 2.5);
   462	    burst(district.nodes[nodeId].x, district.nodes[nodeId].y, HABITATS[district.nodes[nodeId].habitat].color, 7);
   463	    rollEncounter(nodeId);
   464	    updateStatus(`Arrived at ${district.nodes[nodeId].label}. ${encounter ? "A field encounter is nearby." : "No creature this time."}`);
   465	  }
   466	
   467	  function moveByDirection(dx, dy) {
   468	    if (state !== "map" || !district) return;
   469	    const current = district.nodes[currentNode];
   470	    const choices = neighbors(currentNode).map((id) => district.nodes[id]);
   471	    let bestNode = null;
   472	    let bestDot = -Infinity;
   473	    for (const node of choices) {
   474	      const vx = node.x - current.x;
   475	      const vy = node.y - current.y;
   476	      const length = Math.hypot(vx, vy) || 1;
   477	      const dot = (vx / length) * dx + (vy / length) * dy;
   478	      if (dot > bestDot) { bestDot = dot; bestNode = node.id; }
   479	    }
   480	    if (bestNode !== null && bestDot > 0.05) moveTo(bestNode);
   481	  }
   482	
   483	  function openEncounter() {
   484	    if (!encounter || state !== "map") return;
   485	    const species = speciesById.get(encounter.speciesId);
   486	    if (!species) { encounter = null; return; }
   487	    state = "capture";
   488	    captureTime = 0;
   489	    throwsLeft = 3;
   490	    captureDrag = null;
   491	    capturePointer = null;
   492	    flash = 0.18;
   493	    chirp(540, 0.12, "sine", 0.025);
   494	    updateStatus(`Capture drill for ${species.name}. Flick toward the lead mark.`);
   495	  }
   496	
   497	  function beginCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   498	    if (state !== "capture" || input.capturePointerId !== null) return;
   499	    if (y < 470 || y > 626) return;
   500	    input.capturePointerId = pointerId;
   501	    input.captureStart = { x, y };
   502	    capturePointer = { x, y };
   503	    captureDrag = { x, y, startX: x, startY: y, startedAt: performance.now() };
   504	  }
   505	
   506	  function moveCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   507	    if (pointerId !== input.capturePointerId || !captureDrag) return;
   508	    capturePointer = { x: clamp(x, 12, W - 12), y: clamp(y, 110, 642) };
   509	    captureDrag.x = capturePointer.x;
   510	    captureDrag.y = capturePointer.y;
   511	  }
   512	
   513	  function releaseCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   514	    if (pointerId !== input.capturePointerId || !captureDrag) return;
   515	    const drag = captureDrag;
   516	    const now = performance.now();
   517	    const dx = x - drag.startX;
   518	    const dy = y - drag.startY;
   519	    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   520	    const elapsed = Math.max(0.07, (now - drag.startedAt) / 1000);
   521	    const speed = distance / elapsed;
   522	    const leadX = captureTarget.x + captureTarget.vx * 0.18;
   523	    const leadY = captureTarget.y + captureTarget.vy * 0.18;
   524	    const aimDistance = Math.hypot(x - leadX, y - leadY);
   525	    const ringPhase = (captureTime * 1.25) % 1;
   526	    const timing = Math.abs(ringPhase - 0.78) < 0.18 || ringPhase < 0.08;
   527	    const goodDirection = dy < -52;
   528	    const success = distance > 95 && speed > 180 && goodDirection && aimDistance < 78 && timing;
   529	    capturePointer = null;
   530	    captureDrag = null;
   531	    input.capturePointerId = null;
   532	    input.captureStart = null;
   533	    if (success) captureSuccess();
   534	    else captureMiss();
   535	  }
   536	
   537	  function captureSuccess() {
   538	    const species = speciesById.get(encounter && encounter.speciesId);
   539	    if (!species) { state = "map"; return; }
   540	    const size = Math.round((species.base + rng() * species.variance) * 10) / 10;
   541	    const previous = records[species.id];
   542	    records[species.id] = { seen: true, bestSize: Math.max(previous ? previous.bestSize : 0, size) };
   543	    best = Math.max(best, SPECIES.filter((item) => records[item.id]).length);
   544	    score += 100 + Math.round(size);
   545	    safeSave();
   546	    result = { species, size, newRecord: !previous || size >= previous.bestSize };
   547	    encounter = null;
   548	    flash = 0.9;
   549	    shake = 7;
   550	    burst(captureTarget.x, captureTarget.y, species.color, 26);
   551	    chirp(650, 0.12, "triangle", 0.04);
   552	    schedule(() => chirp(900, 0.18, "sine", 0.025), 90);
   553	    state = best >= SPECIES.length ? "medal" : "result";
   554	    updateStatus(best >= SPECIES.length ? "Naturalist medal earned. Every creature is in the field notes." : `${species.name} recorded at ${size.toFixed(1)} cm.`);
   555	  }
   556	
   557	  function captureMiss() {
   558	    throwsLeft -= 1;
   559	    shake = 4;
   560	    burst(captureTarget.x, captureTarget.y, C.coral, 8);
   561	    chirp(190, 0.1, "sawtooth", 0.018);
   562	    if (throwsLeft <= 0) {
   563	      encounter = null;
   564	      state = "map";
   565	      showToast("The rustle slipped away. Another one will find you.", 1900);
   566	      updateStatus("The encounter escaped without a failed run. Keep exploring.");
   567	    } else {
   568	      showToast(`${throwsLeft} field flick${throwsLeft === 1 ? "" : "s"} left. Lead the mark.`, 1200);
   569	    }
   570	  }
   571	
   572	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   573	    const safeCount = clamp(Math.floor(count), 0, 32);
   574	    for (let i = 0; i < safeCount; i += 1) {
   575	      if (particles.length >= MAX_PARTICLES) particles.shift();
   576	      const angle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
   577	      const speed = 25 + rng() * 110;
   578	      particles.push({
   579	        x, y,
   580	        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
   581	        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18,
   582	        life: 0.5 + rng() * 0.55,
   583	        maxLife: 0.5 + rng() * 0.55,
   584	        size: 2 + rng() * 4,
   585	        color
   586	      });
   587	    }
   588	  }
   589	
   590	  function resetRun() {
   591	    cancelTimers();
   592	    clearInput();
   593	    mapSeed = hashSeed(`${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)}`);
   594	    district = buildDistrict(mapSeed);
   595	    currentNode = 0;
   596	    district.nodes[0].visited = true;
   597	    visited = new Set([0]);
   598	    steps = maxSteps;
   599	    practiceMode = false;
   600	    walkCount = 0;
   601	    score = 0;
   602	    encounter = null;
   603	    result = null;
   604	    selectedDex = 0;
   605	    state = "map";
   606	    flash = 0;
   607	    shake = 0;
   608	    pulse = 0;
   609	    particles = [];
   610	    rng = mulberry32(mapSeed ^ 0x9e3779b9);
   611	    rollEncounter(0, true);
   612	    lastFrame = performance.now();
   613	    updateStatus("Field ready. Tap a glowing path, then follow the rustle.");
   614	  }
   615	
   616	  function restart() {
   617	    resetRun();
   618	    showToast("A fresh route is drawn. Your field notes remain.", 1600);
   619	    chirp(300, 0.09, "triangle", 0.02);
   620	  }

   639	
   640	  function activate() {
   649	  function pointerPosition(event) {
   650	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   651	    return {
   652	      x: clamp((event.clientX - rect.left) * W / Math.max(1, rect.width), 0, W),
   653	      y: clamp((event.clientY - rect.top) * H / Math.max(1, rect.height), 0, H)
   654	    };
   655	  }
   656	
   657	  function hit(rect, x, y) {
   658	    return x >= rect.x && x <= rect.x + rect.w && y >= rect.y && y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   659	  }
   660	
   661	  function assignPointer(pointerId, owner, point) {
   662	    if (activePointers.size >= MAX_ACTIVE_POINTERS) return false;
   663	    activePointers.set(pointerId, { owner, x: point.x, y: point.y });
   664	    return true;
   665	  }
   666	
   667	  function pointerDown(event) {
   668	    event.preventDefault();
   669	    if (pausedByOrientation) return;
   670	    unlockAudio();
   671	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   672	    if (!assignPointer(event.pointerId, "pending", point)) return;
   673	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* no-op */ }
   674	
   675	    if (state === "capture") {
   676	      if (hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) {
   677	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   678	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   679	        return;
   680	      }
   681	      if (point.y >= 470) {
   682	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "capture";
   683	        beginCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   684	      } else activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   685	      return;
   686	    }
   687	
   688	    if (state === "dex") {
   689	      if (hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) {
   690	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   691	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   692	        return;
   693	      }
   694	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) {
   695	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "dex";
   696	        input.dexPointerId = event.pointerId;
   697	        return;
   698	      }
   699	      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   700	      return;
   701	    }
   702	
   703	    if (state === "result" || state === "medal") {
   704	      const continueRect = state === "result" ? ui.resultContinue : ui.medalContinue;
   705	      if (hit(continueRect, point.x, point.y)) {
   706	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   707	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   708	      } else activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   709	      return;
   710	    }
   711	
   712	    if (hit(ui.notes, point.x, point.y)) {
   713	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "notes";
   714	      input.notesPointerId = event.pointerId;
   715	    } else if (hit(ui.restart, point.x, point.y)) {
   716	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "restart";
   717	      input.restartPointerId = event.pointerId;
   718	    } else if (hit(ui.action, point.x, point.y)) {
   719	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "encounter";
   720	      input.encounterPointerId = event.pointerId;
   721	    } else if (hit(ui.map, point.x, point.y)) {
   722	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "map";
   723	      input.mapPointerId = event.pointerId;
   724	      input.mapStart = point;
   725	    } else {
   726	      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   727	    }
   728	  }
   729	
   730	  function pointerMove(event) {
   731	    event.preventDefault();
   732	    const tracked = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   733	    if (!tracked || pausedByOrientation) return;
   734	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   735	    tracked.x = point.x;
   736	    tracked.y = point.y;
   737	    if (tracked.owner === "capture") moveCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   738	  }
   739	
   740	  function pointerUp(event, cancelled = false) {
   741	    event.preventDefault();
   742	    const tracked = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   743	    if (!tracked) return;
   744	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   745	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   746	    if (cancelled || pausedByOrientation) {
   747	      if (tracked.owner === "capture") {
   748	        capturePointer = null;
   749	        captureDrag = null;
   750	        input.capturePointerId = null;
   751	        input.captureStart = null;
   752	      }
   753	      clearOwner(tracked.owner, event.pointerId);
   754	      return;
   755	    }
   756	    if (tracked.owner === "map") {
   757	      const start = input.mapStart;
   758	      clearOwner("map", event.pointerId);
   759	      if (start && Math.hypot(point.x - start.x, point.y - start.y) < 22) {
   760	        const destination = destinationAt(point.x, point.y);
   761	        if (destination !== null) moveTo(destination);
   762	      }
   763	    } else if (tracked.owner === "capture") {
   764	      releaseCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   765	    } else if (tracked.owner === "encounter") {
   766	      clearOwner("encounter", event.pointerId);
   767	      if (hit(ui.action, point.x, point.y)) activate();
   768	    } else if (tracked.owner === "notes") {
   769	      clearOwner("notes", event.pointerId);
   770	      if (hit(ui.notes, point.x, point.y)) openDex();
   771	    } else if (tracked.owner === "restart") {
   772	      clearOwner("restart", event.pointerId);
   773	      if (hit(ui.restart, point.x, point.y)) restart();
   774	    } else if (tracked.owner === "back") {
   775	      clearOwner("back", event.pointerId);
   776	      if (state === "capture" && hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) { state = "map"; clearInput(); }
   777	      else if (state === "dex" && hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   778	      else if (state === "result" && hit(ui.resultContinue, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   779	      else if (state === "medal" && hit(ui.medalContinue, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   780	    } else if (tracked.owner === "dex") {
   781	      clearOwner("dex", event.pointerId);
   782	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) selectDexAt(point.x, point.y);
   783	    }
   784	  }

   786	  function clearOwner(owner, pointerId) {
   787	    if (owner === "map" && input.mapPointerId === pointerId) { input.mapPointerId = null; input.mapStart = null; }
   788	    if (owner === "encounter" && input.encounterPointerId === pointerId) input.encounterPointerId = null;
   789	    if (owner === "notes" && input.notesPointerId === pointerId) input.notesPointerId = null;
   790	    if (owner === "restart" && input.restartPointerId === pointerId) input.restartPointerId = null;
   791	    if (owner === "back" && input.backPointerId === pointerId) input.backPointerId = null;
   792	    if (owner === "dex" && input.dexPointerId === pointerId) input.dexPointerId = null;
   793	  }

   795	  function selectDexAt(x, y) {

   807	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   808	    if (pausedByOrientation) return;
   809	    unlockAudio();
   810	    const key = event.key;
   811	    if (["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", " ", "Escape", "d", "D", "r", "R"].includes(key)) event.preventDefault();
   812	    if (event.repeat && key !== "ArrowUp" && key !== "ArrowDown" && key !== "ArrowLeft" && key !== "ArrowRight") return;
   813	    keyState.add(key);
   814	    if (key === "ArrowUp") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: 0, dy: -1 });
   815	    else if (key === "ArrowDown") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: 0, dy: 1 });
   816	    else if (key === "ArrowLeft") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: -1, dy: 0 });
   817	    else if (key === "ArrowRight") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: 1, dy: 0 });
   818	    else if (key === " ") queueAction({ type: "activate" });
   819	    else if (key === "Escape") queueAction({ type: "back" });
   820	    else if (key === "d" || key === "D") queueAction({ type: "dex" });
   821	    else if (key === "r" || key === "R") queueAction({ type: "restart" });
   822	  }

   824	  function onKeyUp(event) {
   825	    keyState.delete(event.key);
   826	  }

   828	  function processActions() {
   829	    const action = actionQueue.shift();

   834	    else if (action.type === "back") {

   837	    } else if (action.type === "restart") restart();

   206	  function tone(frequency, duration, type, volume) {
   207	    if (!audio.unlocked || !audio.context) return;
   208	    try {
   209	      var now = audio.context.currentTime;
   210	      var oscillator = audio.context.createOscillator();
   211	      var gain = audio.context.createGain();
   212	      oscillator.type = type || 'sine';
   213	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   214	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume || 0.025, now);
   215	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
   216	      oscillator.connect(gain);
   217	      gain.connect(audio.context.destination);
   218	      oscillator.start(now);
   219	      oscillator.stop(now + duration);
   220	    } catch (error) {}
   220	    } catch (error) {}
