   273	    resetInput();
   274	    state.record = safeRecord();
   275	    state.standings = defaultStandings();
   276	    state.gameStartStandings = [];
   277	    state.seasonGame = 1;
   278	    state.seasonFinished = false;
   279	    state.seasonWon = false;
   280	    state.screen = 'game';
   281	    state.paused = false;
   282	    startGame(1);
   283	  }
   284	
   285	  function startGame(gameNumber) {
   286	    cancelTimers();
   287	    resetInput();
   288	    state.seasonGame = clamp(gameNumber, 1, 9);
   289	    state.opponentIndex = 1 + ((state.seasonGame - 1) % 4);
   290	    state.gameStartStandings = state.standings.map(function (row) {
   291	      return { team: row.team, wins: row.wins, losses: row.losses, runsFor: row.runsFor, runsAgainst: row.runsAgainst };
   292	    });
   293	    resetGameFields();
   294	    state.screen = 'game';
   295	    state.paused = false;
   296	    beginAtBat();
   297	  }
   298	
   299	  function rematch() {
   300	    if (state.seasonFinished) {
   301	      startSeason();
   302	      return;
   303	    }
   304	    cancelTimers();
   305	    resetInput();
   306	    state.standings = state.gameStartStandings.map(function (row) {
   307	      return { team: row.team, wins: row.wins, losses: row.losses, runsFor: row.runsFor, runsAgainst: row.runsAgainst };
   308	    });
   309	    resetGameFields();
   310	    state.screen = 'game';
   311	    state.paused = false;
   312	    beginAtBat();
   313	  }
   314	
   315	  function beginAtBat() {
   316	    state.diveUsed = false;
   317	    state.lastHit = null;
   318	    if (state.gameClock <= 0) {
   319	      finishGame();
   320	      return;
   321	    }
   322	    if (state.half === 'home') beginBatting();
   323	    else beginPitching();
   324	  }
   325	
   326	  function beginBatting() {
   327	    state.phase = 'batPre';
   328	    state.preTimer = 0.78;
   329	    state.pitchProgress = 0;
   330	    state.pitchZone = Math.floor(rand() * 3);
   331	    state.guessZone = 1;
   332	    state.resultText = 'READ THE PITCH';
   333	    state.hint = 'Drag before the pitch to call a zone. Tap SWING at the plate.';
   334	    addEvent('YOU BAT  •  ' + playerName(state.playerBat), COLORS.lime);
   335	  }
   336	
   337	  function beginPitching() {
   338	    state.phase = 'userPitchReady';
   339	    state.preTimer = 0.52;
   340	    state.targetTime = 0;
   341	    state.targetStopped = false;
   342	    state.selectedPitch = 0;
   343	    state.target = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };
   344	    state.resultText = 'SET YOUR PITCH';
   345	    state.hint = 'Pick a pitch, then tap STOP when the moving target crosses the zone.';
   346	    addEvent('PITCH TO  •  ' + aiName(state.aiBat), TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color);
   347	  }
   348	
   349	  function beginUserPitch() {
   350	    state.phase = 'userPitching';
   351	    state.targetTime = 0;
   352	    state.targetStopped = false;
   353	    state.resultText = 'STOP THE TARGET';
   354	  }
   355	
   356	  function playerName(index) {
   357	    return TEAMS[0].lineup[index % TEAMS[0].lineup.length][0];
   358	  }
   359	
   360	  function aiName(index) {
   361	    return TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup[index % TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup.length][0];
   362	  }
   363	
   364	  function playerHitter() { return TEAMS[0].lineup[state.playerBat % TEAMS[0].lineup.length]; }
   365	  function aiHitter() { return TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup[state.aiBat % TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup.length]; }
   366	
   367	  function update(dt) {
   368	    if (state.orientationPaused || state.screen === 'start' || state.screen === 'gameOver' || state.screen === 'seasonComplete') return;
   369	    state.gameClock = Math.max(0, state.gameClock - dt);
   370	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3.8);
   371	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2.4);
   372	    updateParticles(dt);
   373	
   374	    if (state.gameClock <= 0 && state.phase !== 'result' && state.phase !== 'fielding') {
   375	      finishGame();
   376	      return;
   377	    }
   378	
   379	    if (state.phase === 'batPre') {
   380	      state.preTimer -= dt;
   381	      if (state.preTimer <= 0) {
   382	        state.phase = 'batPitch';
   383	        state.pitchProgress = 0;
   384	        state.resultText = 'SWING!';
   385	        tone(220, 0.045, 'triangle', 0.018);
   386	      }
   387	    } else if (state.phase === 'batPitch') {
   388	      state.pitchProgress = clamp(state.pitchProgress + dt / 0.88, 0, 1.2);
   389	      if (state.pitchProgress >= 1) resolveBatting(false);
   390	    } else if (state.phase === 'userPitchReady') {
   391	      state.preTimer -= dt;
   392	      if (state.preTimer <= 0) beginUserPitch();
   393	    } else if (state.phase === 'userPitching') {
   394	      state.targetTime += dt;
   395	      updateTarget();
   396	      if (state.targetTime > 1.85) resolvePitch(false);
   397	    } else if (state.phase === 'fielding') {
   398	      state.fieldTimer -= dt;
   399	      if (state.fieldTimer <= 0) resolveFielding(false);
   400	    } else if (state.phase === 'result') {
   401	      state.resultTimer -= dt;
   402	      if (state.resultTimer <= 0) advanceAfterResult();
   403	    }
   404	  }
   405	
   406	  function updateTarget() {
   407	    var pitch = PITCHES[state.selectedPitch];
   408	    var t = state.targetTime * (1.6 + pitch.speed);
   409	    state.target.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.32 * pitch.sway;
   410	    state.target.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(t * 2.65 + 0.7) * 0.27 * pitch.sway;
   411	  }
   412	
   413	  function resolveBatting(swung) {
   414	    if (state.phase !== 'batPitch') return;
   415	    var hitter = playerHitter();
   416	    var progress = state.pitchProgress;
   417	    var timing = clamp(1 - Math.abs(progress - 0.66) / 0.36, 0, 1);
   418	    var zoneBonus = state.guessZone === state.pitchZone ? 0.18 : 0;
   419	    var contact = hitter[1];
   420	    var quality = timing * 0.64 + contact * 0.28 + zoneBonus;
   421	    var hitChance = swung ? clamp(quality - 0.1, 0.03, 0.96) : 0.025;
   422	    var hit = chance(hitChance * 0.76);
   423	    state.playerBat += 1;
   424	    if (hit) {
   425	      var power = hitter[2];
   426	      var outcome = 'SINGLE';
   427	      if (power + timing > 1.45 && chance(0.22)) outcome = 'HOME RUN';
   428	      else if (power + timing > 1.24 && chance(0.22)) outcome = 'DOUBLE';
   429	      else if (hitter[3] > 0.82 && timing > 0.75 && chance(0.11)) outcome = 'TRIPLE';
   430	      recordHit('home', outcome, timing > 0.68 && zoneBonus > 0);
   431	    } else {
   432	      var label = swung && timing > 0.28 ? 'FLY OUT' : 'STRIKEOUT';
   433	      recordOut(label, 'home');
   434	    }
   435	  }
   436	
   437	  function resolvePitch(stopped) {
   438	    if (state.phase !== 'userPitching') return;
   439	    state.targetStopped = stopped;
   440	    var pitch = PITCHES[state.selectedPitch];
   441	    var dx = (state.target.x - 0.5) / 0.42;
   442	    var dy = (state.target.y - 0.5) / 0.37;
   443	    var distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   444	    var accuracy = clamp(1 - distance, 0, 1);
   445	    var inZone = Math.abs(state.target.x - 0.5) < 0.25 && Math.abs(state.target.y - 0.5) < 0.23;
   446	    var hitter = aiHitter();
   447	    var strikePower = accuracy * 0.7 + (inZone ? 0.25 : 0) + pitch.bonus;
   448	    var getsOut = chance(clamp(strikePower - hitter[1] * 0.18 + 0.1, 0.12, 0.96));
   449	    state.aiBat += 1;
   450	    if (getsOut) {
   451	      recordOut(inZone ? 'PAINTED CORNER' : 'CHASED IT', 'away');
   452	    } else {
   453	      var hitChance = clamp((1 - accuracy) * 0.38 + hitter[1] * 0.27 + hitter[2] * 0.13, 0.08, 0.74);
   454	      if (chance(hitChance)) {
   455	        var outcome = hitter[2] > 0.84 && chance(0.2) ? 'HOME RUN' : (hitter[3] > 0.8 && chance(0.18) ? 'TRIPLE' : (chance(0.22) ? 'DOUBLE' : 'SINGLE'));
   456	        state.lastHit = { outcome: outcome, accuracy: accuracy };
   457	        state.fieldTimer = 0.94;
   458	        state.fieldTarget = { x: 0.5 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.7, y: 0.48 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.34 };
   459	        state.diveUsed = false;
   460	        state.phase = 'fielding';
   460	        state.phase = 'fielding';
   461	        state.resultText = 'BALL IN PLAY';
   462	        state.hint = 'Auto-fielding is active. Tap DIVE as the marker flashes.';
   463	        tone(180, 0.08, 'sawtooth', 0.025);
   464	      } else {
   465	        recordOut('SOFT CONTACT', 'away');
   466	      }
   467	    }
   468	  }
   469	
   470	  function resolveFielding(dived) {
   471	    if (state.phase !== 'fielding') return;
   472	    var success = dived && !state.diveUsed;
   473	    state.diveUsed = true;
   474	    if (success) {
   475	      state.lastHit = null;
   476	      recordOut('DIVING STOP', 'away');
   477	      burst(W * state.fieldTarget.x, H * (0.14 + state.fieldTarget.y * 0.52), COLORS.aqua, 18);
   478	      tone(520, 0.12, 'square', 0.03);
   479	    } else {
   480	      recordHit('away', state.lastHit ? state.lastHit.outcome : 'SINGLE', false);
   481	    }
   482	  }
   483	
   484	  function recordOut(label, side) {
   485	    state.outs += 1;
   486	    state.bases = state.outs >= 3 ? [false, false, false] : state.bases;
   487	    state.shake = 0.08;
   488	    state.flash = 0.3;
   489	    state.resultColor = side === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color;
   490	    state.resultText = label;
   491	    state.resultSub = state.outs >= 3 ? 'THREE DOWN  •  SWITCH SIDES' : (state.outs + ' OUT' + (state.outs === 1 ? '' : 'S'));
   492	    state.pendingTransition = state.outs >= 3 ? 'half' : 'next';
   493	    state.phase = 'result';
   494	    state.resultTimer = 0.86;
   495	    addEvent(label + '  •  ' + (side === 'home' ? 'N9' : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].short), state.resultColor);
   496	    burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.47, COLORS.white, label === 'DIVING STOP' ? 16 : 7);
   497	    tone(label === 'STRIKEOUT' ? 150 : 260, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.022);
   498	  }
   499	
   500	  function recordHit(side, outcome, bonus) {
   501	    var sideIndex = side === 'home' ? 1 : 0;
   502	    state.hits[sideIndex] += 1;
   503	    var bases = outcome === 'HOME RUN' ? 4 : (outcome === 'TRIPLE' ? 3 : (outcome === 'DOUBLE' ? 2 : 1));
   504	    var runs = advanceBases(bases, sideIndex);
   505	    if (bonus) {
   506	      state.shake = 0.12;
   507	      state.flash = 0.65;
   508	      burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, COLORS.gold, 20);
   509	    } else {
   510	      burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, side === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 9);
   511	    }
   512	    state.resultColor = side === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color;
   513	    state.resultText = outcome;
   514	    state.resultSub = runs > 0 ? (runs + (runs === 1 ? ' RUN' : ' RUNS')) : 'RUNNERS MOVE';
   515	    state.pendingTransition = 'next';
   516	    state.phase = 'result';
   517	    state.resultTimer = 0.92;
   518	    addEvent(outcome + (runs ? '  •  ' + runs + ' RUN' + (runs === 1 ? '' : 'S') : ''), state.resultColor);
   519	    tone(outcome === 'HOME RUN' ? 660 : 420, outcome === 'HOME RUN' ? 0.2 : 0.1, 'sine', 0.03);
   520	  }
   521	
   522	  function advanceBases(distance, sideIndex) {
   523	    var scoreRuns = 0;
   524	    var old = state.bases.slice();
   525	    var next = [false, false, false];
   526	    if (distance >= 4) {
   527	      scoreRuns = 1 + (old[0] ? 1 : 0) + (old[1] ? 1 : 0) + (old[2] ? 1 : 0);
   528	      next = [false, false, false];
   529	    } else {
   530	      for (var i = 2; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   531	        if (old[i]) {
   532	          var dest = i + distance;
   533	          if (dest >= 3) scoreRuns += 1;
   534	          else next[dest] = true;
   535	        }
   536	      }
   537	      var batterDest = distance - 1;
   538	      if (batterDest >= 3) scoreRuns += 1;
   539	      else next[batterDest] = true;
   540	    }
   541	    state.bases = next;
   542	    state.score[sideIndex] += scoreRuns;
   543	    return scoreRuns;
   544	  }
   545	
   546	  function advanceAfterResult() {
   547	    if (state.pendingTransition === 'half') {
   548	      state.bases = [false, false, false];
   549	      state.outs = 0;
   550	      if (state.half === 'away') {
   551	        state.half = 'home';
   552	      } else {
   553	        state.inning += 1;
   554	        state.half = 'away';
   555	      }
   556	      if (state.inning > 3) {
   557	        finishGame();
   558	        return;
   559	      }
   560	    }
   561	    beginAtBat();
   562	  }
   563	
   564	  function finishGame() {
   565	    if (state.screen !== 'game') return;
   566	    cancelTimers();
   567	    resetInput();
   568	    var player = state.standings[0];
   569	    var opponent = state.standings[state.opponentIndex];
   570	    var playerWon = state.score[1] > state.score[0];
   571	    if (state.score[1] === state.score[0]) playerWon = chance(0.5);
   572	    player.runsFor += state.score[1];
   573	    player.runsAgainst += state.score[0];
   574	    opponent.runsFor += state.score[0];
   575	    opponent.runsAgainst += state.score[1];
   576	    if (playerWon) { player.wins += 1; opponent.losses += 1; }
   577	    else { player.losses += 1; opponent.wins += 1; }
   578	    simulateOtherGames();
   579	    state.record.games += 1;
   580	    state.resultText = playerWon ? 'GAME WON' : 'GAME LOST';
   581	    state.resultSub = state.score[1] + ' — ' + state.score[0] + '  •  ' + TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].name;
   582	    state.resultColor = playerWon ? COLORS.lime : COLORS.coral;
   583	    state.screen = state.seasonFinished ? 'seasonComplete' : 'gameOver';
   584	    state.paused = true;
   585	    state.seasonFinished = state.seasonGame >= 9;
   586	    state.seasonWon = false;
   587	    if (state.seasonFinished) {
   588	      var rank = sortedStandings().findIndex(function (entry) { return entry.team === 0; });
   589	      state.seasonWon = rank === 0;
   590	      state.record.seasons += 1;
   591	      if (state.seasonWon) state.record.pennants += 1;
   592	      state.record.bestWins = Math.max(state.record.bestWins, player.wins);
   593	      saveRecord();
   594	    } else {
   595	      saveRecord();
   596	    }
   597	    addEvent(playerWon ? 'WIN  •  STANDINGS CLIMB' : 'LOSS  •  NEXT GAME', playerWon ? COLORS.lime : COLORS.coral);
   598	    burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, playerWon ? COLORS.lime : COLORS.coral, 26);
   599	    tone(playerWon ? 720 : 120, playerWon ? 0.22 : 0.16, playerWon ? 'sine' : 'sawtooth', 0.035);
   600	  }
   601	
   602	  function simulateOtherGames() {
   603	    var pairings = [[1, 2], [3, 4]];
   604	    pairings.forEach(function (pair) {
   605	      var first = state.standings[pair[0]];
   606	      var second = state.standings[pair[1]];
   607	      var firstWins = chance(0.5);
   608	      var firstRuns = 1 + Math.floor(rand() * 7);
   609	      var secondRuns = 1 + Math.floor(rand() * 6);
   610	      if (firstWins) firstRuns = Math.max(firstRuns, secondRuns + 1);
   611	      else secondRuns = Math.max(secondRuns, firstRuns + 1);
   612	      first.runsFor += firstRuns; first.runsAgainst += secondRuns;
   613	      second.runsFor += secondRuns; second.runsAgainst += firstRuns;
   614	      if (firstWins) { first.wins += 1; second.losses += 1; }
   615	      else { second.wins += 1; first.losses += 1; }
   616	    });
   617	  }
   618	
   619	  function sortedStandings() {
   620	    return state.standings.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
   621	      return b.wins - a.wins || (b.runsFor - b.runsAgainst) - (a.runsFor - a.runsAgainst) || a.team - b.team;
   622	    });
   623	  }
   624	
   625	  function spawnParticle(x, y, color, size, life, vx, vy) {
   626	    if (state.particles.length >= 180) state.particles.splice(0, 24);
   627	    state.particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, size: size, life: life, max: life, color: color });
   628	  }
   629	
   630	  function burst(x, y, color, amount) {
   631	    var count = Math.min(amount, 30);
   632	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
   633	      var angle = rand() * TAU;
   634	      var speed = 24 + rand() * 75;
   635	      spawnParticle(x, y, color, 2 + rand() * 4, 0.42 + rand() * 0.48, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed);
   636	    }
   637	  }
   638	
   639	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   640	    for (var i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   641	      var p = state.particles[i];
   642	      p.life -= dt;
   643	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   644	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   645	      p.vy += 34 * dt;
   646	      if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   647	    }
   648	  }
   649	
   650	  function addEvent(text, color) {
   651	    state.events.unshift({ text: text, color: color || COLORS.text, age: 0 });
   652	    if (state.events.length > 18) state.events.length = 18;
   653	  }
   654	
   655	  function updateEvents(dt) {
   656	    for (var i = state.events.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   657	      state.events[i].age += dt;
   658	      if (state.events[i].age > 12) state.events.splice(i, 1);
   659	    }
   660	  }
   661	
   662	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lineWidth) {
   663	    r = Math.min(r, Math.abs(w) / 2, Math.abs(h) / 2);
   664	    ctx.beginPath();
   665	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   666	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   667	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   668	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   669	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   670	    ctx.closePath();
   671	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   672	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   673	  }
   674	
   675	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   676	    ctx.font = (weight || 600) + ' ' + size + 'px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
   677	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.text;
   678	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   679	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   680	    ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   681	  }
   682	
   683	  function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width) {
   684	    ctx.beginPath();
   685	    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
   686	    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width || 1; ctx.stroke();
   687	  }
   688	
   689	  function circle(x, y, radius, fill, stroke, width) {
   690	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, TAU);
   691	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   692	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = width || 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   693	  }
   694	
   695	  function draw() {
   696	    ctx.save();
   697	    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
   698	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.night;
   699	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   700	    drawBackdrop();
   700	    drawBackdrop();
   701	    if (state.screen === 'start') drawStart();
   702	    else {
   703	      drawHud();
   704	      drawArena();
   705	      drawBottomBar();
   706	      drawEvents();
   707	      drawParticles();
   708	      if (state.screen === 'gameOver' || state.screen === 'seasonComplete') drawGameOver();
   709	    }
   710	    if (portrait) drawRotateOverlay();
   711	    ctx.restore();
   712	  }
   713	
   714	  function drawBackdrop() {
   715	    var grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   716	    grad.addColorStop(0, '#102a32'); grad.addColorStop(0.56, '#0b1c22'); grad.addColorStop(1, '#071116');
   717	    ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   718	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
   719	    for (var i = -H; i < W + H; i += 44) line(i, 0, i + H, H, COLORS.aqua, 1);
   720	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   721	  }
   722	
   723	  function drawStart() {
   724	    var cx = W / 2;
   725	    var cy = H * 0.42;
   726	    circle(cx, cy - 68, 38, COLORS.lime);
   727	    line(cx - 16, cy - 84, cx + 16, cy - 52, COLORS.ink, 3);
   728	    line(cx - 21, cy - 67, cx + 9, cy - 96, COLORS.ink, 3);
   729	    text('PENNANT', cx, cy - 10, Math.min(42, W * 0.075), COLORS.text, 'center', 800);
   730	    text('NINE', cx, cy + 35, Math.min(64, W * 0.12), COLORS.lime, 'center', 900);
   731	    text('A tiny pennant, a loud swing.', cx, cy + 78, 15, COLORS.muted, 'center', 500);
   732	    var btn = startButton();
   733	    roundRect(btn.x, btn.y, btn.w, btn.h, 16, COLORS.lime);
   734	    text('TAP TO PLAY', cx, btn.y + btn.h / 2, 18, COLORS.ink, 'center', 900);
   735	    text('free forever  •  9 games  •  no luck boxes', cx, btn.y + btn.h + 30, 11, COLORS.muted, 'center', 600);
   736	    var rec = state.record;
   737	    text('PENNANTS ' + rec.pennants + '   BEST WINS ' + rec.bestWins, cx, H - 30, 11, COLORS.aqua, 'center', 700);
   738	  }

   753	
   754	  function formatTime(seconds) {
   755	    var total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(seconds));
   756	    var min = Math.floor(total / 60);
   757	    var sec = total % 60;
   758	    return min + ':' + (sec < 10 ? '0' : '') + sec;
   759	  }

   761	  function arenaRect() {
   762	    return { x: Math.max(154, W * 0.2), y: 75, w: W - Math.max(308, W * 0.4), h: H - 172 };
   763	  }

   765	  function drawArena() {
   766	    var ar = arenaRect();
   767	    var x = ar.x, y = ar.y, w = ar.w, h = ar.h;
   768	    roundRect(x - 10, y - 10, w + 20, h + 20, 18, COLORS.panel, COLORS.line, 1);
   769	    ctx.save();
   770	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x, y, w, h); ctx.clip();
   771	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.field; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
   772	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
   773	    for (var i = -h; i < w + h; i += 34) {
   774	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
   775	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + i, y); ctx.lineTo(x + i + h * 0.32, y); ctx.lineTo(x + i + h * 0.32 - h, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + i - h, y + h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   776	    }
   777	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   778	    var homeX = x + w / 2, homeY = y + h * 0.79;
   779	    var moundX = homeX, moundY = y + h * 0.42;
   780	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dirt;
   781	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(homeX, homeY); ctx.lineTo(homeX - w * 0.41, y + h * 0.05); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.04, y + h * 0.04); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.03, y + h * 0.95); ctx.lineTo(homeX - w * 0.41, y + h * 0.95); ctx.closePath(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.38; ctx.fill();
   782	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(homeX, homeY); ctx.lineTo(homeX + w * 0.41, y + h * 0.05); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.96, y + h * 0.04); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.97, y + h * 0.95); ctx.lineTo(homeX + w * 0.41, y + h * 0.95); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   783	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   784	    circle(moundX, moundY, 19, COLORS.dirt, '#e3a16d', 2);
   785	    circle(homeX, homeY, 13, COLORS.white);
   786	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
   787	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(homeX - 12, homeY - 7); ctx.lineTo(homeX + 12, homeY - 7); ctx.lineTo(homeX + 8, homeY + 10); ctx.lineTo(homeX, homeY + 14); ctx.lineTo(homeX - 8, homeY + 10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   788	    drawBaseDiamond(homeX, homeY - 52, 15);
   789	    drawBaseDiamond(homeX - 52, homeY - 1, 15);
   790	    drawBaseDiamond(homeX + 52, homeY - 1, 15);
   791	    drawPitchZone(ar, homeX, homeY);
   792	    drawPlayers(ar, homeX, homeY, moundX, moundY);
   793	    drawPhaseObject(ar, homeX, homeY);
   794	    ctx.restore();
   795	    drawSideCards();
   796	  }

   798	  function drawBaseDiamond(cx, cy, size) {
   799	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx, cy); ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
   800	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white; ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.48, -size * 0.48, size * 0.96, size * 0.96); ctx.restore();
   801	  }

   803	  function drawPitchZone(ar, homeX, homeY) {
   804	    var zone = { x: homeX - Math.min(76, ar.w * 0.28), y: ar.y + ar.h * 0.28, w: Math.min(152, ar.w * 0.56), h: Math.min(112, ar.h * 0.46) };
   805	    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
   806	    roundRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.w, zone.h, 4, null, COLORS.aqua, 2);
   807	    ctx.setLineDash([]);
   808	    if (state.half === 'home' && (state.phase === 'batPre' || state.phase === 'batPitch')) {
   809	      var colW = zone.w / 3;
   810	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
   811	        if (i === state.guessZone) roundRect(zone.x + i * colW + 3, zone.y + 3, colW - 6, zone.h - 6, 4, 'rgba(201,255,98,.18)', null);
   812	      }
   813	      line(zone.x + colW, zone.y, zone.x + colW, zone.y + zone.h, 'rgba(134,228,213,.45)', 1);
   814	      line(zone.x + colW * 2, zone.y, zone.x + colW * 2, zone.y + zone.h, 'rgba(134,228,213,.45)', 1);
   815	      if (state.phase === 'batPitch') {
   816	        var bx = zone.x + (state.pitchZone + 0.5) * colW;
   817	        var by = zone.y + zone.h * (0.36 + Math.sin(state.pitchProgress * Math.PI) * 0.18);
   818	        circle(bx, by, 10 + state.pitchProgress * 5, COLORS.white);
   819	        circle(bx, by, 4, COLORS.coral);
   820	      }
   821	      text('GUESS', zone.x + zone.w / 2, zone.y - 13, 10, COLORS.aqua, 'center', 800);
   822	    }
   823	    if (state.half === 'away' && (state.phase === 'userPitching' || state.phase === 'userPitchReady')) {
   824	      if (state.phase === 'userPitching') {
   825	        var tx = zone.x + state.target.x * zone.w;
   826	        var ty = zone.y + state.target.y * zone.h;
   827	        circle(tx, ty, 16, 'rgba(255,255,255,.16)', PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color, 3);
   828	        circle(tx, ty, 4, PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color);
   829	        line(tx - 23, ty, tx + 23, ty, PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color, 1);
   830	        line(tx, ty - 23, tx, ty + 23, PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color, 1);
   831	      }
   832	      text('STRIKE ZONE', zone.x + zone.w / 2, zone.y - 13, 10, COLORS.aqua, 'center', 800);
   833	    }
   834	  }

   836	  function drawPlayers(ar, homeX, homeY, moundX, moundY) {
   837	    var player = state.half === 'home' ? playerHitter() : aiHitter();
   838	    var batterColor = state.half === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color;
   839	    circle(homeX - 39, homeY - 38, 13, batterColor);
   840	    line(homeX - 35, homeY - 28, homeX - 27, homeY - 8, batterColor, 7);
   841	    line(homeX - 30, homeY - 23, homeX - 52, homeY - 10, batterColor, 5);
   842	    line(homeX - 29, homeY - 8, homeX - 45, homeY + 9, batterColor, 5);
   843	    line(homeX - 27, homeY - 8, homeX - 13, homeY + 10, batterColor, 5);
   844	    if (state.half === 'home' && state.phase === 'batPitch') line(homeX - 49, homeY - 23, homeX - 8, homeY - 52, COLORS.gold, 5);
   845	    circle(moundX, moundY - 19, 11, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color);
   846	    line(moundX, moundY - 8, moundX, moundY + 16, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 6);
   847	    line(moundX, moundY + 1, moundX - 16, moundY + 12, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 5);
   848	    line(moundX, moundY + 1, moundX + 16, moundY + 12, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 5);
   849	    text(player[0].split(' ')[0], homeX, ar.y + ar.h - 11, 10, batterColor, 'center', 800);
   850	  }

   852	  function drawPhaseObject(ar, homeX, homeY) {
   853	    if (state.phase === 'fielding') {
   854	      var fx = ar.x + ar.w * state.fieldTarget.x;
   855	      var fy = ar.y + ar.h * (0.2 + state.fieldTarget.y * 0.6);
   856	      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
   857	      line(homeX, homeY, fx, fy, COLORS.gold, 2);
   858	      ctx.setLineDash([]);
   859	      circle(fx, fy, 15 + Math.sin(state.fieldTimer * 18) * 3, 'rgba(255,211,107,.14)', COLORS.gold, 3);
   860	      circle(fx, fy, 4, COLORS.white);
   861	      if (state.fieldTimer < 0.68) {
   862	        roundRect(fx - 40, fy - 45, 80, 25, 8, COLORS.gold);
   863	        text('DIVE', fx, fy - 32, 12, COLORS.ink, 'center', 900);
   864	      }
   865	    }
   866	    if (state.flash > 0) {
   867	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (state.flash * 0.16) + ')';
   868	      ctx.fillRect(ar.x, ar.y, ar.w, ar.h);
   869	    }
   870	  }

  1028	  function pointFromEvent(event) {
  1029	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  1030	    return { x: clamp(event.clientX - rect.left, 0, W), y: clamp(event.clientY - rect.top, 0, H) };
  1031	  }

  1037	  function controlAt(point) {
  1038	    if (state.screen === 'start') return within(point, startButton()) ? 'menu' : null;
  1039	    if (state.screen === 'gameOver' || state.screen === 'seasonComplete') {
  1040	      if (within(point, menuPrimaryButton())) return 'menuNext';
  1041	      if (within(point, menuRematchButton())) return 'menuRematch';
  1042	      return null;

  1044	    if (state.phase === 'fielding' && within(point, diveButton())) return 'dive';
  1045	    if (state.half === 'home') {
  1046	      if (within(point, swingButton())) return 'swing';
  1047	    } else {
  1048	      for (var i = 0; i < PITCHES.length; i += 1) if (within(point, pitchButton(i))) return 'pitch' + i;
  1049	      if (within(point, stopButton())) return 'stop';
  1050	    }
  1051	    return null;
  1052	  }

  1054	  function claim(role, pointerId, point) {
  1055	    if (input.owners[role] !== null) return false;
  1056	    input.owners[role] = pointerId;
  1057	    input.pointers.set(pointerId, { role: role, x: point.x, y: point.y, moved: false });
  1058	    return true;
  1059	  }
  1060	
  1061	  function release(pointerId, cancelled) {
  1062	    var tracked = input.pointers.get(pointerId);
  1063	    if (!tracked) return;
  1064	    input.pointers.delete(pointerId);
  1065	    if (input.owners[tracked.role] === pointerId) input.owners[tracked.role] = null;
  1066	    if (cancelled) return;
  1067	    if (tracked.role === 'menu') { startSeason(); return; }
  1068	    if (tracked.role === 'menuNext') { nextMenuAction(); return; }
  1069	    if (tracked.role === 'menuRematch') { rematch(); return; }
  1070	    if (tracked.role === 'swing') { doSwing(); return; }
  1071	    if (tracked.role === 'stop') { doStop(); return; }
  1072	    if (tracked.role === 'dive') { doDive(); return; }
  1073	    if (tracked.role.indexOf('pitch') === 0) {
  1074	      var index = Number(tracked.role.slice(5));
  1075	      if (Number.isFinite(index)) state.selectedPitch = clamp(index, 0, PITCHES.length - 1);
  1076	      return;
  1077	    }
  1078	    if (tracked.role === 'play' && !tracked.moved) {
  1079	      if (state.phase === 'batPitch') doSwing();
  1080	      else if (state.phase === 'userPitching') doStop();
  1081	      else if (state.phase === 'fielding') doDive();
  1082	    }
  1083	  }

   328	  function updateFx(dt) {
   329	    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 16);
   330	    game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt * 4);
   331	    for (let i = game.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   332	      const p = game.particles[i];
   333	      p.life -= dt;
   334	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   335	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   336	      p.vy += 160 * dt;
   337	      if (p.life <= 0) game.particles.splice(i, 1);
   338	    }
   339	    for (let i = game.floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   340	      const f = game.floaters[i];
   341	      f.life -= dt;
   342	      f.y -= 28 * dt;
   343	      if (f.life <= 0) game.floaters.splice(i, 1);
   344	    }

   347	  function attack() {
   348	    if (game.status !== 'playing' || !game.foe) return;
   349	    const crit = random() < 0.08 + game.skills.crit + game.stats.fortune;
   350	    const damage = game.stats.power * (crit ? 1.75 : 1) + random() * 2.5;

   358	    tone(crit ? 620 : 350, crit ? 0.11 : 0.06, 'triangle', crit ? 0.04 : 0.022);
   359	    if (game.foe.hp <= 0) defeatFoe();

   378	  function checkRankUps() {
   379	    let safety = 0;
   380	    while (game.status === 'playing' && game.rank < 20 && game.xp >= xpForNext() && safety < 4) {
   381	      safety += 1;

   411	  function chooseEvolution(branch) {
   412	    if (game.status !== 'choice' || !EVOLUTION[branch]) return;

   420	    if (branch === 'trickster') game.skills.crit += [0.07, 0.14, 0.22][tierIndex];

   501	    if (game.sampleTimer <= 0) {
   502	      game.sampleTimer += 1;
   503	      capPush(game.history, { t: game.runElapsed, xp: game.runXp }, MAX_HISTORY);

   509	  function updateRate() {
   510	    if (game.history.length < 2) {
   511	      game.ratePerMin = 0;
   512	      return;
   513	    }
   514	    const newest = game.history[game.history.length - 1];
   515	    const cutoff = newest.t - 60;
   516	    let oldest = game.history[0];
   517	    for (let i = game.history.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   518	      if (game.history[i].t <= cutoff) { oldest = game.history[i]; break; }
   519	    }
   520	    const seconds = Math.max(1, newest.t - oldest.t);
   521	    game.ratePerMin = Math.max(0, (newest.xp - oldest.xp) / seconds * 60);
   522	  }

   557	  function processActions() {
   558	    if (input.queuedActions.length > 12) input.queuedActions.splice(0, input.queuedActions.length - 12);

   580	  function inside(point, rect) {
   581	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   582	  }

   584	  function hitControl(point) {
   585	    if (game.status === 'choice') {
   586	      for (let i = 0; i < choiceControls.length; i += 1) if (inside(point, choiceControls[i])) return `choose-${i}`;
   587	      return '';

   590	    if (inside(point, mainControls.forage)) return 'forage';
   591	    if (point.y >= 92 && point.y <= 312 && point.x >= 176) return 'attack';
   592	    return '';

   595	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   596	    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) return;
   597	    event.preventDefault();
   598	    unlockAudio();
   599	    if (input.activePointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS || input.activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;
   600	    const control = hitControl(pointFromEvent(event));
   601	    if (!control) return;
   602	    input.activePointers.set(event.pointerId, control);
   603	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* Capture is optional. */ }
   604	  }

   606	  function onPointerUp(event) {
   607	    event.preventDefault();
   608	    const control = input.activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   609	    input.activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   610	    if (control) queueAction(control);
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  function onPointerCancel(event) {
   614	    event.preventDefault();

   616	  }

   618	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   619	    if (event.code === 'Space' || event.key === '1' || event.key === '2' || event.key === '3' || event.key.toLowerCase() === 'f' || event.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') event.preventDefault();
   620	    if (input.pressedKeys.has(event.code)) return;
   621	    if (input.pressedKeys.size >= MAX_KEYS) input.pressedKeys.clear();
   622	    input.pressedKeys.add(event.code);
   623	    unlockAudio();
   624	    if (event.code === 'Space') queueAction('attack');
   625	    else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'f') queueAction('forage');
   626	    else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') queueAction('restart');
   627	    else if (event.key === '1' || event.key === '2' || event.key === '3') queueAction(`choose-${Number(event.key) - 1}`);
   628	  }

   651	  function roundedRect(x, y, w, h, radius) {
   652	    const r = Math.min(radius, w / 2, h / 2);
   653	    ctx.beginPath();
   654	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   655	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   656	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   657	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   658	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   659	    ctx.closePath();
   660	  }

    75	  const clamp = (n, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));
    76	  const finite = (n, fallback = 0) => Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
    77	  const clampInt = (n, min, max, fallback) => Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(clamp(n, min, max)) : fallback;
    78	  const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
    79	  const normalize = (x, y) => {
    80	    const m = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1;
    81	    return { x: x / m, y: y / m };
    82	  };
    83	  const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
    84	    const value = hex.replace('#', '');
    85	    return [parseInt(value.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(value.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(value.slice(4, 6), 16)];
    86	  };
    87	  const rgba = (hex, alpha) => {
    88	    const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(hex);
    89	    return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
    90	  };

    92	  function readProgress() {
    93	    try {
    94	      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    95	      if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length > 1800) return { ...defaults };
    96	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    97	      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return { ...defaults };
    98	      return {
    99	        maxStage: clampInt(parsed.maxStage, 1, 12, defaults.maxStage),
   100	        unlocked: clampInt(parsed.unlocked, 3, 6, defaults.unlocked),
   101	        bestScore: clampInt(parsed.bestScore, 0, 999999, defaults.bestScore),
   102	        bestTime: clampInt(parsed.bestTime, 0, 999999, defaults.bestTime)
   103	      };
   104	    } catch (_) {
   105	      return { ...defaults };
   106	    }
   107	  }
   108	
   109	  function saveProgress() {
   110	    try {
   111	      const safe = {
   112	        maxStage: clampInt(progress.maxStage, 1, 12, 1),
   113	        unlocked: clampInt(progress.unlocked, 3, 6, 3),
   114	        bestScore: clampInt(progress.bestScore, 0, 999999, 0),
   115	        bestTime: clampInt(progress.bestTime, 0, 999999, 0)
   116	      };
   117	      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(safe));
   118	    } catch (_) { /* Storage is optional. */ }
   119	  }

   121	  function later(fn, delay) {
   122	    if (pendingTimers.size >= MAX_TIMERS) return 0;
   123	    let timer = 0;
   124	    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
   125	      pendingTimers.delete(timer);
   126	      fn();
   127	    }, delay);
   128	    pendingTimers.add(timer);
   129	    return timer;
   130	  }
   131	
   132	  function cancelTimers() {
   133	    pendingTimers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
   134	    pendingTimers.clear();
   135	  }

   137	  function resetInput() {
   138	    const capturedAimId = aimPointerId;
   139	    const capturedBootId = bootPointerId;
   140	    const capturedButtons = Array.from(buttonPointers.entries());
   141	    aimPointerId = null;
   142	    bootPointerId = null;
   143	    aimStart = null;
   144	    buttonPointers.clear();
   145	    keys.clear();
   146	    queuedActions.length = 0;
   147	    aim = { x: 0, y: -1 };
   148	    try { if (capturedAimId !== null && canvas.hasPointerCapture && canvas.hasPointerCapture(capturedAimId)) canvas.releasePointerCapture(capturedAimId); } catch (_) {}
   149	    try { if (capturedBootId !== null && bootButton.hasPointerCapture && bootButton.hasPointerCapture(capturedBootId)) bootButton.releasePointerCapture(capturedBootId); } catch (_) {}
   150	    for (const [key, pointerId] of capturedButtons) {
   151	      const target = key === 'restart' ? restartButton : teamControls.querySelector(`[data-id="${key}"]`);
   152	      try { if (target && target.hasPointerCapture && target.hasPointerCapture(pointerId)) target.releasePointerCapture(pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   153	    }
   154	  }

   156	  function updateLayout() {
   157	    const cssW = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   158	    const cssH = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   159	    const dpr = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1), 960 / Math.max(cssW, cssH));
   160	    const scale = Math.min(cssW / VW, cssH / VH);
   161	    layout = { cssW, cssH, scale, ox: (cssW - VW * scale) / 2, oy: (cssH - VH * scale) / 2, dpr, portrait: cssH >= cssW };
   162	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cssW * dpr));
   163	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cssH * dpr));
   164	    orientationPaused = !layout.portrait;
   165	    rotateLayer.hidden = layout.portrait;
   166	  }
   167	
   168	  function worldPoint(clientX, clientY) {
   169	    return { x: (clientX - layout.ox) / layout.scale, y: (clientY - layout.oy) / layout.scale };
   170	  }

   172	  function makeTeam() {
   173	    const safe = team.slice(0, 3).filter((id) => id >= 0 && id < progress.unlocked);
   174	    while (safe.length < 3) safe.push(safe.length % progress.unlocked);
   175	    team = safe;
   176	    activeSlot = clampInt(activeSlot, 0, team.length - 1, 0);
   177	    renderTeamControls();
   178	  }

   190	  function enemy(x, y, type = 'drift', hp = 1) {
   191	    const palette = { drift: '#ee7e70', heavy: '#e89d65', guard: '#d477b3', boss: '#f05e6f' };
   192	    return { id: nextId++, x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: type === 'boss' ? 31 : type === 'heavy' ? 22 : 18, hp, maxHp: hp, type, color: palette[type] || palette.drift, hitCooldown: 0, flash: 0 };
   193	  }

   195	  function buildStage(n) {
   196	    enemies = [];
   197	    walls = [];
   198	    shards = [];
   199	    particles = [];
   200	    effects = [];
   201	    trails = [];
   202	    stageClearQueued = false;
   203	    shotNumber = 0;
   204	    combo = 0;
   205	    teamHP = 100;
   206	    nextId = 1;
   207	    const boss = n === 6 || n === 12;
   208	    const count = boss ? (n === 12 ? 7 : 5) : Math.min(12, 2 + n);
   209	    const pattern = n % 4;
   210	    for (let i = 0; i < count && enemies.length < 18; i++) {
   211	      let x = 65 + ((i * 73 + n * 29) % 260);
   212	      let y = 170 + ((i * 47 + n * 19) % 210);
   213	      let type = i % 5 === 0 && n > 2 ? 'heavy' : i % 7 === 0 && n > 4 ? 'guard' : 'drift';
   214	      if (pattern === 0) { x = 64 + i * (262 / Math.max(1, count - 1)); y = 178 + (i % 2) * 54; }
   215	      if (pattern === 1) { x = 195 + Math.cos(i / Math.max(1, count) * TAU) * 120; y = 275 + Math.sin(i / Math.max(1, count) * TAU) * 105; }
   216	      if (pattern === 2) { x = 58 + (i % 4) * 92 + (Math.floor(i / 4) % 2) * 24; y = 175 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 72; }
   217	      if (boss && i === count - 1) { x = 195; y = 192; type = 'boss'; }
   218	      enemies.push(enemy(x, y, type, type === 'boss' ? (n === 12 ? 13 : 8) : type === 'heavy' ? 2 : type === 'guard' ? 2 : 1));
   219	    }
   220	    if (boss) {
   221	      const wallCount = n === 12 ? 3 : 2;
   222	      for (let i = 0; i < wallCount && walls.length < 6; i++) {
   223	        walls.push({ id: nextId++, x: i === 0 ? 68 : i === 1 ? 195 : 322, y: 300 + (i % 2) * 75, w: 86, h: 13, hp: n === 12 ? 2 : 1, maxHp: n === 12 ? 2 : 1, alive: true, flash: 0 });
   224	      }
   225	    }
   226	    resetPlayer();
   227	    stageStartedAt = performance.now();
   228	    stageSeconds = 0;
   229	    announce.textContent = `Stage ${n}. ${boss ? 'Bank shots through the phase walls.' : 'Clear the formation.'}`;
   230	    renderTeamControls();
   231	  }

   233	  function startAudio() {
   234	    try {
   235	      audioCtx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
   236	      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
   237	      audioReady = true;
   238	    } catch (_) { audioReady = false; }
   239	  }
   240	
   241	  function tone(freq, duration = .08, type = 'sine', volume = .035) {
   242	    if (!audioReady || !audioCtx) return;
   243	    try {
   244	      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
   245	      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
   246	      osc.type = type;
   247	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
   248	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
   249	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
   250	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
   251	      osc.start();
   252	      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
   253	    } catch (_) {}
   254	  }
   255	
   256	  function emit(x, y, color, count = 8, speed = 80, life = .45) {
   257	    const safeCount = Math.min(count, MAX_PARTICLES - particles.length);
   258	    for (let i = 0; i < safeCount; i++) {
   259	      const a = Math.random() * TAU;
   260	      const s = speed * (.35 + Math.random() * .9);
   261	      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life, maxLife: life, size: 1.5 + Math.random() * 3.5, color });
   262	    }
   263	    while (particles.length > MAX_PARTICLES) particles.shift();
   264	  }
   265	
   266	  function addEffect(effect) {
   267	    if (effects.length >= MAX_EFFECTS) effects.shift();
   268	    effects.push(effect);
   269	  }

   271	  function clearStage() {
   272	    if (stageClearQueued || state !== 'play') return;
   273	    stageClearQueued = true;
   274	    state = 'clear';
   275	    const elapsed = Math.max(1, Math.round(stageSeconds));
   276	    const stageGain = Math.max(100, 900 - shotNumber * 55 - elapsed * 4 + combo * 25);
   277	    stageScore = stageGain;
   278	    score += stageGain;
   279	    progress.bestScore = Math.max(progress.bestScore, score);
   280	    progress.bestTime = progress.bestTime === 0 ? elapsed : Math.min(progress.bestTime, elapsed);
   281	    progress.maxStage = Math.max(progress.maxStage, Math.min(12, stage + 1));
   282	    progress.unlocked = Math.min(6, Math.max(progress.unlocked, Math.min(3 + stage, 6)));
   283	    saveProgress();
   284	    emit(195, 300, '#c8ffcf', 42, 150, .95);
   285	    tone(392, .12, 'triangle', .05);
   286	    later(() => {
   287	      if (stage >= 12) {
   288	        state = 'win';
   289	        bootLayer.hidden = true;
   290	        restartButton.textContent = 'Play again';
   291	        announce.textContent = 'All twelve stages cleared. Victory.';
   292	        tone(659, .2, 'triangle', .06);
   293	      } else {
   294	        stage += 1;
   295	        state = 'play';
   296	        buildStage(stage);
   297	        restartButton.textContent = 'Restart';
   298	      }
   299	    }, 760);
   300	  }
   301	
   302	  function failStage() {
   303	    if (state !== 'play') return;
   304	    state = 'fail';
   305	    resetInput();
   306	    restartButton.textContent = 'Retry stage';
   307	    announce.textContent = `Stage ${stage} failed. Team vitality depleted.`;
   308	    flash = .55;
   309	    shake = 12;
   310	    tone(120, .22, 'sawtooth', .055);
   311	  }

   333	    announce.textContent = `Stage ${stage} restarted.`;

   336	  function launch() {
   337	    if (!player || player.launched || state !== 'play' || orientationPaused || audioGate) return;
   338	    const dir = normalize(aim.x, aim.y);
   339	    const power = clamp(170 + (Math.abs(dir.x) + Math.abs(dir.y)) * 36, 180, 245);
   340	    player.vx = dir.x * power;
   341	    player.vy = dir.y * power;
   342	    player.launched = true;
   343	    player.shotTime = 0;
   344	    player.settle = 0;
   345	    player.bounces = 0;
   346	    player.banked = false;
   347	    player.splitUsed = false;
   348	    shotNumber = Math.min(999, shotNumber + 1);
   349	    trails.length = 0;
   350	    emit(player.x, player.y, roster[team[activeSlot]].color, 10, 65, .28);
   351	    tone(210 + Math.abs(dir.x) * 80, .09, 'square', .035);
   352	  }

   354	  function hitEnemy(target, damage, source, normal) {
   355	    if (!target || target.hitCooldown > 0) return;
   356	    if (target.type === 'boss' && !bossWallsCleared() && !(source === 'player' && player.bounces > 0)) return;
   357	    const creature = roster[team[activeSlot]];
   358	    target.hp -= damage;
   359	    target.hitCooldown = .12;
   360	    target.flash = .18;
   361	    combo = Math.min(99, combo + 1);
   362	    score += damage * 12;
   363	    emit(target.x, target.y, target.color, target.type === 'boss' ? 11 : 6, 88, .35);
   364	    tone(target.type === 'boss' ? 130 : 250 + damage * 40, .045, 'square', .022);
   365	    if (target.hp <= 0) {
   366	      const value = target.type === 'boss' ? 500 : target.type === 'heavy' ? 130 : 80;
   367	      score += value;
   368	      emit(target.x, target.y, '#fdf0bc', target.type === 'boss' ? 26 : 12, 150, .7);
   369	      shake = Math.max(shake, target.type === 'boss' ? 10 : 4);
   370	      enemies = enemies.filter((item) => item !== target);
   800	    } else if (effect.kind === 'pop') {
   801	      ctx.strokeStyle = effect.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(effect.x, effect.y, (1 - p) * 38, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
   802	    }
   803	    ctx.restore();
   804	  }
   805	
   806	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lineWidth) {
   807	    ctx.beginPath();
   808	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); ctx.closePath();
   809	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   810	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth; ctx.stroke(); }
   811	  }
   812	
   813	  function polygon(...points) {
   814	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(points[0], points[1]);
   815	    for (let i = 2; i < points.length; i += 2) ctx.lineTo(points[i], points[i + 1]);
   816	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   817	  }

   819	  function renderTeamControls() {
   820	    teamControls.replaceChildren();
   821	    roster.forEach((info, id) => {
   822	      const button = document.createElement('button');
   823	      button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'team-button'; button.dataset.id = String(id); button.style.setProperty('--button-color', info.color);
   824	      button.innerHTML = `<span class="sigil">${info.sigil}</span><span>${info.short}</span>`;
   825	      const unlocked = id < progress.unlocked;
   826	      const selected = team.includes(id);
   827	      button.disabled = !unlocked;
   828	      button.classList.toggle('locked', !unlocked); button.classList.toggle('active', selected && team[activeSlot] === id);
   829	      button.title = unlocked ? `${info.name}: ${info.passive}. Tap to make your next fang.` : 'Unlock by clearing stages';
   830	      if (unlocked) {
   831	        button.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   832	          event.preventDefault();
   833	          if (buttonPointers.has(id) || state === 'clear' || state === 'win' || state === 'fail') return;
   834	          buttonPointers.set(id, event.pointerId);
   835	          try { button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   836	        }, { passive: false });
   837	        button.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
   838	          event.preventDefault();
   839	          if (buttonPointers.get(id) !== event.pointerId) return;
   840	          buttonPointers.delete(id);
   841	          if (state === 'play' && player && !player.launched) selectCreature(id);
   842	        }, { passive: false });
   843	        button.addEventListener('pointercancel', (event) => { if (buttonPointers.get(id) === event.pointerId) buttonPointers.delete(id); }, { passive: false });
   844	        button.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', () => { buttonPointers.delete(id); });
   845	        button.addEventListener('click', (event) => { if (event.detail === 0 && state === 'play' && player && !player.launched) selectCreature(id); });
   846	      }
   847	      teamControls.appendChild(button);
   848	    });
   849	  }
   850	
   851	  function selectCreature(id) {
   852	    if (id < 0 || id >= progress.unlocked || state !== 'play' || player?.launched) return;
   853	    const existing = team.indexOf(id);
   854	    if (existing >= 0) activeSlot = existing;
   855	    else {
   856	      team[activeSlot] = id;
   857	      activeSlot = clamp(activeSlot, 0, 2);
   858	    }
   859	    resetPlayer();
   860	    renderTeamControls();
   861	    announce.textContent = `${roster[id].name} selected. Passive: ${roster[id].passive.toLowerCase()}.`;
   862	  }
   863	
   864	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   865	    if (orientationPaused || audioGate || state !== 'play' || !player || player.launched) return;
   866	    event.preventDefault();
   867	    if (aimPointerId !== null) return;
   868	    const p = worldPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
   869	    if (Math.hypot(p.x - player.x, p.y - player.y) > 34) return;
   870	    aimPointerId = event.pointerId;
   871	    aimStart = { x: p.x, y: p.y };
   872	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   873	  }
   874	
   875	  function onPointerMove(event) {
   876	    if (event.pointerId !== aimPointerId || !aimStart || !player || player.launched) return;
   877	    event.preventDefault();
   878	    const p = worldPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
   879	    const dragX = aimStart.x - p.x;
   880	    const dragY = aimStart.y - p.y;
   881	    if (Math.hypot(dragX, dragY) > 5) aim = normalize(dragX, dragY);
   882	  }
   883	
   884	  function endPointer(event, shouldLaunch) {
   885	    if (event.pointerId !== aimPointerId) return;
   886	    event.preventDefault();
   887	    aimPointerId = null; aimStart = null;
   888	    if (shouldLaunch) launch();
   889	  }
   890	
   891	  function handleKeyDown(event) {
   892	    if (audioGate && (event.key === ' ' || event.key === 'Enter')) {
   893	      event.preventDefault();
   894	      boot();
   895	      return;
   896	    }
   897	    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'ArrowUp' || event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === ' ') {
   898	      event.preventDefault();
   899	      keys.add(event.key);
   900	      if (event.key === ' ' && !event.repeat && queuedActions.length < 8) queuedActions.push('launch');
   901	    }
   902	    if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') restartButton.click();
   903	  }

   905	  function releaseAllInput() { resetInput(); }
   906	
   907	  function boot() {
   908	    startAudio();
   909	    cancelTimers();
   910	    audioGate = false;
   911	    bootLayer.hidden = true;
   912	    resetInput();
   913	    stage = clampInt(progress.maxStage, 1, 12, 1);
   914	    makeTeam();
   915	    buildStage(stage);
   916	    announce.textContent = 'Arena awake. Drag from the glowing fang.';
   917	    tone(260, .08, 'triangle', .035);
   918	  }
   919	
   920	  bootButton.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (bootPointerId !== null) return; bootPointerId = event.pointerId; try { bootButton.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {} }, { passive: false });
   921	  bootButton.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (bootPointerId !== event.pointerId) return; bootPointerId = null; boot(); }, { passive: false });
   922	  bootButton.addEventListener('pointercancel', (event) => { if (bootPointerId === event.pointerId) bootPointerId = null; try { bootButton.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {} }, { passive: false });

   939	  function boardCell(px, py) {
   940	    var x = Math.floor((px - BX) / CELL), y = Math.floor((py - BY) / CELL);
   941	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > 7 || y > 7) return null;
   942	    return { x: x, y: y };
   943	  }
   944	
   945	  /* ---------------- pointer handling (per-id) ---------------- */
   946	  function onDown(e) {
   947	    if (paused) return;
   948	    var p = toDesign(e);
   949	    var b = hitButton(p.x, p.y);
   950	    var rec = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, btn: b ? b.id : null, cell: null, moved: false };
   951	    if (!b && screen === 'play' && !result && phase === 'idle') {
   952	      rec.cell = boardCell(p.x, p.y);
   953	      if (rec.cell) {
   954	        if (boosterArmed >= 0) {
   955	          useBooster(boosterArmed, rec.cell.x, rec.cell.y);
   956	          rec.cell = null;
   957	        } else if (st.canSwapCell(rec.cell.x, rec.cell.y)) {
   958	          sel = { x: rec.cell.x, y: rec.cell.y };
   959	          cur.x = rec.cell.x; cur.y = rec.cell.y;
   960	        }
   961	      }
   962	    }
   963	    pointers[e.pointerId] = rec;
   964	  }
   965	
   966	  function onMove(e) {
   967	    var rec = pointers[e.pointerId];
   968	    if (!rec || paused) return;
   969	    var p = toDesign(e);
   970	    rec.x = p.x; rec.y = p.y;
   971	    if (!rec.cell || rec.moved) return;
   972	    var dx = p.x - rec.sx, dy = p.y - rec.sy;
   973	    if (Math.abs(dx) < 14 && Math.abs(dy) < 14) return;
   974	    rec.moved = true;
   975	    var tx = rec.cell.x, ty = rec.cell.y;
   976	    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) tx += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   977	    else ty += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   978	    trySwap(rec.cell.x, rec.cell.y, tx, ty);
   979	  }
   980	
   981	  function onUp(e) {
   982	    var rec = pointers[e.pointerId];
   983	    delete pointers[e.pointerId];
   984	    if (!rec || paused) return;
   985	    if (rec.btn) {
   986	      var b = hitButton(rec.x, rec.y);
   987	      if (b && b.id === rec.btn) act(rec.btn);
   988	      return;
   989	    }
   990	    // tap-to-select then tap-neighbour to swap
   991	    if (rec.cell && !rec.moved) {
   992	      var c = boardCell(rec.x, rec.y);
   993	      if (c && sel && (Math.abs(c.x - sel.x) + Math.abs(c.y - sel.y)) === 1) trySwap(sel.x, sel.y, c.x, c.y);
   994	      else if (c && sel && c.x === sel.x && c.y === sel.y) { /* keep selection */ }
   995	    }
   996	  }

  1003	  function onKey(e) {

  1006	    if (keys[k] && k !== 'ArrowLeft' && k !== 'ArrowRight' && k !== 'ArrowUp' && k !== 'ArrowDown') return;

  1009	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') dx = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowRight') dx = 1;

  1016	      return;
  1017	    }
  1018	    if (result) {

  1020	      else if (k === 'Escape') act('back');
  1021	      e.preventDefault();
  1022	      return;
  1023	    }
  1024	    if (dx || dy) {
  1025	      e.preventDefault();
  1026	      if (sel && phase === 'idle') { trySwap(sel.x, sel.y, sel.x + dx, sel.y + dy); cur.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.x + dx)); cur.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.y + dy)); }
  1027	      else { cur.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.x + dx)); cur.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.y + dy)); }

  1030	    }
  1031	    if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {

  1036	      return;
  1037	    }
  1038	    if (k === 'Escape') { if (boosterArmed >= 0) boosterArmed = -1; else if (sel) sel = null; else act('back'); e.preventDefault(); }
  1039	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') act('retry');
  1040	    if (k === '1' || k === '2' || k === '3') act('b' + (parseInt(k, 10) - 1));
  1041	  }

   118	    context.moveTo(x + r, y);

   233	    activePointers.clear();
   234	    heldKeys.clear();
   235	    queuedActions.length = 0;
   236	    if (game) {
   237	      game.keyboardPlate = null;
   238	      game.keyboardDrag = false;
   239	    }
   240	  }
   241	
   242	  function unlockAudio() {
   243	    if (audioUnlocked) return;
   244	    try {
   245	      var AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   246	      if (AudioCtor) {
   247	        audioContext = new AudioCtor();
   248	        if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume();
   249	        var gain = audioContext.createGain();
   250	        gain.gain.value = .0001;
   251	        gain.connect(audioContext.destination);
   252	        var oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   253	        oscillator.frequency.value = 440;
   254	        oscillator.connect(gain);
   255	        oscillator.start();
   256	        oscillator.stop(audioContext.currentTime + .02);
   257	      }
   258	    } catch (error) {
   259	      audioContext = null;
   260	    }
   380	  function serveCustomer(customer) {
   381	    if (!customer || customer.served || customer.leaving) return false;
   382	    customer.served = true;
   383	    customer.leave = .75;
   384	    game.servedThisWave += 1;
   385	    game.totalServed += 1;
   386	    var tip = 7 + game.wave * 2 + Math.ceil(customer.patience);
   387	    var streakBonus = Math.min(10, game.servedThisWave);
   388	    game.gold += tip;
   389	    game.score += tip * 10 + streakBonus * 3;
   390	    game.best = Math.max(game.best, game.score);
   391	    game.flash = .18;
   392	    game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, 2.5);
   393	    var rect = tableRects[customer.table];
   394	    burst(rect.x + rect.w / 2, rect.y + 58, palette.gold, 14);
   395	    floatText('+' + tip + ' coins', rect.x + rect.w / 2, rect.y + 20, palette.gold);
   396	    playSound('serve');
   397	    safeSave();
   398	    return true;
   399	  }
   400	
   401	  function updateRush(dt) {
   402	    game.elapsed += dt;
   403	    game.waveTimer -= dt;
   404	    game.spawnTimer -= dt;
   405	    if (game.messageTimer > 0) game.messageTimer -= dt;
   406	    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 9);
   407	    game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt * 2.8);
   408	    for (var s = 0; s < game.stationPulse.length; s += 1) game.stationPulse[s] = Math.max(0, game.stationPulse[s] - dt);
   409	
   410	    if (game.spawnTimer <= 0 && game.spawned < game.targetCustomers) {
   411	      spawnCustomer();
   412	      game.spawnTimer = (2.1 - Math.min(.55, game.wave * .08)) / game.speed;
   413	    }
   414	    autoWork(dt);
   415	
   416	    for (var c = game.customers.length - 1; c >= 0; c -= 1) {
   417	      var customer = game.customers[c];
   418	      customer.bounce = Math.max(0, customer.bounce - dt * 3);
   419	      if (customer.served) {
   420	        customer.leave -= dt;
   421	        if (customer.leave <= 0) game.customers.splice(c, 1);
   422	      } else if (!customer.leaving) {
   423	        customer.patience -= dt;
   424	        if (customer.patience <= 0) {
   425	          customer.leaving = true;
   426	          customer.leave = .65;
   427	          game.walkouts += 1;
   428	          game.score = Math.max(0, game.score - 40);
   429	          game.shake = 6;
   430	          game.flash = .12;
   431	          var walkRect = tableRects[customer.table];
   432	          burst(walkRect.x + walkRect.w / 2, walkRect.y + 55, palette.red, 12);
   433	          floatText('walkout!', walkRect.x + walkRect.w / 2, walkRect.y + 18, palette.red);
   434	          playSound('miss');
   435	          if (game.walkouts >= 3) {
   436	            game.state = 'failed';
   437	            clearInputState();
   438	            safeSave();
   439	            return;
   440	          }
   441	        }
   442	      } else {
   443	        customer.leave -= dt;
   444	        if (customer.leave <= 0) game.customers.splice(c, 1);
   445	      }
   446	    }
   447	
   448	    for (var p = 0; p < game.plates.length; p += 1) game.plates[p].age += dt;
   449	    if (game.waveTimer <= 0 && game.spawned >= game.targetCustomers && game.customers.length === 0) {
   450	      game.state = 'waveClear';
   451	      clearInputState();
   452	      game.best = Math.max(game.best, game.score);
   453	      safeSave();
   454	      playSound('upgrade');
   455	    }
   456	  }
   457	
   458	  function buyUpgrade() {
   459	    if (!game || game.state !== 'rush') return;
   460	    if (game.upgrades >= upgradeNames.length) return;
   461	    var cost = upgradeCosts[game.upgrades];
   462	    if (game.gold < cost) {
   463	      game.waveMessage = 'Serve a few more tables';
   464	      game.messageTimer = 1.2;
   465	      playSound('miss');
   466	      return;
   467	    }
   468	    game.gold -= cost;
   469	    game.upgrades += 1;
   470	    game.flash = .3;
   471	    burst(195, 602, palette.gold, 18);
   472	    floatText('SYSTEM +' + game.upgrades, 195, 567, palette.gold);
   473	    playSound('upgrade');
   474	    safeSave();
   475	    if (game.upgrades >= upgradeNames.length) {
   476	      game.state = 'prestige';
   477	      clearInputState();
   478	    }
   479	  }
   480	
   481	  function nextWave() {
   482	    game.wave += 1;
   483	    resetWave();
   484	    safeSave();
   485	    playSound('start');
   486	  }

   488	  function prestige() {
   489	    game.prestige += 1;
   490	    game.shopTier = Math.min(9, game.shopTier + 1);
   491	    game.speed = 1 + game.prestige * .12;
   492	    game.gold = 0;
   493	    game.wave = 1;
   494	    game.score = 0;
   495	    game.upgrades = 0;
   496	    game.state = 'rush';
   497	    safeSave();
   498	    resetWave();
   499	    burst(195, 278, palette.gold, 32);
   500	    playSound('prestige');
   501	  }

   503	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   504	    var amount = Math.min(count, 24);
   505	    for (var i = 0; i < amount; i += 1) {
   506	      if (game.particles.length >= 120) game.particles.shift();
   507	      var angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
   508	      var speed = 18 + random() * 55;
   509	      game.particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18, life: .35 + random() * .45, max: .8, size: 1.5 + random() * 3.2, color: color });
   510	    }
   511	  }

   513	  function floatText(value, x, y, color) {
   514	    if (game.floaters.length >= 20) game.floaters.shift();
   515	    game.floaters.push({ value: value, x: x, y: y, color: color || palette.cream, life: 1 });
   516	  }

   518	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   519	    for (var i = game.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   520	      var particle = game.particles[i];
   780	    text(game.upgrades + '/12', 376, y + 18, 10, palette.gold, 800, 'right');
   781	    var cellW = 115;
   782	    var cellH = 28;

   798	      if (next) text(upgradeCosts[i] + '¢', x + cellW - 7, cellY + 12, 8, palette.gold, 800, 'right');
   799	      if (active) text('✓', x + cellW - 8, cellY + 12, 10, palette.mint, 800, 'right');
   800	    }
   801	    var action = game.upgrades >= 12 ? 'READY — TAP TO PRESTIGE' : 'BUY NEXT AUTOMATION';

   803	    ctx.fillStyle = game.upgrades >= 12 ? 'rgba(118,209,174,.18)' : 'rgba(244,201,115,.1)';
   804	    roundRect(ctx, 12, 672, 366, 20, 10);

   809	  function drawEffects() {
   810	    for (var i = 0; i < game.particles.length; i += 1) {
   811	      var particle = game.particles[i];
   812	      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(particle.life / particle.max, 0, 1);
   813	      ctx.fillStyle = particle.color;
   814	      ctx.fillRect(particle.x, particle.y, particle.size, particle.size);
   815	    }
   816	    for (var j = 0; j < game.floaters.length; j += 1) {
   817	      var floater = game.floaters[j];
   818	      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(floater.life, 0, 1);
   819	      text(floater.value, floater.x, floater.y, 10, floater.color, 800, 'center');
   820	    }
   821	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   822	  }

   824	  function drawDraggedPlate(pointer) {
   825	    if (!pointer || pointer.kind !== 'plate') return;
   826	    ctx.save();
   827	    ctx.globalAlpha = .92;
   828	    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
   829	    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
   830	    ctx.fillStyle = palette.cream;
   831	    ctx.beginPath();
   832	    ctx.ellipse(pointer.x, pointer.y, 27, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   833	    ctx.fill();
   834	    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
   835	    ctx.fillStyle = palette.coral;
   836	    ctx.beginPath();
   837	    ctx.arc(pointer.x - 5, pointer.y - 2, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   838	    ctx.fill();
   839	    ctx.fillStyle = palette.mint;
   840	    ctx.beginPath();
   841	    ctx.arc(pointer.x + 7, pointer.y - 2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   842	    ctx.fill();
   843	    ctx.restore();
   844	  }

   900	  function draw() {
   901	    if (!game) return;
   902	    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0);
   903	    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, view.cssW, view.cssH);
   904	    ctx.save();
   905	    ctx.translate(view.ox, view.oy);
   906	    ctx.scale(view.scale, view.scale);
   907	    ctx.save();
   908	    if (game.shake > 0) ctx.translate((random() - .5) * game.shake, (random() - .5) * game.shake);
   909	    drawBackground();
   910	    drawHeader();
   930	    view.scale = Math.min(view.cssW / W, view.cssH / H);
   931	    view.ox = (view.cssW - W * view.scale) / 2;
   932	    view.oy = (view.cssH - H * view.scale) / 2;
   933	    view.dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / Math.max(view.cssW, view.cssH));
   934	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(view.cssW * view.dpr));
   935	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(view.cssH * view.dpr));
   936	  }

   938	  function syncOrientation() {
   939	    var isLandscape = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   940	    rotateOverlay.hidden = !isLandscape;
   941	    if (game.orientationPaused !== isLandscape) {
   942	      game.orientationPaused = isLandscape;
   943	      clearInputState();
   944	      lastFrame = performance.now();
   945	    }
   946	  }
   947	
   948	  function toWorld(event) {
   949	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   950	    return {
   951	      x: clamp((event.clientX - rect.left - view.ox) / view.scale, 0, W),
   952	      y: clamp((event.clientY - rect.top - view.oy) / view.scale, 0, H)
   953	    };
   954	  }
   955	
   956	  function inside(point, rect) {
   957	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   958	  }
   959	
   960	  function tableAt(point) {
   961	    for (var i = 0; i < tableRects.length; i += 1) if (inside(point, tableRects[i])) return i;
   962	    return -1;
   963	  }
   964	
   965	  function plateAt(point) {
   966	    if (!inside(point, stationRects[2])) return null;
   967	    if (!game.plates.length) return null;
   968	    var centerX = stationRects[2].x + 58;
   969	    var centerY = stationRects[2].y + 63;
   970	    if (Math.abs(point.x - centerX) < 42 && Math.abs(point.y - centerY) < 27) return game.plates[game.plates.length - 1];
   971	    return null;
   972	  }
   973	
   974	  function pointerDown(event) {
   975	    event.preventDefault();
   976	    if (game.orientationPaused) return;
   977	    var point = toWorld(event);
   978	    var pointer = { id: event.pointerId, kind: 'none', x: point.x, y: point.y, station: -1, plateId: null, nextAction: 0 };
   979	    var table = tableAt(point);
   980	    if (game.state !== 'rush') {
   981	      if (game.state === 'failed' && point.x >= 45 && point.x <= 345 && point.y >= 350 && point.y <= 650) restartFromFail();
   982	      else if (game.state === 'waveClear') nextWave();
   983	      else if (game.state === 'prestige') prestige();
   984	      return;
   985	    }
   986	    if (point.y >= 672) {
   987	      buyUpgrade();
   988	      return;
   989	    }
   990	    var plate = plateAt(point);
   991	    if (plate) {
   992	      pointer.kind = 'plate';
   993	      pointer.plateId = plate.id;
   994	      pointer.x = point.x;
   995	      pointer.y = point.y;
   996	      activePointers.set(event.pointerId, pointer);
   997	      try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
   998	      return;
   999	    }
  1000	    for (var i = 0; i < stationRects.length; i += 1) {
  1001	      if (inside(point, stationRects[i])) {
  1002	        game.selectedStation = i;
  1003	        pointer.kind = 'station';
  1004	        pointer.station = i;
  1005	        pointer.nextAction = 0;
  1006	        activePointers.set(event.pointerId, pointer);
  1007	        try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1008	        stationAction(i);
  1009	        return;
  1010	      }
  1011	    }
  1012	    if (table >= 0) {
  1013	      game.selectedTable = table;
  1014	      var customer = game.customers.find(function (item) { return item.table === table && !item.served && !item.leaving; });
  1015	      if (customer) customer.bounce = .3;
  1016	    }
  1017	    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, pointer);
  1018	  }
  1019	
  1020	  function pointerMove(event) {
  1021	    event.preventDefault();
  1022	    var pointer = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1023	    if (!pointer) return;
  1024	    var point = toWorld(event);
  1025	    pointer.x = point.x;
  1026	    pointer.y = point.y;
  1027	  }
  1028	
  1029	  function pointerUp(event) {
  1030	    event.preventDefault();
  1031	    var pointer = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1032	    if (!pointer) return;
  1033	    if (pointer.kind === 'plate' && game.state === 'rush') {
  1034	      var table = tableAt({ x: pointer.x, y: pointer.y });
  1035	      var plateIndex = game.plates.findIndex(function (plate) { return plate.id === pointer.plateId; });
  1036	      if (plateIndex >= 0 && table >= 0) {
  1037	        var customer = game.customers.find(function (item) { return item.table === table; });
  1038	        if (serveCustomer(customer)) {
  1039	          game.plates.splice(plateIndex, 1);
  1040	          game.bakedStock = Math.max(0, game.bakedStock - 1);
  1041	        }
  1042	      }
  1043	    }
  1044	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1045	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1046	  }
  1047	
  1048	  function pointerCancel(event) {
  1049	    event.preventDefault();
  1050	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1051	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1052	  }
  1053	
  1054	  function restartFromFail() {
  1055	    resetWave();
  1056	    playSound('start');
  1057	  }
  1058	
  1059	  function keyDown(event) {
  1060	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Space', 'Enter'].indexOf(event.code) >= 0 || /^Digit[123]$/.test(event.code) || event.code === 'KeyR') event.preventDefault();
  1061	    if (heldKeys.has(event.code)) return;
  1062	    heldKeys.add(event.code);
  1063	    if (game.orientationPaused) return;
  1064	    if (game.state !== 'rush') {
  1065	      if (event.code === 'KeyR' || event.code === 'Enter' || event.code === 'Space') {
  1066	        if (game.state === 'failed') restartFromFail();
  1067	        else if (game.state === 'waveClear') nextWave();
  1068	        else if (game.state === 'prestige') prestige();
  1069	      }
  1070	      return;
  1071	    }
  1072	    if (event.code === 'Digit1') { game.selectedStation = 0; stationAction(0); }
  1073	    if (event.code === 'Digit2') { game.selectedStation = 1; stationAction(1); }
  1074	    if (event.code === 'Digit3') { game.selectedStation = 2; }
  1075	    if (event.code === 'ArrowLeft') game.selectedStation = (game.selectedStation + 2) % 3;
  1076	    if (event.code === 'ArrowRight') game.selectedStation = (game.selectedStation + 1) % 3;
  1077	    if (event.code === 'ArrowUp') { game.selectedTable = (game.selectedTable + 2) % 3; }
  1078	    if (event.code === 'ArrowDown') { game.selectedTable = (game.selectedTable + 1) % 3; }
  1079	    if (event.code === 'Space' || event.code === 'Enter') {
  1080	      if (game.selectedStation === 2) {
  1081	        var customer = game.customers.find(function (item) { return item.table === game.selectedTable; });
  1082	        var plate = game.plates[game.plates.length - 1];
  1083	        if (plate && serveCustomer(customer)) {
  1084	          game.plates.pop();
  1085	          game.bakedStock = Math.max(0, game.bakedStock - 1);
  1086	        }
  1087	      } else stationAction(game.selectedStation);
  1088	    }
  1089	  }
  1090	
  1091	  function keyUp(event) {
  1092	    heldKeys.delete(event.code);

   424	    if (blockedByOrientation) return;
   425	    var p = pointerPos(e); activePointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: p.x, y: p.y, points: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }], mode: null });
   426	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
   427	    if (state === 'match' && match) {
   428	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.stick) && setControl('stick', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'stick'; updateStick(p); return; }
   429	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.pass) && setControl('pass', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'pass'; return; }
   430	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.shoot) && setControl('shoot', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'shoot'; return; }
   431	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.switch) && setControl('switch', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'switch'; return; }
   432	      if (p.y >= field.t && p.y <= field.b && setControl('gesture', e.pointerId)) {
   433	        var carrier = match.own.find(function (q) { return q.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   434	        if (carrier && dist(p, carrier) < 64) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'gesture'; match.drag = { start: p, points: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }] }; }
   435	        else { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'defender'; }
   436	      }
   437	    } else { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'ui'; }
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  function updateStick(p) {
   441	    if (!match) return;
   442	    var c = { x: 64, y: 650 }, v = norm(p.x - c.x, p.y - c.y), d = clamp(Math.hypot(p.x - c.x, p.y - c.y) / 44, 0, 1);
   443	    match.stick = { x: v.x * d, y: v.y * d };
   444	  }
   445	
   446	  function onPointerMove(e) {
   447	    e.preventDefault(); var rec = activePointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!rec) return; var p = pointerPos(e);
   448	    if (rec.points.length < 20) rec.points.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y });
   449	    if (rec.mode === 'stick') updateStick(p);
   450	    if (rec.mode === 'gesture' && match && match.drag) match.drag.points = rec.points.slice(-20);
   451	  }
   452	
   453	  function onPointerUp(e, cancelled) {
   454	    e.preventDefault(); var rec = activePointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!rec) return; var p = pointerPos(e);
   455	    activePointers.delete(e.pointerId); releaseControl(e.pointerId);
   456	    if (cancelled) { if (rec.mode === 'stick' && match) match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 }; if (match) match.drag = null; return; }
   457	    if (state === 'match' && match) {
   458	      if (rec.mode === 'pass') passBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0);
   459	      else if (rec.mode === 'shoot') shootBall(0, -1, 0);
   460	      else if (rec.mode === 'switch') switchDefender(match.ball.x, match.ball.y);
   461	      else if (rec.mode === 'stick') match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 };
   462	      else if (rec.mode === 'gesture') {
   463	        var start = rec.points[0], dx = p.x - start.x, dy = p.y - start.y, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   464	        var curve = rec.points.reduce(function (acc, q, i) { if (!i) return acc; var prev = rec.points[i - 1]; return acc + (q.x - prev.x) * (q.y - start.y) - (q.y - prev.y) * (q.x - start.x); }, 0) / 5000;
   465	        if (len > 18) { if (dy < -22 && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 0.45) shootBall(dx, dy, clamp(curve, -1, 1)); else passBall(dx, dy, clamp(curve, -1, 1)); }
   466	        else { switchDefender(p.x, p.y); }
   467	        match.drag = null;
   468	      } else if (rec.mode === 'defender') switchDefender(p.x, p.y);
   469	    } else handleUiTap(p);
   470	  }
   471	
   472	  function handleUiTap(p) {
   473	    var area = Object.keys(hitAreas).find(function (key) { return key !== 'stick' && key !== 'pass' && key !== 'shoot' && inRect(p, hitAreas[key]); });
   474	    if (area === 'start') { if (state === 'menu') state = 'lineup'; else if (state === 'loss') replayMatch(); else if (state === 'trophy') newCup(); sound('ui'); }
   475	    else if (area === 'fixture') { if (state === 'lineup' && selected.length === 5) startMatch(); }
   476	    else if (area && area.indexOf('player-') === 0) togglePlayer(Number(area.slice(7)));
   477	  }
   478	
   479	  function togglePlayer(index) {
   480	    if (index < 0 || index >= roster.length) return;
   481	    if (selectedSet.has(index)) { if (selected.length <= 5) return; selected = selected.filter(function (n) { return n !== index; }); selectedSet.delete(index); }
   482	    else if (selected.length < 5) { selected.push(index); selectedSet.add(index); }
   483	    save(); sound('ui');
   484	  }
