   486	  function keyDown(e) {
   487	    if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'j', 'k', 'J', 'K', ' '].indexOf(e.key) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   488	    unlockAudio();
   489	    if (e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'J') { keys.add('j'); if (state === 'match') passBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0); }
   490	    else if (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K') { keys.add('k'); if (state === 'match') shootBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0); }
   491	    else if (e.key === ' ') { if (state === 'match') tackle(); else handleUiTap({ x: 195, y: 540 }); }
   492	    else keys.add(e.key);
   493	  }
   494	
   495	  function keyUp(e) { keys.delete(e.key); }

   497	  function draw() {
   498	    ctx.setTransform(pxScale, 0, 0, pxScale, 0, 0);
   499	    ctx.fillStyle = '#091217'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);
   500	    ctx.setTransform(pxScale * viewScale, 0, 0, pxScale * viewScale, pxScale * viewX, pxScale * viewY);
   501	    var sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
   502	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, sy); drawScene(); ctx.restore();
   503	    if (flash > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,201,' + Math.min(0.22, flash * 0.18) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); }
   504	    if (blockedByOrientation) drawRotateOverlay();
   505	  }

   586	  function drawPitch() {
   587	    roundRect(field.l, field.t, field.r - field.l, field.b - field.t, 17, COLORS.grass, '#7bc696');

   589	    for (var y = field.t; y < field.b; y += 46) { ctx.fillStyle = (Math.floor((y - field.t) / 46) % 2) ? COLORS.grass2 : COLORS.grass; ctx.fillRect(field.l, y, field.r - field.l, 46); }
   590	    ctx.restore();
   591	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,244,192,.65)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(field.l, field.mid); ctx.lineTo(field.r, field.mid); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(195, field.mid, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,255,210,.7)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(195, field.mid, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

   649	  function addBurst(x, y, color, count) {
   650	    count = Math.min(count || 8, 30);
   651	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: rand(-100, 100), vy: rand(-100, 100), life: rand(0.3, 0.8), max: 0.8, color: color, size: rand(2, 5) });
   652	    if (particles.length > 160) particles.splice(0, particles.length - 160);
   653	  }
   654	  function addText(x, y, value, color, life) { texts.push({ x: x, y: y, value: value, color: color, life: life || 1, max: life || 1 }); if (texts.length > 24) texts.shift(); }
   655	  function updateParticles(dt) { particles.forEach(function (p) { p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= 0.96; p.vy *= 0.96; }); particles = particles.filter(function (p) { return p.life > 0; }).slice(-160); }
   656	  function updateTexts(dt) { texts.forEach(function (t) { t.life -= dt; t.y -= 18 * dt; }); texts = texts.filter(function (t) { return t.life > 0; }).slice(-24); }
   657	  function drawParticles() { particles.forEach(function (p) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1); ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size); }); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
   658	  function drawTexts() { texts.forEach(function (t) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(t.life / t.max, 0, 1); text(t.value, t.x, t.y, 11, t.color, 'center', 800); }); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
   659	
   660	  function resize() {
   661	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); cssW = rect.width || W; cssH = rect.height || H;
   662	    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2), longAxis = Math.max(cssW, cssH); pxScale = Math.min(dpr, 960 / Math.max(1, longAxis));
   663	    viewScale = Math.min(cssW / W, cssH / H); viewX = (cssW - W * viewScale) / 2; viewY = (cssH - H * viewScale) / 2;
   664	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cssW * pxScale)); canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cssH * pxScale));
   665	    blockedByOrientation = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   666	    previous = performance.now();
   667	  }
   668	
   669	  function loop(now) {
   670	    var dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0, (now - previous) / 1000)); previous = now;
   671	    if (!blockedByOrientation) update(dt);
   672	    draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop);
   673	  }

   675	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: false });
   676	  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
   677	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { onPointerUp(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   678	  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (e) { onPointerUp(e, true); }, { passive: false });
   679	  window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown, { passive: false }); window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
   680	  window.addEventListener('blur', resetInputs); window.addEventListener('resize', resize); window.addEventListener('orientationchange', resize);
   681	  resize(); requestAnimationFrame(loop);
   682	}());

     2	(function (g) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	
     5	  var Input = {
     6	    el: null,
     7	    pointers: new Map(),      // pointerId -> {x0,y0,x,y,t0,fired}

    17	
    18	      this._pd = function (e) { self.onDown(e); };
    19	      this._pm = function (e) { self.onMove(e); };
    20	      this._pu = function (e) { self.onUp(e); };
    21	      this._pc = function (e) { self.onCancel(e); };
    22	
    23	      if (window.PointerEvent) {

    26	        window.addEventListener('pointerup', this._pu, opt);

    28	        el.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', this._pc, opt);

    31	        el.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { self.touch(e, 'move'); }, opt);
    32	        window.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { self.touch(e, 'up'); }, opt);
    33	        window.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { self.touch(e, 'cancel'); }, opt);
    34	        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { self.mouse(e, 'down'); }, opt);
    35	        window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { self.mouse(e, 'move'); }, opt);
    36	        window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { self.mouse(e, 'up'); }, opt);
    37	      }
    38	
    39	      el.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
    40	      el.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, opt);
    41	
    42	      window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { self.onKey(e, true); });
    43	      window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { self.onKey(e, false); });
    44	      window.addEventListener('blur', function () { self.releaseAll(); });
    45	      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
    46	        if (document.hidden) self.releaseAll();
    47	      });
    48	    },

    50	    touch: function (e, kind) {

    53	      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    54	        var t = list[i];
    55	        var fake = { pointerId: 'T' + t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY, preventDefault: function () { } };
    56	        if (kind === 'down') this.onDown(fake);
    57	        else if (kind === 'move') this.onMove(fake);
    58	        else if (kind === 'up') this.onUp(fake);
    59	        else this.onCancel(fake);
    60	      }
    61	    },
    62	    mouse: function (e, kind) {
    63	      var fake = { pointerId: 'M', clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY, preventDefault: function () { } };
    64	      if (kind === 'down') { e.preventDefault(); this.onDown(fake); }
    65	      else if (kind === 'move') { if (this.pointers.has('M')) this.onMove(fake); }
    66	      else this.onUp(fake);
    67	    },
    68	
    69	    onDown: function (e) {
    70	      if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    71	      if (!this.enabled) return;
    72	      var id = e.pointerId;
    73	      this.pointers.set(id, { x0: e.clientX, y0: e.clientY, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, t0: performance.now(), fired: false });
    74	      if (this.el && this.el.setPointerCapture && typeof id === 'number') {
    75	        try { this.el.setPointerCapture(id); } catch (err) { }
    76	      }
    77	    },
    78	    onMove: function (e) {
    79	      if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    80	      var p = this.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
    81	      if (!p) return;
    82	      p.x = e.clientX; p.y = e.clientY;
    83	      if (p.fired) return;
    84	      var dx = p.x - p.x0, dy = p.y - p.y0;
    85	      if (Math.abs(dx) < this.SWIPE && Math.abs(dy) < this.SWIPE) return;
    86	      p.fired = true;
    87	      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) this.push(dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left');
    88	      else this.push(dy > 0 ? 'down' : 'up');
    89	    },
    90	    onUp: function (e) {
    91	      var p = this.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
    92	      if (!p) return;
    93	      this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    94	      if (!p.fired && this.enabled) {
    95	        var dt = performance.now() - p.t0;
    96	        var dx = (e.clientX || p.x) - p.x0, dy = (e.clientY || p.y) - p.y0;
    97	        if (dt < 400 && Math.abs(dx) < this.SWIPE && Math.abs(dy) < this.SWIPE) this.push('up'); // tap = vault
    98	      }
    99	    },
   100	    onCancel: function (e) { this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId); },
   101	
   102	    onKey: function (e, down) {

   104	      var map = {
   105	        ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', A: 'left',
   106	        ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right', D: 'right',
   107	        ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', W: 'up', ' ': 'up',
   108	        ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down', S: 'down'
   109	      };
   110	      var act = map[k];
   111	      if (act) {
   112	        e.preventDefault();

   114	        if (down) this.keys.add(k); else this.keys.delete(k);
   115	        return;
   116	      }
   117	      if (!down) this.keys.delete(k);
   118	      if (down && (k === 'p' || k === 'P' || k === 'Escape')) {
   119	        if (typeof this.onPause === 'function') this.onPause();
   120	      }
   121	      if (down && (k === 'r' || k === 'R')) {
   122	        if (typeof this.onRestart === 'function') this.onRestart();
   123	      }
   124	      if (down && (k === 'm' || k === 'M')) {
   125	        g.TD.Audio.muted = !g.TD.Audio.muted;
   126	      }
   127	    },
   128	
   129	    push: function (a) { if (this.queue.length < 6) this.queue.push(a); },
   130	    take: function () { return this.queue.length ? this.queue.shift() : null; },
   131	
   132	    releaseAll: function () {
   133	      this.pointers.clear();
   134	      this.keys.clear();
   135	      this.queue.length = 0;
   136	    },
   137	    reset: function () { this.releaseAll(); this.enabled = true; }
   138	  };

   232	      this.speed = Math.min(SPDMAX, this.speed + SPD_RAMP * dt);

   238	      /* lane lerp */
   239	      p.lp += clamp(p.lane - p.lp, -1, 1) * Math.min(1, dt * 13);
   240	      if (Math.abs(p.lane - p.lp) < 0.005) p.lp = p.lane;
   241	      p.tilt *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   242	
   243	      /* vertical */
   244	      if (p.air) {
   245	        p.vy -= p.grav * dt;
   246	        p.y += p.vy * dt;
   247	        if (p.y <= 0) {
   248	          p.y = 0; p.vy = 0; p.air = false; p.sky = false; p.grav = GRAV;
   249	          TD.Audio.land(); this.puff(5, '#9fb2c8');
   250	        }
   251	      } else {
   252	        p.phase += eff * dt * 0.9;
   253	      }
   254	      if (p.slideT > 0) { p.slideT -= dt; if (p.slideT < 0) p.slideT = 0; }
   255	
   256	      /* powers */
   257	      if (this.magnetT > 0) this.magnetT -= dt;
   258	      if (this.boardT > 0) this.boardT -= dt;
   259	      if (this.multT > 0) this.multT -= dt;
   260	      if (this.bannerT > 0) this.bannerT -= dt;
   261	      if (this.hintT > 0) this.hintT -= dt;
   262	
   263	      /* inspector recedes while clean */
   264	      if (this.inspT > 0) {
   265	        this.inspT -= dt;
   266	        if (this.inspT <= 0) { this.inspT = 0; this.banner('INSPECTOR LOST'); TD.Audio.tone(660, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.14); }
   267	      }
   268	
   269	      this.genUntil(SPAWN_AHEAD);

   271	      this.prune();
   272	      this.stepFx(dt);
   273	
   274	      this.bumpMission('dist', 0, Math.floor(this.dist));
   275	      this.bumpMission('clean', 0, Math.floor(this.cleanDist));
   276	
   277	      if (this.shake > 0) this.shake = Math.max(0, this.shake - dt * 26);
   278	      if (this.flash > 0) this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 3.2);
   279	    },
   280	
   281	    playerBox: function () {
   282	      var p = this.p;
   283	      var sliding = p.slideT > 0 && !p.air;
   284	      var h = sliding ? 0.95 : 1.8;
   285	      return { y0: p.y, y1: p.y + h, slide: sliding };

   360	    stumble: function (e) {

   225	  function schedule(fn, delay) {
   226	    let timer = null;
   227	    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
   228	      pendingTimers.delete(timer);
   229	      fn();
   230	    }, delay);
   231	    pendingTimers.add(timer);
   232	    return timer;
   233	  }
   234	
   235	  function cancelTimers() {
   236	    for (const timer of pendingTimers) window.clearTimeout(timer);
   237	    pendingTimers.clear();
   238	  }

   240	  function clearInput() {
   241	    for (const pointerId of activePointers.keys()) {
   242	      try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId); } catch (error) { /* no-op */ }
   243	    }
   244	    activePointers.clear();
   245	    keyState.clear();
   246	    actionQueue.length = 0;
   247	    input.mapPointerId = null;
   248	    input.mapStart = null;
   249	    input.encounterPointerId = null;
   250	    input.notesPointerId = null;
   251	    input.restartPointerId = null;
   252	    input.backPointerId = null;
   253	    input.dexPointerId = null;
   254	    input.capturePointerId = null;
   255	    input.captureStart = null;
   256	    capturePointer = null;
   257	    captureDrag = null;
   258	  }

   260	  function queueAction(action) {
   261	    if (actionQueue.length >= MAX_ACTIONS) actionQueue.shift();
   262	    actionQueue.push(action);

   270	  function unlockAudio() {
   271	    try {
   272	      if (!audioContext) audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
   273	      if (audioContext.state === "suspended") audioContext.resume();
   274	    } catch (error) {
   275	      audioContext = null;
   276	    }
   277	  }

   279	  function chirp(frequency, duration = 0.08, type = "sine", volume = 0.035) {
   280	    if (!audioContext) return;
   430	      pick -= species.weight;
   431	      if (pick <= 0) return species;
   432	    }
   433	    return candidates[candidates.length - 1];
   434	  }

   436	  function rollEncounter(nodeId, guaranteed = false) {
   437	    const node = district.nodes[nodeId];
   438	    if (!guaranteed && rng() > 0.86) {
   439	      encounter = null;
   440	      showToast("Only leaves. Keep exploring.", 1300);
   441	      return;
   442	    }
   443	    const weather = conditions().weather.key;
   444	    const species = chooseSpecies(node.habitat, weather);
   445	    encounter = { speciesId: species.id, age: 0, sparkle: rng() * Math.PI * 2 };
   446	    pulse = 1;
   447	    chirp(390 + rng() * 180, 0.1, "triangle", 0.025);
   448	  }
   449	
   450	  function moveTo(nodeId) {
   451	    if (!district.nodes[nodeId] || nodeId === currentNode) return;
   452	    const isPractice = practiceMode || steps <= 0;
   453	    if (!isPractice && steps > 0) steps -= 1;
   454	    if (steps <= 0) practiceMode = true;
   455	    currentNode = nodeId;
   456	    district.nodes[currentNode].visited = true;
   457	    visited.add(currentNode);
   458	    if (visited.size > district.nodes.length) visited.delete(visited.values().next().value);
   459	    walkCount += 1;
   460	    score += isPractice ? 2 : 10;
   461	    shake = Math.max(shake, 2.5);
   462	    burst(district.nodes[nodeId].x, district.nodes[nodeId].y, HABITATS[district.nodes[nodeId].habitat].color, 7);
   463	    rollEncounter(nodeId);
   464	    updateStatus(`Arrived at ${district.nodes[nodeId].label}. ${encounter ? "A field encounter is nearby." : "No creature this time."}`);
   465	  }
   466	
   467	  function moveByDirection(dx, dy) {
   468	    if (state !== "map" || !district) return;
   469	    const current = district.nodes[currentNode];
   470	    const choices = neighbors(currentNode).map((id) => district.nodes[id]);
   471	    let bestNode = null;
   472	    let bestDot = -Infinity;
   473	    for (const node of choices) {
   474	      const vx = node.x - current.x;
   475	      const vy = node.y - current.y;
   476	      const length = Math.hypot(vx, vy) || 1;
   477	      const dot = (vx / length) * dx + (vy / length) * dy;
   478	      if (dot > bestDot) { bestDot = dot; bestNode = node.id; }
   479	    }
   480	    if (bestNode !== null && bestDot > 0.05) moveTo(bestNode);
   481	  }

   483	  function openEncounter() {
   484	    if (!encounter || state !== "map") return;
   485	    const species = speciesById.get(encounter.speciesId);
   486	    if (!species) { encounter = null; return; }
   487	    state = "capture";
   488	    captureTime = 0;
   489	    throwsLeft = 3;
   490	    captureDrag = null;
   491	    capturePointer = null;
   492	    flash = 0.18;
   493	    chirp(540, 0.12, "sine", 0.025);
   494	    updateStatus(`Capture drill for ${species.name}. Flick toward the lead mark.`);
   495	  }
   496	
   497	  function beginCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   498	    if (state !== "capture" || input.capturePointerId !== null) return;
   499	    if (y < 470 || y > 626) return;
   500	    input.capturePointerId = pointerId;
   501	    input.captureStart = { x, y };
   502	    capturePointer = { x, y };
   503	    captureDrag = { x, y, startX: x, startY: y, startedAt: performance.now() };
   504	  }
   505	
   506	  function moveCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   507	    if (pointerId !== input.capturePointerId || !captureDrag) return;
   508	    capturePointer = { x: clamp(x, 12, W - 12), y: clamp(y, 110, 642) };
   509	    captureDrag.x = capturePointer.x;
   510	    captureDrag.y = capturePointer.y;
   511	  }
   512	
   513	  function releaseCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   514	    if (pointerId !== input.capturePointerId || !captureDrag) return;
   515	    const drag = captureDrag;
   516	    const now = performance.now();
   517	    const dx = x - drag.startX;
   518	    const dy = y - drag.startY;
   519	    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   520	    const elapsed = Math.max(0.07, (now - drag.startedAt) / 1000);
   521	    const speed = distance / elapsed;
   522	    const leadX = captureTarget.x + captureTarget.vx * 0.18;
   523	    const leadY = captureTarget.y + captureTarget.vy * 0.18;
   524	    const aimDistance = Math.hypot(x - leadX, y - leadY);
   525	    const ringPhase = (captureTime * 1.25) % 1;
   526	    const timing = Math.abs(ringPhase - 0.78) < 0.18 || ringPhase < 0.08;
   527	    const goodDirection = dy < -52;
   528	    const success = distance > 95 && speed > 180 && goodDirection && aimDistance < 78 && timing;
   529	    capturePointer = null;
   530	    captureDrag = null;
   531	    input.capturePointerId = null;
   532	    input.captureStart = null;
   533	    if (success) captureSuccess();
   534	    else captureMiss();
   535	  }
   536	
   537	  function captureSuccess() {
   538	    const species = speciesById.get(encounter && encounter.speciesId);
   539	    if (!species) { state = "map"; return; }
   540	    const size = Math.round((species.base + rng() * species.variance) * 10) / 10;
   580	        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
   581	        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18,
   582	        life: 0.5 + rng() * 0.55,
   583	        maxLife: 0.5 + rng() * 0.55,
   584	        size: 2 + rng() * 4,
   585	        color
   586	      });
   587	    }
   588	  }

   590	  function resetRun() {
   591	    cancelTimers();
   592	    clearInput();
   593	    mapSeed = hashSeed(`${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)}`);
   594	    district = buildDistrict(mapSeed);
   595	    currentNode = 0;
   596	    district.nodes[0].visited = true;
   597	    visited = new Set([0]);
   598	    steps = maxSteps;
   599	    practiceMode = false;
   600	    walkCount = 0;
   601	    score = 0;
   602	    encounter = null;
   603	    result = null;
   604	    selectedDex = 0;
   605	    state = "map";
   606	    flash = 0;
   607	    shake = 0;
   608	    pulse = 0;
   609	    particles = [];
   610	    rng = mulberry32(mapSeed ^ 0x9e3779b9);
   611	    rollEncounter(0, true);
   612	    lastFrame = performance.now();
   613	    updateStatus("Field ready. Tap a glowing path, then follow the rustle.");
   614	  }

   640	  function activate() {
   641	    if (state === "map") {
   642	      if (encounter) openEncounter();
   643	      else practiceMode = !practiceMode;
   644	    } else if (state === "dex" || state === "result" || state === "medal") {
   645	      closeOverlay();
   646	    }

   649	  function pointerPosition(event) {
   650	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   651	    return {
   652	      x: clamp((event.clientX - rect.left) * W / Math.max(1, rect.width), 0, W),
   653	      y: clamp((event.clientY - rect.top) * H / Math.max(1, rect.height), 0, H)
   654	    };
   655	  }
   656	
   657	  function hit(rect, x, y) {
   658	    return x >= rect.x && x <= rect.x + rect.w && y >= rect.y && y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   659	  }
   660	
   661	  function assignPointer(pointerId, owner, point) {
   662	    if (activePointers.size >= MAX_ACTIVE_POINTERS) return false;
   663	    activePointers.set(pointerId, { owner, x: point.x, y: point.y });
   664	    return true;
   665	  }
   666	
   667	  function pointerDown(event) {
   668	    event.preventDefault();
   669	    if (pausedByOrientation) return;
   670	    unlockAudio();
   671	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   672	    if (!assignPointer(event.pointerId, "pending", point)) return;
   673	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* no-op */ }
   674	
   675	    if (state === "capture") {
   676	      if (hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) {
   677	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   678	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   679	        return;
   680	      }
   681	      if (point.y >= 470) {
   682	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "capture";
   683	        beginCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   684	      } else activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   685	      return;
   686	    }
   687	
   688	    if (state === "dex") {
   689	      if (hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) {
   690	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   691	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   692	        return;
   693	      }
   694	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) {
   695	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "dex";
   696	        input.dexPointerId = event.pointerId;
   697	        return;
   698	      }
   699	      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   700	      return;
   701	    }
   702	
   703	    if (state === "result" || state === "medal") {
   704	      const continueRect = state === "result" ? ui.resultContinue : ui.medalContinue;
   705	      if (hit(continueRect, point.x, point.y)) {
   706	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   707	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   708	      } else activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   709	      return;
   710	    }
   760	        const destination = destinationAt(point.x, point.y);
   761	        if (destination !== null) moveTo(destination);
   762	      }
   763	    } else if (tracked.owner === "capture") {
   764	      releaseCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   765	    } else if (tracked.owner === "encounter") {
   766	      clearOwner("encounter", event.pointerId);
   767	      if (hit(ui.action, point.x, point.y)) activate();
   768	    } else if (tracked.owner === "notes") {
   769	      clearOwner("notes", event.pointerId);
   770	      if (hit(ui.notes, point.x, point.y)) openDex();
   771	    } else if (tracked.owner === "restart") {
   772	      clearOwner("restart", event.pointerId);
   773	      if (hit(ui.restart, point.x, point.y)) restart();
   774	    } else if (tracked.owner === "back") {
   775	      clearOwner("back", event.pointerId);
   776	      if (state === "capture" && hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) { state = "map"; clearInput(); }
   777	      else if (state === "dex" && hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   778	      else if (state === "result" && hit(ui.resultContinue, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   779	      else if (state === "medal" && hit(ui.medalContinue, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   780	    } else if (tracked.owner === "dex") {
   781	      clearOwner("dex", event.pointerId);
   782	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) selectDexAt(point.x, point.y);
   783	    }
   784	  }
   785	
   786	  function clearOwner(owner, pointerId) {
   787	    if (owner === "map" && input.mapPointerId === pointerId) { input.mapPointerId = null; input.mapStart = null; }
   788	    if (owner === "encounter" && input.encounterPointerId === pointerId) input.encounterPointerId = null;
   789	    if (owner === "notes" && input.notesPointerId === pointerId) input.notesPointerId = null;
   790	    if (owner === "restart" && input.restartPointerId === pointerId) input.restartPointerId = null;
   791	    if (owner === "back" && input.backPointerId === pointerId) input.backPointerId = null;
   792	    if (owner === "dex" && input.dexPointerId === pointerId) input.dexPointerId = null;
   793	  }
   794	
   795	  function selectDexAt(x, y) {
   796	    const row = Math.floor((y - 128) / 38);
   797	    if (row < 0 || row >= 12) return;
   798	    const column = x < 195 ? 0 : 1;
   799	    const index = row * 2 + column;
   800	    if (index >= 0 && index < SPECIES.length) {
   801	      selectedDex = index;
   802	      chirp(360 + index * 7, 0.05, "sine", 0.016);
   803	      updateStatus(`${SPECIES[index].name}: ${SPECIES[index].note}`);
   804	    }
   805	  }
   806	
   807	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   808	    if (pausedByOrientation) return;
   809	    unlockAudio();
   810	    const key = event.key;
   811	    if (["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", " ", "Escape", "d", "D", "r", "R"].includes(key)) event.preventDefault();
   812	    if (event.repeat && key !== "ArrowUp" && key !== "ArrowDown" && key !== "ArrowLeft" && key !== "ArrowRight") return;
   813	    keyState.add(key);
   814	    if (key === "ArrowUp") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: 0, dy: -1 });
   815	    else if (key === "ArrowDown") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: 0, dy: 1 });
   816	    else if (key === "ArrowLeft") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: -1, dy: 0 });
   817	    else if (key === "ArrowRight") queueAction({ type: "move", dx: 1, dy: 0 });
   818	    else if (key === " ") queueAction({ type: "activate" });

   258	      case 'q': case 'Q': G.kbCard = (G.kbCard + G.save.unlocked.length - 1) % G.save.unlocked.length; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   259	      case 'e': case 'E': case 'Tab': e.preventDefault(); G.kbCard = (G.kbCard + 1) % G.save.unlocked.length; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   260	      case ' ': {
   261	        e.preventDefault();
   262	        var dd = EO.defAt(C.c, C.r);
   263	        if (dd) { G.sel = (G.sel === dd) ? null : dd; EO.sfx.ui(); }
   264	        else { var id = G.save.unlocked[G.kbCard]; if (id) EO.placeDefender(id, C.c, C.r, G.kbDir); }
   265	        break;
   266	      }
   267	      case 'Enter': e.preventDefault(); if (G.sel) EO.useSkill(G.sel); break;
   268	      case 'x': case 'X': if (G.sel) EO.recycle(G.sel); break;
   269	      case 'p': case 'P': case 'Escape': G.paused = !G.paused; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   270	      case 'f': case 'F': G.speed = G.speed === 1 ? 2 : 1; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   271	    }
   272	  }, { passive: false });
   273	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });

   275	  /* ---------- keyboard cursor overlay ---------- */
   276	  function drawCursor() {
   277	    if (!EO.kbActive || G.screen !== 'play' || G.paused) return;
   278	    var L = G.L, t = L.tile, C = G.cursor;
   279	    var id = G.save.unlocked[G.kbCard];
   280	    var free = EO.buildable(C.c, C.r);
   281	    if (id && free) {
   282	      var cells = EO.fpPreview(id, C.c, C.r, G.kbDir);
   283	      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,84,0.16)';
   284	      for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) g.fillRect(L.ox + cells[i][0] * t + 1, L.oy + cells[i][1] * t + 1, t - 2, t - 2);
   285	      var cx = EO.cellX(C.c), cy = EO.cellY(C.r), d = EO.DIRS[G.kbDir];
   286	      g.strokeStyle = '#ffb454'; g.lineWidth = 3;
   287	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(cx, cy); g.lineTo(cx + d[0] * t * 0.7, cy + d[1] * t * 0.7); g.stroke();
   288	    }
   289	    g.strokeStyle = free ? '#ffb454' : '#e05f5f';
   290	    g.lineWidth = 3;
   291	    g.strokeRect(L.ox + C.c * t + 2, L.oy + C.r * t + 2, t - 4, t - 4);
   292	  }

   294	  /* ---------- loop ---------- */
   295	  function frame(ts) {
   296	    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   297	    if (EO.blocked) { last = 0; return; }
   298	    if (!last) last = ts;
   299	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   300	    last = ts;
     1	/* Emberline Outpost - simulation */
     2	(function (EO) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	
     5	  var DIRS = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]]; /* up right down left */
     6	  EO.DIRS = DIRS;
     7	
     8	  /* rotate a facing-space offset [forward, side] into grid delta for dir */
     9	  EO.rotFp = function (f, s, dir) {
    10	    switch (dir) {
    11	      case 0: return [s, -f];
    12	      case 1: return [f, s];
    13	      case 2: return [-s, f];
    14	      default: return [-f, -s];
    15	    }
    16	  };
    17	
    18	  var G = {
    19	    screen: 'play',       /* play | result | base | maps */
    20	    state: 'prep',        /* prep | wave | won | lost */
    21	    mapIdx: 0,
    22	    L: { ox: 0, oy: 0, tile: 40, w: 390, h: 700, hud: 54, trayY: 0, trayH: 118 },
    23	    paths: [], gate: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    24	    pathSet: null,
    25	    defs: [], enemies: [], shots: [], floats: [],
    26	    parts: null,
    27	    energy: 0, regen: 3.2, leaks: 0, leakCap: 10,
    28	    waves: [], waveIdx: 0, prepT: 0, queue: [], waveActive: false,
    29	    time: 0, kills: 0, score: 0, best: 0,
    30	    shake: 0, flashT: 0, sel: null, hint: true,
    31	    speed: 1, paused: false,
    32	    mods: null, save: null, resultInfo: null,
    33	    trayPage: 0, cursor: { c: 3, r: 4 }, kbDir: 0, kbCard: 0
    34	  };

    38	  EO.cellY = function (r) { return G.L.oy + r * G.L.tile + G.L.tile * 0.5; };

    40	  EO.defAt = function (c, r) {
    41	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) if (G.defs[i].c === c && G.defs[i].r === r) return G.defs[i];
    42	    return null;
    43	  };
    44	  EO.isPath = function (c, r) { return !!(G.pathSet && G.pathSet[c + ',' + r]); };
    45	  EO.buildable = function (c, r) {
    46	    if (c < 0 || r < 0 || c >= EO.COLS || r >= EO.ROWS) return false;
    47	    if (EO.isPath(c, r)) return false;
    48	    if (EO.defAt(c, r)) return false;

    52	  EO.computeMods = function (save) {
    53	    var m = { energy: 0, regen: 0, leak: 0, hp: 1, cd: 1, kill: 1 };
    54	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    55	      var id = save.kits[i];
    56	      if (!id) continue;
    57	      if (id === 'cache') m.energy += 12;
    58	      else if (id === 'core') m.regen += 1.2;
    59	      else if (id === 'plate') m.leak += 3;
    60	      else if (id === 'frame') m.hp *= 1.30;
    61	      else if (id === 'kiln') m.cd *= 0.75;
    62	      else if (id === 'rig') m.kill *= 1.40;
    63	    }
    64	    return m;
    65	  };

    67	  /* ---------- start a map ---------- */
    68	  EO.startMap = function (mi) {
    69	    EO.clearTimers();
    70	    mi = EO.clamp(mi | 0, 0, EO.MAPS.length - 1);
    71	    var m = EO.MAPS[mi];
    72	    G.mapIdx = mi;
    73	    G.screen = 'play'; G.state = 'prep';
    74	    G.defs.length = 0; G.enemies.length = 0; G.shots.length = 0; G.floats.length = 0;
    75	    if (!G.parts) G.parts = new EO.Particles(); else G.parts.clear();
    76	    G.mods = EO.computeMods(G.save);
    77	    G.energy = m.energy + G.mods.energy;
    78	    G.regen = m.regen + G.mods.regen;
    79	    G.leaks = 0; G.leakCap = m.leak + G.mods.leak;
    80	    G.waves = EO.buildWaves(mi);
    81	    G.waveIdx = 0; G.queue.length = 0; G.waveActive = false;
    82	    G.prepT = G.waves.length ? G.waves[0].prep : 3;
    83	    G.time = 0; G.kills = 0; G.score = 0;
    84	    G.best = (G.save.best && G.save.best['m' + mi]) || 0;
    85	    G.shake = 0; G.flashT = 0; G.sel = null;
    86	    G.speed = 1; G.paused = false;
    87	    G.hint = !G.save.seen;
    88	    G.trayPage = 0; G.cursor.c = 3; G.cursor.r = EO.ROWS - 2; G.kbDir = 0; G.kbCard = 0;
    89	
    90	    /* paths */
    91	    G.paths = [];
    92	    G.pathSet = {};
    93	    for (var p = 0; p < m.paths.length; p++) {
    94	      var cells = EO.expandPath(m.paths[p]);
    95	      var pts = [];
    96	      for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    97	        pts.push({ c: cells[i][0], r: cells[i][1] });
    98	        G.pathSet[cells[i][0] + ',' + cells[i][1]] = 1;
    99	      }
   100	      G.paths.push(pts);
   101	    }
   102	    var last = G.paths[0][G.paths[0].length - 1];
   103	    G.gate = { c: last.c, r: last.r };
   104	  };

   106	  /* ---------- placement ---------- */
   107	  EO.placeDefender = function (id, c, r, dir) {
   108	    var d = EO.DEF_BY_ID[id];
   109	    if (!d) return false;
   110	    if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(id) < 0) return false;
   111	    if (!EO.buildable(c, r)) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   112	    if (G.energy < d.cost) { EO.sfx.deny(); EO.float(EO.cellX(c), EO.cellY(r), 'NO CHARGE', '#e05f5f'); return false; }
   113	    if (G.defs.length >= 40) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   114	    G.energy -= d.cost;
   115	    var hp = Math.round(d.hp * G.mods.hp);
   116	    G.defs.push({
   117	      def: d, c: c, r: r, dir: dir & 3, hp: hp, maxhp: hp,
   118	      cd: 0, skcd: 0, flash: 0, burst: 0, brace: 0, shieldT: 0, born: 0.35, pulse: 0
   119	    });
   120	    EO.sfx.place();
   121	    G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(c), EO.cellY(r), 10, d.col, 90, 3);
   122	    G.hint = false;
   123	    if (!G.save.seen) { G.save.seen = 1; EO.writeSave(G.save); }
   124	    return true;
   125	  };

   127	  EO.recycle = function (dd) {
   128	    var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   129	    if (i < 0) return;
   130	    G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   131	    G.energy += Math.round(dd.def.cost * 0.5);
   132	    G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 10, '#9aa6b2', 80, 3);
   133	    EO.sfx.ui();
   134	    if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   135	  };

   138	    if (G.floats.length >= 30) G.floats.shift();
   139	    G.floats.push({ x: x, y: y, t: 0.85, mt: 0.85, s: txt, c: col || '#e8e2d4' });
   140	  };
   141	  function shot(x, y, tx, ty, col, type) {
   142	    if (G.shots.length >= 90) G.shots.shift();
   143	    G.shots.push({ x: x, y: y, tx: tx, ty: ty, t: 0.16, mt: 0.16, c: col, k: type || 0 });
   144	  }

   146	  /* ---------- footprint helpers ---------- */
   147	  EO.fpCells = function (dd) {
   148	    var out = [], fp = dd.def.fp;
   149	    for (var i = 0; i < fp.length; i++) {
   150	      var o = EO.rotFp(fp[i][0], fp[i][1], dd.dir);
   170	      for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) if (cells[i][0] === e.cc && cells[i][1] === e.cr) return true;
   171	      return false;
   172	    }
   173	    var t = G.L.tile;
   174	    for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
   175	      var cx = EO.cellX(cells[i][0]), cy = EO.cellY(cells[i][1]);
   176	      if (Math.abs(e.x - cx) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5 && Math.abs(e.y - cy) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5) return true;
   177	    }
   178	    return false;
   179	  }
   180	  function targetsOf(dd) {
   181	    var tgt = dd.def.tgt, out = [];
   182	    if (tgt === 'n') return out;
   183	    for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   184	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   185	      if (e.dead) continue;
   186	      if (tgt === 'g' && e.air) continue;
   187	      if (tgt === 'a' && !e.air) continue;
   188	      if (inFp(dd, e)) out.push(e);
   189	    }
   190	    /* front-most (furthest along) first */
   191	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.prog - a.prog; });
   192	    return out;
   193	  }

   195	  /* ---------- damage ---------- */
   196	  function hurtEnemy(e, amount, col, crit) {
   197	    if (e.dead) return;
   198	    var arm = e.def.armor * (e.oil > 0 ? 0.5 : 1);
   199	    var dmg = Math.max(1, amount - arm);
   200	    e.hp -= dmg;
   201	    e.flash = 0.12;
   202	    if (Math.random() < 0.45) G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, crit ? 8 : 3, col || '#ffd08a', 70, 2);
   203	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e);
   204	    else EO.sfx.hit();
   205	  }
   206	  function killEnemy(e) {
   207	    if (e.dead) return;
   208	    e.dead = true;
   209	    G.kills++;
   210	    var gain = (1.4 + e.maxhp / 34) * G.mods.kill;
   211	    G.energy += gain;
   212	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 10, e.def.col, 120, 3);
   213	    EO.float(e.x, e.y - 8, '+' + Math.round(gain), '#8fe0a0');
   214	    EO.sfx.die();
   215	  }
   216	  function auraMul(dd) {
   217	    var mul = 1;
   218	    if (dd.brace > 0) mul *= 0.4;
   219	    if (dd.shieldT > 0) mul *= 0.55;
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   221	      var w = G.defs[i];
   222	      if (w === dd || w.def.id !== 'warden' || w.hp <= 0) continue;
   223	      if (Math.abs(w.c - dd.c) <= 1 && Math.abs(w.r - dd.r) <= 1) { mul *= 0.8; break; }
   224	    }
   225	    return mul;
   226	  }
   227	  function hurtDefender(dd, amount) {
   228	    dd.hp -= amount * auraMul(dd);
   229	    dd.flash = 0.14;
   230	    if (dd.hp <= 0) {
   231	      var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   232	      if (i >= 0) G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   233	      if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   234	      G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 14, dd.def.col, 130, 4);
   235	      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6);
   236	      EO.sfx.boom();
   237	    }
   238	  }

   240	  /* ---------- spawning ---------- */
   241	  function spawnEnemy(type, pathIdx) {
   242	    if (G.enemies.length >= 90) return;
   243	    var base = EO.ENEMIES[type];
   244	    if (!base) return;
   245	    var s = EO.mapScale(G.mapIdx);
   246	    var hp = Math.round(base.hp * s);
   247	    var e = {
   248	      def: base, air: base.air, hp: hp, maxhp: hp, dead: false,
   249	      slow: 0, stun: 0, root: 0, burn: 0, burnT: 0, oil: 0,
   250	      atkCd: 0, tgt: null, flash: 0, prog: 0, kbcd: 0, rage: 0, cc: 0, cr: 0, x: 0, y: 0
   251	    };
   252	    if (base.air) {
   253	      e.x = G.L.ox + EO.rnd(G.L.tile * 0.6, G.L.tile * (EO.COLS - 0.6));
   254	      e.y = G.L.oy - 26 - EO.rnd(0, 40);
   255	      e.gx = EO.cellX(G.gate.c); e.gy = EO.cellY(G.gate.r);
   256	      e.ph = Math.random() * 6.28;
   257	    } else {
   258	      var pi = EO.clamp(pathIdx | 0, 0, G.paths.length - 1);
   259	      e.path = G.paths[pi]; e.seg = 0; e.u = 0;
   260	      e.x = EO.cellX(e.path[0].c); e.y = EO.cellY(e.path[0].r);
   360	        }
   361	        continue;
   362	      }
   363	
   364	      if (e.root > 0) continue;
   365	
   366	      /* advance along path */
   367	      var move = e.def.spd * spdMul * dt;
   368	      while (move > 0 && e.seg < e.path.length - 1) {
   369	        var need = 1 - e.u;
   370	        if (move >= need) { move -= need; e.seg++; e.u = 0; }
   371	        else { e.u += move; move = 0; }
   372	      }
   373	      if (e.seg >= e.path.length - 1) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   374	      var a = e.path[e.seg], b = e.path[e.seg + 1];
   375	      e.x = EO.lerp(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellX(b.c), e.u);
   376	      e.y = EO.lerp(EO.cellY(a.r), EO.cellY(b.r), e.u);
   377	      e.prog = (e.seg + e.u) / e.path.length;
   378	    }
   379	    if (G.enemies.length > 90) G.enemies.splice(0, G.enemies.length - 90);
   380	  }
   381	
   382	  function leak(e) {
   383	    G.leaks += e.def.leak;
   384	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 9);
   385	    G.flashT = 0.25;
   386	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 14, '#e05f5f', 150, 4);
   387	    EO.float(e.x, G.L.oy + G.L.tile * EO.ROWS - 14, '-' + e.def.leak, '#e05f5f');
   388	    EO.sfx.leak();
   389	    if (G.leaks >= G.leakCap) loseMap();
   390	  }

   392	  /* ---------- defender update ---------- */
   393	  function updateDefs(dt) {
   394	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   395	      var dd = G.defs[i], d = dd.def;
   396	      if (dd.flash > 0) dd.flash -= dt;
   397	      if (dd.born > 0) dd.born -= dt;
   398	      if (dd.brace > 0) dd.brace -= dt;
   399	      if (dd.shieldT > 0) dd.shieldT -= dt;
   400	      if (dd.skcd > 0) dd.skcd -= dt;
   401	      dd.pulse += dt;
   402	      if (d.id === 'scout') G.energy += 0.45 * dt;
   403	
   404	      dd.cd -= dt;
   405	      if (dd.burst > 0) {
   406	        dd.burstT -= dt;
   407	        if (dd.burstT <= 0) { dd.burst--; dd.burstT = 0.16; fire(dd, 1.0); }
   408	      }
   409	      if (dd.cd > 0) continue;
   410	
   411	      if (d.kind === 'heal') {
   412	        var healed = false;
   413	        var cells = EO.fpCells(dd);
   414	        for (var c = 0; c < cells.length; c++) {
   415	          var t2 = EO.defAt(cells[c][0], cells[c][1]);
   416	          if (t2 && t2.hp < t2.maxhp) {
   417	            t2.hp = Math.min(t2.maxhp, t2.hp + 14);
   418	            G.parts.add(EO.cellX(t2.c), EO.cellY(t2.r) - 6, EO.rnd(-14, 14), -34, 0.5, '#8fe0a0', 3, -8);
   419	            healed = true;
   420	          }
   421	        }
   422	        dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   423	        if (healed) EO.audio.tone(760, 0.05, 'sine', 0.05);
   424	        continue;
   425	      }
   426	      var tg = targetsOf(dd);
   427	      if (!tg.length) { dd.cd = 0.08; continue; }
   428	      dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   429	      fire(dd, 1.0, tg);
   430	    }
   431	  }
   432	
   433	  function fire(dd, mul, tg) {
   434	    var d = dd.def;
   435	    tg = tg || targetsOf(dd);
   436	    if (!tg.length) return;
   437	    var sx = EO.cellX(dd.c), sy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   438	    var dmg = d.dmg * mul;
   439	    if (d.kind === 'melee' || d.kind === 'single') {
   440	      var e = tg[0];
   441	      hurtEnemy(e, dmg, d.col, mul > 1.5);
   442	      shot(sx, sy, e.x, e.y, d.col, d.kind === 'single' ? 2 : 0);
   443	    } else if (d.kind === 'pierce') {
   444	      for (var i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], dmg, d.col); }
   445	      var lastp = tg[tg.length - 1];
   446	      shot(sx, sy, lastp.x, lastp.y, d.col, 2);
   447	    } else if (d.kind === 'chain') {
   448	      for (var j = 0; j < Math.min(3, tg.length); j++) {
   449	        hurtEnemy(tg[j], dmg, d.col);
   450	        shot(j === 0 ? sx : tg[j - 1].x, j === 0 ? sy : tg[j - 1].y, tg[j].x, tg[j].y, d.col, 3);
   451	      }
   452	    } else if (d.kind === 'splash') {
   453	      var c0 = tg[0];
   454	      var rad = G.L.tile * 0.85;
   455	      for (var k = 0; k < tg.length; k++) {
   456	        if (EO.dist2(tg[k].x, tg[k].y, c0.x, c0.y) <= rad * rad) hurtEnemy(tg[k], dmg, d.col);
   457	      }
   458	      G.parts.burst(c0.x, c0.y, 8, '#ffb454', 110, 3);
   459	      shot(sx, sy, c0.x, c0.y, d.col, 4);
   460	      EO.audio.tone(180, 0.08, 'sine', 0.09, 90);
   530	          hurtEnemy(e3, d.dmg * 2, d.col);
   531	          if (!e3.air) { var bk = 1.2; while (bk > 0) { if (e3.u >= bk) { e3.u -= bk; bk = 0; } else if (e3.seg > 0) { bk -= e3.u; e3.seg--; e3.u = 1; } else { e3.u = 0; bk = 0; } } }
   532	        }
   533	        break;
   534	      case 'scout':
   535	        G.energy += 16; EO.float(cx, cy - 30, '+16', '#8fe0a0'); break;
   536	      case 'anchor':
   537	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) if (!tg[i].air) tg[i].root = 2.6;
   538	        break;
   539	    }
   540	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 4);
   541	    return true;
   542	  };
   543	
   544	  /* ---------- end states ---------- */
   545	  function winMap() {
   546	    G.state = 'won';
   547	    var timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.round(1200 - G.time * 4));
   548	    G.score = G.kills * 12 + (G.leakCap - G.leaks) * 140 + timeBonus;
   549	    var first = (G.save.cleared === G.mapIdx);
   550	    var mats = EO.matsFor(G.mapIdx, first);
   551	    G.save.mats.scrap = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.scrap + mats.scrap);
   552	    G.save.mats.ember = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.ember + mats.ember);
   553	    G.save.mats.alloy = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.alloy + mats.alloy);
   554	    var newDefs = [];
   555	    if (first) {
   556	      G.save.cleared = G.mapIdx + 1;
   557	      var ul = EO.UNLOCKS[G.mapIdx] || [];
   558	      for (var i = 0; i < ul.length; i++) {
   559	        if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(ul[i]) < 0) { G.save.unlocked.push(ul[i]); newDefs.push(ul[i]); }
   560	      }
   561	    }
   562	    var key = 'm' + G.mapIdx;
   563	    var rec = false;
   564	    if (!G.save.best[key] || G.score > G.save.best[key]) { G.save.best[key] = G.score; rec = true; }
   565	    EO.writeSave(G.save);
   566	    G.resultInfo = { win: true, mats: mats, newDefs: newDefs, record: rec, final: (G.mapIdx === EO.MAPS.length - 1) };
   567	    G.shake = 8;
   568	    EO.sfx.win();
   569	    EO.after(700, function () { if (G.state === 'won') G.screen = 'result'; });
   570	  }
   571	  function loseMap() {
   572	    if (G.state === 'lost') return;
   573	    G.state = 'lost';
   574	    G.score = G.kills * 12;
   575	    G.resultInfo = { win: false, mats: null, newDefs: [], record: false, final: false };
   576	    G.shake = 14;
   577	    EO.sfx.lose();
   578	    EO.after(800, function () { if (G.state === 'lost') G.screen = 'result'; });
   579	  }
   580	  EO.winMap = winMap;

   582	  /* ---------- main update ---------- */
   583	  EO.update = function (dt) {
   584	    if (G.screen !== 'play') { if (G.parts) G.parts.update(dt); return; }
   585	    if (G.paused) return;
   586	    var sdt = dt * G.speed;
   587	    if (G.state === 'prep' || G.state === 'wave') {
   588	      G.time += sdt;
   589	      G.energy += G.regen * sdt;
   590	      if (G.energy > 999) G.energy = 999;
   591	      updateSpawner(sdt);
   592	      updateEnemies(sdt);
   593	      updateDefs(sdt);
   594	    } else {
   595	      updateEnemies(sdt * 0.35);
   596	    }
   597	    /* shots */
   598	    for (var i = G.shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   599	      G.shots[i].t -= dt;
   600	      if (G.shots[i].t <= 0) G.shots.splice(i, 1);
   601	    }
   602	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   603	      var fl = G.floats[f];
   604	      fl.t -= dt; fl.y -= 26 * dt;
   605	      if (fl.t <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   606	    }
   607	    G.parts.update(dt);
   608	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   609	    if (G.flashT > 0) G.flashT -= dt;
   610	  };

    10	  function rr(g, x, y, w, h, r) {
    11	    r = Math.min(r, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
    12	    g.beginPath();
    13	    g.moveTo(x + r, y);
    14	    g.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    15	    g.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    16	    g.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    17	    g.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    18	    g.closePath();
    19	  }

   229	  function drawTray(g) {

   141	  function clamp(value, min, max) {
   142	    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));

   145	  function lerp(a, b, t) {
   146	    return a + (b - a) * t;
   147	  }

   149	  function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
   150	    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
   151	  }
   152	
   153	  function mulberry32(seed) {
   154	    let a = seed >>> 0;
   155	    return function random() {
   156	      a |= 0;
   157	      a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
   158	      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
   159	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
   160	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
   161	    };
   162	  }
   163	
   164	  function hashSeed(value) {
   165	    let hash = 2166136261;
   166	    const textValue = String(value);
   167	    for (let i = 0; i < textValue.length; i += 1) {
   168	      hash ^= textValue.charCodeAt(i);
   169	      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
   170	    }
   171	    return hash >>> 0;
   172	  }

   174	  function safeLoad() {
   175	    const fallback = { records: Object.create(null), best: 0 };
   176	    try {
   177	      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
   178	      if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.length === 0 || raw.length > 18000) return fallback;
   179	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   180	      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed)) return fallback;
   181	      const nextRecords = Object.create(null);
   182	      if (parsed.records && typeof parsed.records === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed.records)) {
   183	        let count = 0;
   184	        for (const species of SPECIES) {
   185	          const entry = parsed.records[species.id];
   186	          if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object" || count >= SPECIES.length) continue;
   187	          const size = finite(entry.bestSize, 0);
   188	          const seen = entry.seen === true;
   189	          if (seen && size >= 0 && size <= 999) {
   190	            nextRecords[species.id] = { seen: true, bestSize: Math.round(size * 10) / 10 };
   191	            count += 1;
   192	          }
   193	        }
   194	      }
   195	      return {
   196	        records: nextRecords,
   197	        best: clamp(Math.floor(finite(parsed.best, 0)), 0, SPECIES.length)
   198	      };
   199	    } catch (error) {
   200	      return fallback;
   201	    }
   202	  }
   203	
   204	  function safeSave() {
   205	    try {
   206	      const safeRecords = Object.create(null);
   207	      for (const species of SPECIES) {
   208	        const entry = records[species.id];
   209	        if (entry && entry.seen === true && Number.isFinite(entry.bestSize)) {
   210	          safeRecords[species.id] = {
   211	            seen: true,
   212	            bestSize: clamp(Math.round(entry.bestSize * 10) / 10, 0, 999)
   213	          };
   214	        }
   215	      }
   216	      window.localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
   217	        records: safeRecords,
   218	        best: clamp(Math.floor(best), 0, SPECIES.length)
   219	      }));
   220	    } catch (error) {
   220	    } catch (error) {
   221	      // Private browsing and blocked storage are both valid play conditions.
   222	    }
   223	  }

   225	  function schedule(fn, delay) {
   226	    let timer = null;
   227	    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
   228	      pendingTimers.delete(timer);
   229	      fn();
   230	    }, delay);
   231	    pendingTimers.add(timer);
   232	    return timer;
   233	  }
   234	
   235	  function cancelTimers() {
   236	    for (const timer of pendingTimers) window.clearTimeout(timer);
   237	    pendingTimers.clear();
   238	  }

   643	      else practiceMode = !practiceMode;

   649	  function pointerPosition(event) {
   650	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   651	    return {
   652	      x: clamp((event.clientX - rect.left) * W / Math.max(1, rect.width), 0, W),
   653	      y: clamp((event.clientY - rect.top) * H / Math.max(1, rect.height), 0, H)
   654	    };
   655	  }
   656	
   657	  function hit(rect, x, y) {
   658	    return x >= rect.x && x <= rect.x + rect.w && y >= rect.y && y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   659	  }
   660	
   661	  function assignPointer(pointerId, owner, point) {
   662	    if (activePointers.size >= MAX_ACTIVE_POINTERS) return false;
   663	    activePointers.set(pointerId, { owner, x: point.x, y: point.y });
   664	    return true;
   665	  }
   666	
   667	  function pointerDown(event) {
   668	    event.preventDefault();
   669	    if (pausedByOrientation) return;
   670	    unlockAudio();
   671	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   672	    if (!assignPointer(event.pointerId, "pending", point)) return;
   673	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* no-op */ }
   674	
   675	    if (state === "capture") {
   676	      if (hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) {
   677	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   678	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   679	        return;
   680	      }
   681	      if (point.y >= 470) {
   682	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "capture";
   683	        beginCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   684	      } else activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   685	      return;
   686	    }
   687	
   688	    if (state === "dex") {
   689	      if (hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) {
   690	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   691	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   692	        return;
   693	      }
   694	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) {
   695	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "dex";
   696	        input.dexPointerId = event.pointerId;
   697	        return;
   698	      }
   699	      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   700	      return;
   701	    }
   702	
   703	    if (state === "result" || state === "medal") {
   704	      const continueRect = state === "result" ? ui.resultContinue : ui.medalContinue;
   705	      if (hit(continueRect, point.x, point.y)) {
   706	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   707	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;
   708	      } else activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   709	      return;
   710	    }
   711	
   712	    if (hit(ui.notes, point.x, point.y)) {
   713	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "notes";
   714	      input.notesPointerId = event.pointerId;
   715	    } else if (hit(ui.restart, point.x, point.y)) {
   716	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "restart";
   717	      input.restartPointerId = event.pointerId;
   718	    } else if (hit(ui.action, point.x, point.y)) {
   719	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "encounter";
   720	      input.encounterPointerId = event.pointerId;
   721	    } else if (hit(ui.map, point.x, point.y)) {
   722	      activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "map";
   723	      input.mapPointerId = event.pointerId;
   724	      input.mapStart = point;
   725	    } else {
   726	      activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   727	    }
   728	  }
   729	
   730	  function pointerMove(event) {
   731	    event.preventDefault();
   732	    const tracked = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   733	    if (!tracked || pausedByOrientation) return;
   734	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   735	    tracked.x = point.x;
   736	    tracked.y = point.y;
   737	    if (tracked.owner === "capture") moveCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   738	  }
   739	
   740	  function pointerUp(event, cancelled = false) {
   741	    event.preventDefault();
   742	    const tracked = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   743	    if (!tracked) return;
   744	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   745	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   746	    if (cancelled || pausedByOrientation) {
   747	      if (tracked.owner === "capture") {
   748	        capturePointer = null;
   749	        captureDrag = null;
   750	        input.capturePointerId = null;
   751	        input.captureStart = null;
   752	      }
   753	      clearOwner(tracked.owner, event.pointerId);
   754	      return;
   755	    }
   756	    if (tracked.owner === "map") {
   757	      const start = input.mapStart;
   758	      clearOwner("map", event.pointerId);
   759	      if (start && Math.hypot(point.x - start.x, point.y - start.y) < 22) {
   760	        const destination = destinationAt(point.x, point.y);
   761	        if (destination !== null) moveTo(destination);
   762	      }
   763	    } else if (tracked.owner === "capture") {
   764	      releaseCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   765	    } else if (tracked.owner === "encounter") {
   766	      clearOwner("encounter", event.pointerId);
   767	      if (hit(ui.action, point.x, point.y)) activate();
   768	    } else if (tracked.owner === "notes") {
   769	      clearOwner("notes", event.pointerId);
   770	      if (hit(ui.notes, point.x, point.y)) openDex();
   771	    } else if (tracked.owner === "restart") {
   772	      clearOwner("restart", event.pointerId);
   773	      if (hit(ui.restart, point.x, point.y)) restart();
   774	    } else if (tracked.owner === "back") {
   775	      clearOwner("back", event.pointerId);
   776	      if (state === "capture" && hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) { state = "map"; clearInput(); }
   777	      else if (state === "dex" && hit(ui.back, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   778	      else if (state === "result" && hit(ui.resultContinue, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   779	      else if (state === "medal" && hit(ui.medalContinue, point.x, point.y)) closeOverlay();
   780	    } else if (tracked.owner === "dex") {
   781	      clearOwner("dex", event.pointerId);
   782	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) selectDexAt(point.x, point.y);
   783	    }
   784	  }
   785	
   786	  function clearOwner(owner, pointerId) {
   787	    if (owner === "map" && input.mapPointerId === pointerId) { input.mapPointerId = null; input.mapStart = null; }
   788	    if (owner === "encounter" && input.encounterPointerId === pointerId) input.encounterPointerId = null;
   789	    if (owner === "notes" && input.notesPointerId === pointerId) input.notesPointerId = null;
   790	    if (owner === "restart" && input.restartPointerId === pointerId) input.restartPointerId = null;
   832	    else if (action.type === "activate") activate();
   833	    else if (action.type === "dex") openDex();
   834	    else if (action.type === "back") {
   835	      if (state === "capture") { state = "map"; clearInput(); }
   836	      else closeOverlay();
   837	    } else if (action.type === "restart") restart();
   838	  }

   840	  function updateOrientation() {
   841	    const nextBlocked = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   842	    if (nextBlocked !== pausedByOrientation) {
   843	      pausedByOrientation = nextBlocked;
   844	      clearInput();
   845	      lastFrame = performance.now();
   846	      updateStatus(nextBlocked ? "Turn the field upright to resume." : "Field resumed.");
   847	    }
   848	    resizeCanvas();
   849	  }

   851	  function resizeCanvas() {
   852	    const now = performance.now();
   853	    if (now - lastResize < 80) return;
   854	    lastResize = now;
   855	    const rect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
   856	    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / Math.max(rect.width, rect.height));
   857	    const scale = Math.max(0.5, dpr);
   858	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * scale));
   859	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height * scale));
   860	    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
   861	    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
   862	  }

   864	  function update(dt) {
   865	    processActions();
   866	    pulse = Math.max(0, pulse - dt * 1.6);
   867	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.9);
   868	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 14);
   869	    if (toastText && performance.now() > toastUntil) toastText = "";
   870	    const fieldConditions = conditions();
   871	    const phaseKey = `${fieldConditions.dateKey}-${fieldConditions.phase}`;
   872	    if (phaseKey !== lastPhaseKey) {
   873	      if (fieldConditions.phase === "MORNING" || fieldConditions.phase === "EVENING") {
   874	        steps = maxSteps;
   875	        practiceMode = false;
   876	        showToast(`${fieldConditions.phase.toLowerCase()} window: route refilled`, 1800);
   877	        chirp(510, 0.1, "triangle", 0.02);
   878	      }
   879	      lastPhaseKey = phaseKey;
   880	    }
   881	    if (fieldConditions.weather.key !== lastWeatherKey) {
   882	      if (lastWeatherKey) showToast(`Field weather: ${fieldConditions.weather.label.toLowerCase()}`, 1200);
   883	      lastWeatherKey = fieldConditions.weather.key;
   884	    }

  1099	    ctx.fillStyle = C.deep;

  1101	    ctx.strokeStyle = C.deep;
  1102	    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  1103	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 4, 6, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke();

   164	        D.x = p.x; D.y = p.y; D.sx = p.x; D.sy = p.y; D.moved = false;
   165	        D.cell = null; D.dir = 0;
   166	        G.sel = null;
   167	        G.kbCard = D.card;
   168	        EO.audio.tone(420, 0.04, 'square', 0.08);
   169	        return;
   170	      }
   171	    }
   172	    /* grid tap: select / deselect */
   173	    var cell = cellAt(p.x, p.y);
   174	    if (cell) {
   175	      var dd = EO.defAt(cell.c, cell.r);
   176	      if (dd) { G.sel = (G.sel === dd) ? null : dd; EO.sfx.ui(); }
   177	      else G.sel = null;
   178	    }
   179	  }
   180	
   181	  function onMove(ev) {
   182	    if (EO.blocked) return;
   183	    var pt = pointers[ev.pointerId];
   184	    if (!pt) return;
   185	    var p = pos(ev);
   186	    pt.x = p.x; pt.y = p.y;
   187	    var D = EO.drag;
   188	    if (D.active && D.id === ev.pointerId) {
   189	      D.x = p.x; D.y = p.y;
   190	      if (Math.abs(p.x - D.sx) > 6 || Math.abs(p.y - D.sy) > 6) D.moved = true;
   191	      var cell = cellAt(p.x, p.y);
   192	      if (cell) {
   193	        if (!D.cell || D.cell.c !== cell.c || D.cell.r !== cell.r) {
   194	          D.cell = cell;
   195	          D.dir = defaultDir(cell.c, cell.r);
   196	        } else {
   197	          var cx = EO.cellX(cell.c), cy = EO.cellY(cell.r);
   198	          var dx = p.x - cx, dy = p.y - cy;
   199	          if (dx * dx + dy * dy > (G.L.tile * 0.30) * (G.L.tile * 0.30)) D.dir = dirFrom(dx, dy);
   200	        }
   201	      } else {
   202	        D.cell = null;
   203	      }
   204	    }
   205	  }
   206	
   207	  function onUp(ev, cancel) {
   208	    var D = EO.drag;
   209	    if (D.active && D.id === ev.pointerId) {
   210	      if (!cancel && D.cell && !EO.blocked) {
   211	        var id = G.save.unlocked[D.card];
   212	        if (id) EO.placeDefender(id, D.cell.c, D.cell.r, D.dir);
   213	      }
   214	      D.active = false; D.id = -1; D.card = -1; D.cell = null; D.moved = false;
   215	    }
   216	    delete pointers[ev.pointerId];
   217	  }

   231	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   232	    if (EO.blocked) return;
   233	    var k = e.key;
   234	    if (keys[k]) { if (k === ' ' || k.indexOf('Arrow') === 0) e.preventDefault(); return; }
   235	    keys[k] = 1;
   236	    if (!running) {
   237	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); boot(); }
   238	      return;
   239	    }
   240	    EO.audio.resume();
   241	    if (G.screen !== 'play') {
   242	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   243	        e.preventDefault();
   244	        if (G.screen === 'result') { var nb = null; for (var i = 0; i < U.btns.length; i++) if (U.btns[i].id === 'again') nb = U.btns[i]; if (nb) handleButton(nb); }
   245	        else if (G.screen === 'maps') deploy(Math.min(G.save.cleared, EO.MAPS.length - 1));
   246	        else if (G.screen === 'base') goMaps();
   247	      } else if (k === 'Escape' || k === 'b' || k === 'B') { goMaps(); }
   248	      return;
   249	    }
   250	    EO.kbActive = true;
   251	    var C = G.cursor;
   252	    switch (k) {
   253	      case 'ArrowUp': e.preventDefault(); C.r = EO.clamp(C.r - 1, 0, EO.ROWS - 1); break;
   254	      case 'ArrowDown': e.preventDefault(); C.r = EO.clamp(C.r + 1, 0, EO.ROWS - 1); break;
   255	      case 'ArrowLeft': e.preventDefault(); C.c = EO.clamp(C.c - 1, 0, EO.COLS - 1); break;
   256	      case 'ArrowRight': e.preventDefault(); C.c = EO.clamp(C.c + 1, 0, EO.COLS - 1); break;
   257	      case 'r': case 'R': G.kbDir = (G.kbDir + 1) & 3; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   258	      case 'q': case 'Q': G.kbCard = (G.kbCard + G.save.unlocked.length - 1) % G.save.unlocked.length; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   259	      case 'e': case 'E': case 'Tab': e.preventDefault(); G.kbCard = (G.kbCard + 1) % G.save.unlocked.length; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   260	      case ' ': {
   261	        e.preventDefault();
   262	        var dd = EO.defAt(C.c, C.r);
   263	        if (dd) { G.sel = (G.sel === dd) ? null : dd; EO.sfx.ui(); }
   264	        else { var id = G.save.unlocked[G.kbCard]; if (id) EO.placeDefender(id, C.c, C.r, G.kbDir); }
   265	        break;
   266	      }
   267	      case 'Enter': e.preventDefault(); if (G.sel) EO.useSkill(G.sel); break;
   268	      case 'x': case 'X': if (G.sel) EO.recycle(G.sel); break;
   269	      case 'p': case 'P': case 'Escape': G.paused = !G.paused; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   270	      case 'f': case 'F': G.speed = G.speed === 1 ? 2 : 1; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   271	    }
   272	  }, { passive: false });

    53	    var m = { energy: 0, regen: 0, leak: 0, hp: 1, cd: 1, kill: 1 };
    54	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    55	      var id = save.kits[i];

    60	      else if (id === 'frame') m.hp *= 1.30;
    61	      else if (id === 'kiln') m.cd *= 0.75;
    62	      else if (id === 'rig') m.kill *= 1.40;
    63	    }
    64	    return m;
    65	  };

   107	  EO.placeDefender = function (id, c, r, dir) {
   108	    var d = EO.DEF_BY_ID[id];
   109	    if (!d) return false;
   110	    if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(id) < 0) return false;
   111	    if (!EO.buildable(c, r)) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   112	    if (G.energy < d.cost) { EO.sfx.deny(); EO.float(EO.cellX(c), EO.cellY(r), 'NO CHARGE', '#e05f5f'); return false; }
   113	    if (G.defs.length >= 40) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   114	    G.energy -= d.cost;
   115	    var hp = Math.round(d.hp * G.mods.hp);
   116	    G.defs.push({
   117	      def: d, c: c, r: r, dir: dir & 3, hp: hp, maxhp: hp,
   118	      cd: 0, skcd: 0, flash: 0, burst: 0, brace: 0, shieldT: 0, born: 0.35, pulse: 0
   119	    });
   120	    EO.sfx.place();
   121	    G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(c), EO.cellY(r), 10, d.col, 90, 3);
   122	    G.hint = false;
   123	    if (!G.save.seen) { G.save.seen = 1; EO.writeSave(G.save); }
   124	    return true;
   125	  };

   180	  function targetsOf(dd) {
   181	    var tgt = dd.def.tgt, out = [];

   195	  /* ---------- damage ---------- */
   196	  function hurtEnemy(e, amount, col, crit) {
   197	    if (e.dead) return;
   198	    var arm = e.def.armor * (e.oil > 0 ? 0.5 : 1);
   199	    var dmg = Math.max(1, amount - arm);
   200	    e.hp -= dmg;
   201	    e.flash = 0.12;
   202	    if (Math.random() < 0.45) G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, crit ? 8 : 3, col || '#ffd08a', 70, 2);
   203	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e);
   204	    else EO.sfx.hit();
   205	  }
   206	  function killEnemy(e) {
   207	    if (e.dead) return;
   208	    e.dead = true;
   209	    G.kills++;
   210	    var gain = (1.4 + e.maxhp / 34) * G.mods.kill;
   211	    G.energy += gain;
   212	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 10, e.def.col, 120, 3);
   213	    EO.float(e.x, e.y - 8, '+' + Math.round(gain), '#8fe0a0');
   214	    EO.sfx.die();
   215	  }
   216	  function auraMul(dd) {
   217	    var mul = 1;
   218	    if (dd.brace > 0) mul *= 0.4;
   219	    if (dd.shieldT > 0) mul *= 0.55;
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   221	      var w = G.defs[i];
   222	      if (w === dd || w.def.id !== 'warden' || w.hp <= 0) continue;
   223	      if (Math.abs(w.c - dd.c) <= 1 && Math.abs(w.r - dd.r) <= 1) { mul *= 0.8; break; }
   224	    }
   225	    return mul;
   226	  }
   227	  function hurtDefender(dd, amount) {
   228	    dd.hp -= amount * auraMul(dd);
   229	    dd.flash = 0.14;
   230	    if (dd.hp <= 0) {
   231	      var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   232	      if (i >= 0) G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   233	      if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   234	      G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 14, dd.def.col, 130, 4);
   235	      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6);
   236	      EO.sfx.boom();
   237	    }
   238	  }

   392	  /* ---------- defender update ---------- */
   393	  function updateDefs(dt) {
   394	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   395	      var dd = G.defs[i], d = dd.def;
   396	      if (dd.flash > 0) dd.flash -= dt;
   397	      if (dd.born > 0) dd.born -= dt;
   398	      if (dd.brace > 0) dd.brace -= dt;
   399	      if (dd.shieldT > 0) dd.shieldT -= dt;
   400	      if (dd.skcd > 0) dd.skcd -= dt;
   401	      dd.pulse += dt;
   402	      if (d.id === 'scout') G.energy += 0.45 * dt;
   403	
   404	      dd.cd -= dt;
   405	      if (dd.burst > 0) {
   406	        dd.burstT -= dt;
   407	        if (dd.burstT <= 0) { dd.burst--; dd.burstT = 0.16; fire(dd, 1.0); }
   408	      }
   409	      if (dd.cd > 0) continue;
   410	
   411	      if (d.kind === 'heal') {
   412	        var healed = false;
   413	        var cells = EO.fpCells(dd);
   414	        for (var c = 0; c < cells.length; c++) {
   415	          var t2 = EO.defAt(cells[c][0], cells[c][1]);
   416	          if (t2 && t2.hp < t2.maxhp) {
   417	            t2.hp = Math.min(t2.maxhp, t2.hp + 14);

   560	      }
   561	    }

     1	# Parlor Pop
     2	
     3	Controls: swipe (or tap tile, then tap a neighbour) to swap. Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter selects/swaps, Esc backs out, 1/2/3 arm a booster, R restarts.
     4	Loop: match 3+ tiles to hit each level's goals (collect a colour, smash plated floor, drop keys to the floor) before the moves run out. Crates and ivy break when a match lands beside them; ivy spreads if you ignore it.
     5	Out of moves = instant retry, no lives and no waiting. Stars from finishing with moves to spare fund three restored parlor rooms; each slot offers two furnishings and the choice persists.
     6	Boosters (hammer / row rocket / shuffle) are earned only by 3-star finishes and never cost money; every level is clearable without them.
     7	Build check: `node verify.js` replays each level 200x with a greedy solver; `--fix` raises move budgets until all clear >=90%.

   149	      try { audioContext.resume(); } catch (_) { /* gesture may be unavailable */ }
   150	    }
   151	    $('audioToast').classList.add('off');
   152	  }
   153	
   154	  function tone(frequency, duration, type = 'square', volume = .025) {
   155	    if (!audioContext) return;
   156	    try {
   157	      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
   158	      const osc = audioContext.createOscillator();
   159	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   160	      osc.type = type;
   161	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   162	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, now);
   163	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now + duration);
   164	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
   165	      osc.start(now);
   166	      osc.stop(now + duration);
   167	    } catch (_) { /* audio is flavor, not a dependency */ }
   168	  }
   169	
   170	  function cancelPendingTimers() {
   171	    for (const timer of state.pendingTimers) {
   172	      try { clearTimeout(timer); } catch (_) { /* no-op */ }
   173	    }
   174	    state.pendingTimers.length = 0;
   175	  }
   176	
   177	  function schedule(callback, delay) {
   178	    if (state.pendingTimers.length >= 12) return;
   179	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   180	      const index = state.pendingTimers.indexOf(timer);
   181	      if (index >= 0) state.pendingTimers.splice(index, 1);
   182	      callback();
   183	    }, delay);
   184	    state.pendingTimers.push(timer);
   185	  }

   187	  function resetPad(pad) {
   188	    pad.pointerId = null;
   189	    pad.x = 0;
   190	    pad.y = 0;
   191	    pad.active = false;
   192	    const knob = pad.el.querySelector('.stickKnob');
   193	    if (knob) knob.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
   194	  }

   196	  function releaseAllInput() {
   197	    input.keys.clear();
   198	    input.queuedGadget = 0;
   199	    for (const pad of [input.left, input.right]) {
   200	      if (pad.pointerId !== null) {
   201	        try { pad.el.releasePointerCapture(pad.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* capture may already be gone */ }
   202	      }
   203	      resetPad(pad);
   204	    }
   205	    if (input.gadget.pointerId !== null) {
   206	      try { input.gadget.el.releasePointerCapture(input.gadget.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* no-op */ }
   207	    }
   208	    input.gadget.pointerId = null;
   209	    for (const tap of input.taps) {
   210	      if (tap.pointerId !== null) {
   211	        try { tap.el.releasePointerCapture(tap.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* no-op */ }
   212	      }
   213	      tap.pointerId = null;
   214	    }
   215	  }
   216	
   217	  function bindStick(pad) {
   218	    const el = pad.el;
   219	    const update = (event) => {
   220	      if (event.pointerId !== pad.pointerId) return;
   221	      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
   222	      const dx = event.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width * .5);
   223	      const dy = event.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height * .5);
   224	      const radius = rect.width * .39;
   225	      const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   226	      const scale = Math.min(1, radius / length);
   227	      pad.x = clamp(dx / radius, -1, 1);
   228	      pad.y = clamp(dy / radius, -1, 1);
   229	      const knob = el.querySelector('.stickKnob');
   230	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx * scale}px), calc(-50% + ${dy * scale}px))`;
   231	    };
   232	    const release = (event) => {
   233	      if (event.pointerId !== pad.pointerId) return;
   234	      resetPad(pad);
   235	      event.preventDefault();
   236	    };
   237	    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   238	      if (pad.pointerId !== null) return;
   239	      unlockAudio();
   240	      pad.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   241	      pad.active = true;
   242	      try { el.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* capture is optional */ }
   243	      update(event);
   244	      event.preventDefault();
   245	    }, { passive: false });
   246	    el.addEventListener('pointermove', update, { passive: false });
   247	    el.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   248	    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   249	  }
   250	
   251	  function bindGadgetButton() {
   252	    const el = input.gadget.el;
   253	    const release = (event) => {
   254	      if (event.pointerId !== input.gadget.pointerId) return;
   255	      input.gadget.pointerId = null;
   256	      event.preventDefault();
   257	    };
   258	    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   259	      if (input.gadget.pointerId !== null) return;
   260	      unlockAudio();
   261	      input.gadget.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   262	      try { el.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* optional */ }
   263	      input.queuedGadget = 1;
   264	      event.preventDefault();
   265	    }, { passive: false });
   266	    el.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   267	    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   268	  }
   269	
   270	  function bindTapButton(element, action) {
   271	    const control = { el: element, pointerId: null };
   272	    input.taps.push(control);
   273	    const release = (event) => {
   274	      if (event.pointerId !== control.pointerId) return;
   275	      control.pointerId = null;
   276	      if (event.type === 'pointerup') action();
   277	      event.preventDefault();
   278	    };
   279	    element.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
   280	      if (control.pointerId !== null) return;
   281	      unlockAudio();
   282	      control.pointerId = event.pointerId;
   283	      try { element.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* optional */ }
   284	      event.preventDefault();
   285	    }, { passive: false });
   286	    element.addEventListener('pointerup', release, { passive: false });
   287	    element.addEventListener('pointercancel', release, { passive: false });
   288	  }
