   290	  function makeEntity(name, team, type, position, weapon) {
   650	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt);
   651	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 16);
   652	    state.uavTimer = Math.max(0, state.uavTimer - dt);
   653	    state.sensorTimer = Math.max(0, state.sensorTimer - dt);
   654	  }
   655	
   656	  function updateControl(dt) {
   657	    if (state.mode !== 'control') return;
   658	    let blue = 0;
   659	    let red = 0;
   660	    for (const entity of state.entities) {
   661	      if (!entity.alive || dist(entity, state.map.point) > state.map.point.r) continue;
   662	      if (entity.team === 'blue') blue++; else red++;
   663	    }
   664	    if (blue > red) state.controlBlue = clamp(state.controlBlue + dt * 5, 0, 100);
   665	    if (red > blue) state.controlRed = clamp(state.controlRed + dt * 5, 0, 100);
   666	    if (state.controlBlue >= 100 || state.controlRed >= 100) endRound();
   667	  }
   668	
   669	  function update(dt) {
   670	    if (orientationBlocked || state.roundOver) return;
   671	    state.roundTime = Math.max(0, state.roundTime - dt);
   672	    updatePlayer(dt);
   673	    for (const entity of state.entities) if (entity.type === 'bot') updateBot(entity, dt);
   674	    updateOrdnance(dt);
   675	    updateControl(dt);
   676	    updateEffects(dt);
   677	    if (input.queuedGadget) { input.queuedGadget = 0; useGadget(); }
   678	    if (state.roundTime <= 0) endRound();
   679	  }
   680	
   681	  function burst(x, y, color, count, force) {
   682	    const safeCount = Math.min(count, MAX_PARTICLES - state.particles.length);
   683	    for (let i = 0; i < safeCount; i++) {
   684	      const angle = Math.random() * TAU;
   685	      const speed = Math.random() * force;
   686	      pushCap(state.particles, { x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: .16 + Math.random() * .35, size: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5, color }, MAX_PARTICLES);
   687	    }
   688	  }
   689	
   690	  function addFeed(text, color) { pushCap(state.feed, { text, color, life: 3.2 }, MAX_FEED); }
   691	
   692	  function endRound() {
   693	    if (state.roundOver) return;
   694	    state.roundOver = true;
   695	    releaseAllInput();
   696	    cancelPendingTimers();
   697	    const blueScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.blue : Math.floor(state.controlBlue);
   698	    const redScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.red : Math.floor(state.controlRed);
   699	    const winner = blueScore > redScore ? 'blue' : redScore > blueScore ? 'red' : 'draw';
   700	    const win = winner === 'blue';
   701	    const xpGain = winner === 'draw' ? 50 : (win ? 100 : 35) + Math.min(40, state.player.kills * 4);
   702	    profile.xp = clamp(profile.xp + xpGain, 0, 999999);
   703	    profile.wins = clamp(profile.wins + (win ? 1 : 0), 0, 999999);
   704	    profile.played = clamp(profile.played + 1, 0, 999999);
   705	    profile.bestKills = Math.max(profile.bestKills, state.player.kills);
   706	    profile.camo = clamp(Math.floor(profile.xp / 125), 0, CAMOS.length - 1);
   707	    writeStore('ironsight-ops-profile', profile);
   708	    const title = winner === 'draw' ? 'DRAW' : win ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT';
   709	    $('resultTitle').textContent = title;
   710	    $('resultTitle').style.color = winner === 'draw' ? '#ffbc63' : win ? '#59e0c0' : '#ff6872';
   711	    $('resultBody').textContent = `${state.map.name} · ${state.mode === 'tdm' ? 'TEAM DEATHMATCH' : 'CONTROL POINT'} · ${blueScore} — ${redScore}. ${win ? 'Your squad owns the drill.' : winner === 'draw' ? 'Nobody took the final lane.' : 'Recalibrate and take the next lane.'}`;
   712	    $('resultKills').textContent = `${state.player.kills} KILLS · ${xpGain} XP`;
   713	    $('resultRank').textContent = `RANK ${String(rankNumber()).padStart(2, '0')} · CAMO ${profile.camo + 1}`;
   714	    $('roundResult').hidden = false;
   715	    renderUi();
   716	    tone(win ? 520 : 120, .28, win ? 'sine' : 'sawtooth', .04);
   717	  }
   718

   920	    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0);
   921	    if (orientationBlocked) {

   875	  function onPointerMove(event) {

   882	  }

   896	    }

   898	      event.preventDefault();
   899	      keys.add(event.key);
   900	      if (event.key === ' ' && !event.repeat && queuedActions.length < 8) queuedActions.push('launch');
   901	    }

   903	  }

--- parlor-pop ---
# Parlor Pop

Controls: swipe (or tap tile, then tap a neighbour) to swap. Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter selects/swaps, Esc backs out, 1/2/3 arm a booster, R restarts.
Loop: match 3+ tiles to hit each level's goals (collect a colour, smash plated floor, drop keys to the floor) before the moves run out. Crates and ivy break when a match lands beside them; ivy spreads if you ignore it.
Out of moves = instant retry, no lives and no waiting. Stars from finishing with moves to spare fund three restored parlor rooms; each slot offers two furnishings and the choice persists.
Boosters (hammer / row rocket / shuffle) are earned only by 3-star finishes and never cost money; every level is clearable without them.
Build check: `node verify.js` replays each level 200x with a greedy solver; `--fix` raises move budgets until all clear >=90%.
--- slingfang ---
Controls: drag back from the glowing fang and release; arrows aim, Space launches; tap a roster orb to select.
Loop: clear 12 enemy formations, bank off walls for phase barriers, bump allies for auras, and retry when vitality empties.
Free: six creatures unlock by stage clears; progress and best score persist locally.
--- sporeling-saga ---
Controls: tap the foe or press Space to strike; tap FORAGE PICK or press F for a free drop; use 1/2/3 for evolution choices.
Loop: auto-fight the lane, forage gear/food/trinkets, choose a branch at ranks 5/10/15, and reach rank 20 for a new-seed rerun.
Progress is earned only while the run is active; the economy panel shows posted odds, next-rank XP, and live XP/minute.
Restart or rerun is instant; best rank, best score, wins, and branch unlocks persist locally.
--- touchline-eleven ---
# Touchline Eleven
Drag from the carrier to pass; swipe toward the top goal to shoot; tap a defender to switch and tackle.
Use arrows to move, J to pass, and K to shoot. Tap PASS or SHOOT for a quick action.
Pick five players between fixtures; wins add two squad players and trophies persist on this device.
Seven matches make a cup; a loss replays the fixture. Matches last three minutes and there are no paid gates.
--- ironsight-ops ---
Controls: left pad/WASD move; right pad/arrows aim and fire; G or GADGET uses the selected gadget.
Loop: choose map/mode/loadout, clear a 2-minute warehouse or courtyard drill, then run it back.
Modes: TDM is first to 20; Control is first to 100 while holding the center zone.
Progress: rank XP and earned camo colors persist locally; there are no purchases or gates.
--- slice-rush ---
Controls: tap PREP and OVEN; drag a hot plate from COUNTER to a table.
Keyboard: 1/2 work stations, 3 selects counter, arrows select, Space/Enter serves.
Loop: keep patience bars alive, buy the 12 automation steps, then prestige for speed.
Three walkouts fail a wave; retry instantly. Progress and best score persist locally.
Portrait only; the rush pauses whenever the phone is rotated.
--- transit-dash ---
# Transit Dash
Controls: swipe left/right = change track, swipe up (or tap) = vault, swipe down = slide. Keyboard: arrows/WASD, Space = vault, P/Esc = pause, R = restart, M = mute.
Loop: 3-lane endless run through a seeded daily transit route — vault rail cars, slide under barriers, dodge signal blocks, hit green ramps for the high-value rooftop coin arc.
Pickups: magnet, grind board (absorbs one hit), double fare. Stumble once and the inspector tails you for 13s; stumble again while he's there and you're caught.
Missions: 3 daily mission chains run in the background; clearing one banks tokens AND rotates the live route theme (rail yard -> rooftop line -> deep tunnel), which regenerates the track ahead.
Persistence: best distance, banked tokens, mission tiers and current route theme are stored in localStorage.
--- molehunt-manor ---
# Molehunt Manor
Ten staff work a 16-room manor; two are moles who fake tasks and sabotage. Six rounds.
Each round: tap 2 rooms to watch them live, tap 2 staff for a statement, read the TASK LOG, then ACCUSE or END ROUND.
Watching a room proves who is really there: anyone the log posted elsewhere, or faking their work, is a mole — the honest are cleared.
Catch both moles to win; if either survives round 6 the sabotage lands. Wrong accusation clears that person and burns the round.
Keyboard: arrows move focus, Enter selects, Esc closes. Portrait only; best round-count and last cases are saved locally.
--- emberline-outpost ---
# Emberline Outpost

Drag a card from the tray onto a tile and flick before releasing: the flick sets the defender's FACING, which rotates its firing footprint. Tap a placed defender for its skill / scrap button.
Loop: hold 8 maps of ground-lane + air waves. Deploy charge regenerates in-map and drops from kills; leak too many enemies through the outpost gate and the map is lost. Clearing maps 1-4 unlocks 2 of the 10 defenders each, and every clear pays salvage.
Between maps, the Workshop crafts deploy kits from salvage into unlockable slots (charge, regen, leak cap, hull, cooldown, salvage rate) — all play-earned, nothing purchasable.
Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, Q/E pick a card, R rotates facing, Space places or selects, Enter fires the skill, X scraps, P pauses, F toggles 2x speed.
Progress, roster, kits and per-map best score persist locally; map 8 is the win.
--- fieldnotes-safari ---
Tap a path to walk, tap a rustle to capture, or open FIELD NOTES; arrows and space also work.
Flick from the copper bead toward the pale lead mark when the timing ring nears the target.
The step budget refreshes at morning/evening windows; PRACTICE WALK is always open.
Weather and habitat affect spawns; the dex posts conditions and odds and saves best sizes locally.
Naturalist medal arrives when all 24 original creatures are recorded.
--- pennant-nine ---
Controls: landscape; drag during the pre-pitch window to guess the zone, then tap SWING. Pitch with a type button and tap STOP in the zone; tap DIVE when prompted.
Keyboard: Space swings/stops/dives; arrows pick pitch type or move the batting guess.
Loop: play 3 innings against four original AI clubs across a 9-game pennant; top the standings to win.
Free: no currencies, gates, ads, accounts, cookies, or network calls; record is local only.
